ABHUKTA_MOOLA_DOSHA.name: Abhukta Moola Dosha — birth at the Jyeshtha-4th-pada / Moola-1st-pada junction. Severest Gandanta.
ABHUKTA_MOOLA_DOSHA.prose: Per Narada Samhita, Abhukta Moola = birth in the last pada of Jyeshtha or the first pada of Moola — the exact Scorpio→Sagittarius water-fire junction (the "unconsumed root"). The most intense Gandanta variant: it signifies acute early-childhood survival/health sensitivities and a transformational crisis for the immediate family early in life. Vashistha and Brhaspati differ on the exact ghatika-extent (1-2 ghatikas either side). Classical remedy: mandatory 27-day Moola-shanti, performed by the parents on the child's behalf.
ABHUKTA_MOOLA_DOSHA.general: Early-childhood survival/health risk, family transformational crisis.

ADHI.name: Adhi — benefics in 6/7/8 from Moon. Leadership and enemy-defeat.
ADHI.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34 v.12 and Phaladeepika Ch.6, Chandra-Adhi Yoga forms when natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) occupy the 6th, 7th, and 8th houses from the Moon. The adversarial houses of the Moon are protected by a benefic shield, turning obstacles into absolute ascendancy. The native rises to become a minister, commander, or ruler. It bestows formidable leadership, strategic brilliance, and easy defeat of opponents.

ADHI_RAJA.name: Adhi-Raja Yoga — benefics 6/7/8 from Moon AND in kendras. Cakravarti fame per Phaladeepika 6.
ADHI_RAJA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Adhi-Raja Yoga arises when natural benefics occupy the 6th, 7th, and 8th from the Moon AND those positions also coincide with kendras. Confers Cakravarti (universal-emperor) fame, victory in all directions, and reputation comparable to the eight directional guardians (Aṣṭadikpālaka). A specialized Mahā-Raja-Yoga distinct from broad Adhi (chandra-advanced).
ADHI_RAJA.general: Cakravarti fame, victory in all directions, eight-direction-guardian reputation, imperial power.

ADHI_YOGA.name: Chandra Adhi Yoga — Natural benefics in the 6th, 7th, and 8th houses from the Moon. Royal-tier leadership and victory.
ADHI_YOGA.prose: Chandra Adhi Yoga — According to Phaladeepika Chapter 6, Verse 16. This highly celebrated yoga occurs when natural benefics (Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus) occupy the 6th, 7th, and 8th houses from the Moon. It functions as a powerful Rajayoga, conferring supreme leadership, ministerial status, invincibility against adversaries, and long-lasting fame. The native possesses immense tactical and intellectual authority.
ADHI_YOGA.career: Supreme administrative or political leadership, ministerial status
ADHI_YOGA.mind: Invincible tactical mind, capacity to systematically overcome obstacles

ADHI_YOGA_FULL.name: Full Adhi Yoga — benefics in 6/7/8 from Moon per Phaladeepika 6. Cakravarti capability.
ADHI_YOGA_FULL.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Full Adhi Yoga = natural benefics in ALL three positions (6, 7, 8) from Moon. Distinct from broad Adhi (chandra-yogas — at least one in each); the FULL form requires complete occupation. Confers Cakravarti (universal-emperor) capability, all-direction victory, eight-direction-guardian fame, and exceptional longevity.
ADHI_YOGA_FULL.general: Cakravarti capability, all-direction victory, supreme reputation, exceptional longevity.

ADITYA_YOGA.name: Aditya — Sun+Mercury+Jupiter conjunct in kendra. Triadic apex.
ADITYA_YOGA.prose:
Aditya — Saravali Ch.20 — Sun, Mercury, AND Jupiter all conjunct in a kendra. The triadic combination of soul (Sun), mind (Mercury), and wisdom (Jupiter) — three karakas in unified position — produces exceptional intellectual leadership and royal favor.

Classical signature for chief justices, prime ministers, top advisors, eminent teachers — those whose authority is rooted in both intellect and dharma. Cancelled when Sun is debilitated.
ADITYA_YOGA.career: Chief justice, top advisor, prime minister

AKHANDA_SAMRAJYA.name: Akhanda Samrajya — Jupiter in kendra + 2nd/11th lord in kendra. Sovereign tier.
AKHANDA_SAMRAJYA.prose:
Akhanda Samrajya — Jataka Parijata Ch.5 — Jupiter in any kendra AND 2nd-lord or 11th-lord in Lagna or another kendra. The "unbroken empire" yoga — vast and lasting authority of sovereign scope.

Doctrinally one of the supreme Raja Yogas; classical signature for emperor-tier position, extraordinary power, and long-lasting reign. Found in charts of royalty, heads of state, large-corporation chairmen, or supreme-eminence leaders. The benefic-karaka (Jupiter) unified with dhana/labha-karaka (2nd/11th-lord) produces sovereign-tier authority paired with sovereign-tier wealth.

ALPAYU_BALARISHTA_TRIPLE.name: Alpayu — triple Balarishta cluster. Compound childhood-mortality risk.
ALPAYU_BALARISHTA_TRIPLE.prose: Alpayu Balarishta-Triple — BPHS Ch.43 — three Balarishta indicators co-firing: Moon afflicted, malefics on Lagna-7th axis, no benefic in kendra. The compound triggers a grave childhood-mortality risk (years 0-8); effect diminishes after childhood is safely passed. Remedy: Navagraha-shanti, Mahamrityunjaya-japa, guru-kripa upasana.

ALPAYU_LAGNA_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Alpayu — Lagna-lord in dusthana while 8th-lord strong. Short-life indicator.
ALPAYU_LAGNA_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Alpayu Lagna-Lord-Dusthana — BPHS Ch.43 — forms when the Lagna-lord (atma-karaka) occupies a dusthana (6, 8, 12) while the 8th-lord (death-karaka) sits strong in a kendra or trikona. The self-significator is weakened while the mortality-significator is empowered — classical short-life indicator (under 32 years). Note: this is one diagnostic, not the final verdict; classical commentary directs weighing the count and dignity of all firing tier-rules. Remedy: Mahamrityunjaya-japa, Lagna-lord pacification.

ALPAYU_MOON_SATURN_AFFLICTED.name: Alpayu — weak Moon with strong Saturn. Mind-body vitality compromised.
ALPAYU_MOON_SATURN_AFFLICTED.prose: Alpayu Moon-Saturn-Afflicted — BPHS Ch.43 — Moon weakened (in dusthana or debilitated) while Saturn strong (in kendra/trikona or own/exalted). The mind-Saturn pair forms the second of the three classical Ayur-determining couples; weak Moon with strong Saturn signals weakened mind-body vitality. Remedy: Chandra-shanti, Monday-vrata, Shani-shanti.

AMALA.name: Amala — benefic in 10th from Lagna or Moon. Spotless reputation.
AMALA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Amala Yoga forms when the 10th house from either Lagna or Moon is occupied solely by natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, or Mercury). "Amala" means spotless or unblemished. The native is blessed with a completely clean reputation, enduring public esteem, and highly ethical professional success. The presence of a benefic in the house of action purifies one's karma, making this a signature of respected leaders, philanthropists, and widely beloved public personalities.

AMALA_KIRTI_BENEFIC_10_FROM_MOON.name: Amala Kirti — benefic in 10th from Moon. Untarnished reputation.
AMALA_KIRTI_BENEFIC_10_FROM_MOON.prose:
Amala Kirti is described in Phaladeepika 6.40. It forms when a benefic occupies the 10th house from the Moon (rather than from the Lagna). The Sanskrit name "Amala" literally means "untarnished" or "stainless" — and classical commentary describes these natives as having durable, controversy-resistant reputation grounded in moral consistency.

The yoga is doctrinally distinct from the Lagna-anchored Sukarma — Amala emphasises *reputation-as-perceived* (Moon = mind/public-perception axis), while Sukarma emphasises *action-quality* (Lagna = self-action axis).
AMALA_KIRTI_BENEFIC_10_FROM_MOON.career: Untarnished public reputation, moral consistency, controversy-resistant standing

AMAVASYA_DOSHA.name: Amāvasyā Dosha — new-moon birth per BPHS 6. Lunar-luminosity reduction.
AMAVASYA_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.6, Amāvasyā Dosha = birth on the new-moon day (Sun-Moon conjunction). Distinct from the SUN_MOON_CONJ yoga (which is the planetary conjunction sense); this dosha is the panchanga-tithi-based reading. Confers reduced lunar luminosity (emotional reserve), maternal-health concerns, mental tension, and pitṛ-karma sensitivity. Mitigated by Chandra-śānti vrata.
AMAVASYA_DOSHA.general: Lunar-luminosity reduction, maternal-health concerns, mental tension, pitṛ-karma sensitivity.

AMRIT_CHANDRA.name: Amrit (Moon) — Moon in own/exalted in kendra. Apex Moon-yoga.
AMRIT_CHANDRA.prose:
Amrit (Moon) — Saravali Ch.18 — Moon in own sign (Cancer) OR exalted sign (Taurus) AND simultaneously in a kendra (1, 4, 7, 10). The manas-karaka receives apex strength: foundation-pillar placement combined with own/exalted dignity.

"Amrit" means "ever-living, nectar-like". The native enjoys emotional stability, maternal welfare and longevity, and continuous protection from adversity. Mental peace, natural-grace amid difficulty, and effortless social attractiveness. Doctrinally rated the supreme classical Moon-yoga — comparable in tier to Hamsa among the Pancha Mahapurusha. Maternal welfare is exceptionally strong; Moon's dasha brings abundant benefic results.

ANAPHA.name: Anapha Yoga — Any planet (except Sun, Rahu, and Ketu) in the 12th house from the Moon. Inner refinement and peace.
ANAPHA.prose: Anapha Yoga — As defined in Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 5. This yoga occurs when any qualifying planet other than the Sun, Rahu, and Ketu occupies the 12th house from the Moon. In classical Vedic astrology, this configuration represents inherited cultural refinement, psychological peace, and a compassionate nature. The specific psychological and spiritual effects are refined by the occupying planet.
ANAPHA.mind: Inner tranquility, compassionate disposition, inherited culture
ANAPHA.relationships: Harmony in family life and gentle social interactions

ANAPHA_JUPITER.name: Anapha-Jupiter — Jupiter in the 12th house from the Moon. Spiritual depth and altruism.
ANAPHA_JUPITER.prose: Anapha-Jupiter — Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 5. When Jupiter resides in the 12th house from the Moon, it creates an exceptional vessel for spiritual wisdom, altruism, and meditation. The native seeks inner peace over outer validation, exhibiting a compassionate nature and an inclination toward liberation (moksha) and humanitarian work.
ANAPHA_JUPITER.mind: Profound peace, ethical clarity, detachment from vanity
ANAPHA_JUPITER.spirituality: Inclination toward liberation (moksha), selfless charity, meditative depth

ANAPHA_MARS.name: Anapha-Mars — Mars in the 12th house from the Moon. Composed courage and strategic skill.
ANAPHA_MARS.prose: Anapha-Mars — Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 5. When Mars occupies the 12th house from the Moon, it manifests as inward-directed energy and calculated courage. Unlike the outward aggression of Sunapha-Mars, this placement grants the native an excellent control over impulses, strategic foresight, surgical precision, or martial arts mastery.
ANAPHA_MARS.career: Surgeon, defense strategist, investigator, or martial artist
ANAPHA_MARS.mind: Controlled anger, strategic courage, deep resilience

ANAPHA_MERCURY.name: Anapha-Mercury — Mercury in the 12th house from the Moon. Measured eloquence and research depth.
ANAPHA_MERCURY.prose: Anapha-Mercury — Under Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 5. When Mercury occupies the 12th house from the Moon, it turns the intellectual capabilities inward. This configuration grants the native academic research depth, measured eloquence, editorial excellence, and a talent for studying occult or hidden sciences.
ANAPHA_MERCURY.career: Researcher, editor, academician, archivist, or occult scholar
ANAPHA_MERCURY.mind: Deep investigative intellect, love for solitude and study

ANAPHA_SATURN.name: Anapha-Saturn — Saturn in the 12th house from the Moon. Ascetic disposition and profound resilience.
ANAPHA_SATURN.prose: Anapha-Saturn — Under Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 5. When Saturn occupies the 12th house from the Moon, it brings solemnity, introspection, and structural restraint to the mind. The native has an innate capacity for solitude, ascetic discipline, and profound endurance under adversity. It is a highly protective signature for emotional resilience.
ANAPHA_SATURN.mind: Solitary resilience, stoicism, profound emotional boundaries
ANAPHA_SATURN.spirituality: Ascetic disposition, philosophical detachment, meditative silence

ANAPHA_STRICT.name: Anapha (strict) — benefic in 12th from Moon, 2nd vacant. Pure inherited refinement.
ANAPHA_STRICT.prose:
Anapha (strict-form) — Brihat Jataka 13.5 — benefic in the 12th from Moon AND nothing (except Sun/nodes) in the 2nd. The broader `ANAPHA` fires on any planet in the 12th; the strict form requires benefic-specific occupation AND 2nd vacancy.

Doctrinal flavor: broad form = mixed cultural-inherited disposition; strict form = pure inherited refinement, gentle disposition, and lineage-rooted aesthetic quality. Modern reading: "old-money refinement" or hereditary cultivation is the specific signature of strict Anapha.

ANAPHA_VENUS.name: Anapha-Venus — Venus in the 12th house from the Moon. Refined aesthetic discernment and relational grace.
ANAPHA_VENUS.prose: Anapha-Venus — According to Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 5. When Venus is in the 12th house from the Moon, it elevates the aesthetic sense into a spiritual or deeply private appreciation. The native values loyalty, quiet elegance, and genuine emotional connections, avoiding superficial displays of wealth or affection.
ANAPHA_VENUS.mind: Refined aesthetic discernment, love for quiet elegance and harmony
ANAPHA_VENUS.relationships: Conjugal loyalty, respectful and polished relational boundary

ANGA_ARISHTA.name: Anga-Arishta — debilitated Mars in Lagna. Susceptibility to bodily injuries, muscular frailty, or surgeries.
ANGA_ARISHTA.prose: Anga-Arishta — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — Mars debilitated (Cancer) in Lagna. Mars governs muscles/blood/wounds; debility in the body-house produces an organ-specific defect or injury indication. Remedy: Mars-shanti, Subrahmanya-upasana, Hanuman-Chalisa, Neecha-Bhanga search.

ANSHIK_MANGAL.name: Anshik (partial) Mangal — Mars in dosha-houses but mitigated per Mansagari 5.
ANSHIK_MANGAL.prose: Per Mansagari Ch.5, Anshik Mangal = Mars in classical Mangal-dosha houses (1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12) BUT aspected by benefic OR placed in own/exalted dignity OR debilitated/combust (which weakens its dosha-causing capacity). Confers MILDER marital strain than full Mangal — reduced separation risk, partner-health concerns somewhat softened. Distinct grading from Mansagari's Anshik/Pūrṇa Mangal taxonomy.
ANSHIK_MANGAL.general: Moderate marital strain, partner-health shadow, reduced marriage obstacles.

ARDHA_CHANDRA.name: Ardha-Chandra Yoga — 7 grahas in 6-house arc per BPHS 36. Half-moon royal fame.
ARDHA_CHANDRA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Ardha-Chandra Yoga = 7 grahas in a continuous 6-house arc forming a half-circle. The "half-moon" pattern confers gentle royal fame, public-emotional appeal, and dharma-derived wealth. Common in cultural-figures and beloved leaders whose appeal is moonlight-soft rather than solar-glaring.
ARDHA_CHANDRA.general: Gentle royal fame, public-emotional appeal, dharma-wealth, moon-soft graciousness.

ASA.name: Āśā Yoga — Moon in kendra surrounded by benefics per Phaladeepika 6.
ASA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Āśā (hope/desire-fulfilment) Yoga = Moon in kendra surrounded by natural benefics. Confers fulfilment of all hopes/desires, public-emotional appeal, evenly-distributed auspicious fruit, and mind-significator protection. The yoga's name signals reliable wish-fulfilment.
ASA.general: Desire fulfilment, public emotional appeal, even auspiciousness, mind protection.

BADHAKA_DOSHA.name: Badhaka Dosha — affliction of the badhaka-sthana by Lagna modality (BPHS). Hidden obstruction.
BADHAKA_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS, the badhaka-sthana ("house of obstruction") is the 11th from a movable Lagna, the 9th from a fixed Lagna, and the 7th from a dual Lagna. The dosha fires when a natural malefic occupies the badhaka-sthana, or when the Badhakesh (its lord) sits in a dusthana (6/8/12). It manifests as unexplained bottlenecks and sudden interruptions right as a goal nears completion. Cancellation: the Badhakesh in its own/exalted/mooltrikona sign, or in an upachaya (3/6/11) where malefics mature well. Remedies: propitiation of the Badhakesh, Ganesha puja. (Parashara applies Badhaka chiefly within Chara dasha; here it is surfaced as a natal flag.)
BADHAKA_DOSHA.general: Hidden bottlenecks, sudden interruptions near completion of goals.

BAHU_PUTRA_BENEFIC_5_AND_9.name: Bahu-Putra — benefics in BOTH 5th and 9th. Multiple children, dharmic.
BAHU_PUTRA_BENEFIC_5_AND_9.prose:
Bahu-Putra Yoga — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when natural benefics (Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, unwounded Moon) simultaneously occupy the 5th AND 9th houses. The 5th and 9th are the two auspicious trikonas: 5th carries progeny + merit, 9th carries dharma + fortune. Their joint benefic-occupation crowns Santana with Bhagya, producing the supreme multi-progeny configuration.

Natives have many children — typically dharma-rooted, long-lived, and socially-prominent. The yoga signals long-term lineage prosperity rather than just immediate child-welfare; the family-line continues to flourish across generations.

BALARISHTA_LAGNA_7TH_MALEFICS.name: Balarishta — malefics in Lagna and 7th houses. Squeezed body-axis leads to low physical resilience in childhood.
BALARISHTA_LAGNA_7TH_MALEFICS.prose: Balarishta Lagna-7th-Malefics — BPHS Ch.45 — malefics simultaneously in 1st and 7th with no benefic aspect. The body-axis is squeezed by hostile flanking influences; childhood physical resilience is structurally weak. Remedy: Navagraha-shanti, Hanuman-upasana, vitality-amplifying tapas.

BALARISHTA_MOON_DUSTHANA_NO_BENEFIC.name: Balarishta — Moon in dusthana without benefic aspects. Depressed vitality and physical fragility in early life.
BALARISHTA_MOON_DUSTHANA_NO_BENEFIC.prose: Balarishta Moon-Dusthana-No-Benefic — BPHS Ch.45 — Moon in dusthana (6, 8, 12) with no benefic aspect from Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus. Without restorative grace, childhood vitality remains chronically weak. Remedy: Chandra-Gayatri, mother-welfare puja, upasana to amplify Jupiter aspects.

BALARISHTA_MOON_LAGNA_MALEFIC.name: Balarishta — Moon in Lagna aspected/conjunct malefic. Infant-health and maternal-bond stress in years 1 to 8.
BALARISHTA_MOON_LAGNA_MALEFIC.prose: Balarishta Moon-Lagna-Malefic — BPHS Ch.45 — Moon in 1st conjunct or aspected by malefic. Moon governs body, mind, and mother in early life; afflicted in the body-house, the configuration signals infant-mortality or grave-illness risk in years 1-8. Remedy: Chandra-Gayatri, maternal welfare emphasis, strong Jupiter aspect required. Effect diminishes once childhood is safely passed.

BALARISHTA_MOON_SATURN_DUSTHANA.name: Balarishta — Moon and Saturn conjunct in dusthana. Weakened constitution and physical vulnerability in childhood.
BALARISHTA_MOON_SATURN_DUSTHANA.prose: Balarishta Moon-Saturn-Dusthana — BPHS Ch.45 — Moon and Saturn jointly in a dusthana (6, 8, 12). Mind-karaka fused with chronic-restriction-karaka in the wounded houses produces an acute infant-stage indication: weakened constitution and emotional fragility in years 1-8. Remedy: Moon-Saturn pacification, Mahamrityunjaya-japa, careful maternal care. Strong Jupiter aspect or powerful Lagna offsets.
BALARISHTA_MOON_SATURN_DUSTHANA.mind: Constitution and emotional resilience weak in years 1-8

BALARISHTA_SUN_MARS_LAGNA.name: Balarishta — Sun and Mars in Lagna. Fire-element imbalance causes high fevers, injury, or trauma risks in childhood.
BALARISHTA_SUN_MARS_LAGNA.prose: Balarishta Sun-Mars-Lagna — BPHS Ch.45 — Sun-Mars conjunction in 1st. Both planets carry agni-tattva (fire); their conjunction in the body-house signals acute fever, injury, or accident risk in childhood. Remedy: Surya-Mars pacification, Subrahmanya-upasana, fire-element cooling measures.
BALARISHTA_SUN_MARS_LAGNA.mind: Acute fever or accident risk in childhood

BANDHA_ARISHTA.name: Bandha-Arishta — Saturn and Rahu in 12th house. Susceptibility to legal imprisonment, isolation, or severe debts.
BANDHA_ARISHTA.prose: Bandha-Arishta — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — Saturn-Rahu conjunct in the 12th house. Saturn (chronic-restriction) and Rahu (shadow) jointly in the loss/confinement house signal imprisonment, exile, or hidden-enemy danger. Remedy: Saturn-Rahu pacification, Hanuman-upasana, legal-vigilance.

BANDHU_DOSHA.name: Bandhu Dosha — 3rd lord/Mars afflicted per BPHS 21. Sibling challenges.
BANDHU_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.21, Bandhu (sibling) Dosha = 3rd lord OR Mars (twin sibling-significators) afflicted. Confers sibling-health concerns, separation risk, sibling-conflict tendency. Mitigated by Mars-strength remediation and sibling-affection cultivation.
BANDHU_DOSHA.general: Sibling challenges, separation risk, sibling-conflict tendency.

BENEFIC_ALL_KENDRAS.name: Benefics in all 4 kendras: Śubha-Kendra Yoga. Four-pillar life-stability per Phaladeepika 6.
BENEFIC_ALL_KENDRAS.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, when benefic planets occupy all four kendras (1, 4, 7, 10), the chart gains a Śubha-Kendra Yoga — life rests on four well-built pillars (body, comfort, partnership, career). All four cardinal directions of life flourish; the native enjoys all-round auspiciousness, stable fame, and royal recognition.
BENEFIC_ALL_KENDRAS.general: Śubha-Kendra Yoga, all-round auspiciousness, stable fame, royal recognition, four-pillar life-stability.

BENEFIC_ALL_TRIKONAS.name: Benefics in all 3 trikonas: Śubha-Trikoṇa Yoga. Triple-fortune via Lakshmi-bhavas per Phaladeepika 6.
BENEFIC_ALL_TRIKONAS.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, when benefic planets occupy all three trikonas (1, 5, 9), the chart gains a Śubha-Trikoṇa Yoga — the three Lakshmi-bhavas align to confer triple-fortune. Past-merit (5th), current fame (1st), and future destiny (9th) all flourish in concert. The strongest pure-fortune indicator in the corpus.
BENEFIC_ALL_TRIKONAS.general: Śubha-Trikoṇa Yoga, triple-fortune, Lakshmi-grace, past-merit + present + future synergy.

BENEFIC_IN_5.name: Benefic in 5th — Putra-Prajñā Yoga per BPHS 7. Intelligent progeny, mantra-siddhi.
BENEFIC_IN_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, benefic placed in the 5th = Putra-Prajñā Yoga. Past-merit bhāva housing benefics confers intelligent/worthy progeny, mantra-siddhi, learning skill, and royal recognition. Among the most reliable child-significator yogas. Often reads as "the chart prepared spiritually for fortunate children."
BENEFIC_IN_5.general: Putra-Prajñā Yoga, intelligent progeny, mantra-siddhi, learning skill, royal recognition.

BENEFIC_IN_9.name: Benefic in 9th — Bhāgya-Dharma Yoga per BPHS 7. Supreme fortune, guru-grace.
BENEFIC_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, benefic in 9th = Bhāgya-Dharma Yoga. Fortune-bhāva housing natural benefics confers supreme fortune, guru-grace, dharmic disposition, paternal happiness, and access to spiritual teaching. Among the most exalted Beneficial-placement yogas — destiny opens generously.
BENEFIC_IN_9.general: Bhāgya-Dharma Yoga, supreme fortune, guru's grace, dharmic life, paternal happiness.

BHADRA.name: Bhadra Yoga — Mercury in kendra and dignity. Confers exceptional intellect, eloquence, and commercial acumen.
BHADRA.prose: Bhadra Yoga is the second of the Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas (BPHS Ch. 76, v. 2), representing the pinnacle of mercurial expression. It is formed when Mercury is situated in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) from the Ascendant or the Moon while occupying its own sign (Gemini/Virgo) or its exaltation sign (Virgo). Since Mercury governs cognition, articulation, and commerce, this yoga refines the mind's analytical capacity to an extraordinary degree. The native is endowed with pristine speech (vak-patuta), rapid mathematical computation skills, and a highly strategic business mind. Historically celebrated as the marker of counselors, statesmen, and great merchants, in the modern era it distinguishes visionary tech leaders, writers, financial analysts, and kootniti (diplomats) of the highest order.
BHADRA.body: Graceful, youthful appearance, expressive eyes, and refined physical dexterity
BHADRA.career: Elite positions in academia, literature, trade, diplomacy, software engineering, and strategic consulting
BHADRA.mind: Exceptional cognitive speed, photographic memory, and advanced logical reasoning
BHADRA.wealth: Prolific financial success derived from intellectual property, trade, advisory services, and diversified assets

BHADRA_BHANGA.name: Bhadra Bhanga — Mercury combust or retrograde in kendra. Bhadra-yoga effects are rendered unstable or delayed.
BHADRA_BHANGA.prose: Bhadra Bhanga occurs when the primary astronomical conditions of Bhadra Yoga are met, but Mercury is simultaneously combust (asta) by the Sun or retrograde (vakri). Because Mercury naturally orbits close to the Sun, this combustion is extremely common in astrological charts. Under this configuration, the native possesses a highly analytical mind and vast knowledge base, but struggles to project it seamlessly. The combust status causes mental hesitation, stage fright, or an inability to articulate thoughts under pressure. The retrograde status introduces a tendency to over-analyze, leading to commercial indecisiveness or project delays. Classical remedies include Mercury Gayatri japa and sincere devotion to Goddess Saraswati to restore mental clarity.
BHADRA_BHANGA.career: Talents in writing or commerce exist but are subject to constant revisions, delays, and contractual renegotiations
BHADRA_BHANGA.mind: Exceptional intellect paired with severe self-doubt, performance anxiety, or communication blocks under stress
BHADRA_BHANGA.spirituality: Recitation of the Mercury Gayatri mantra and worship of Goddess Saraswati are highly recommended to balance the energy

BHADRA_DOSHA.name: Bhadra Dosha — Viṣṭi karaṇa birth per Muhurta Chintamani. Auspicious-work obstruction.
BHADRA_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi, Bhadra Dosha = birth during Viṣṭi karaṇa (one of the 11 karaṇas, considered inauspicious for muhurta-based actions). Confers obstruction in auspicious karmas, sacrament-difficulty risk, and daily-work reduction. Three-tier classical grading: Pucchā Bhadra (tail-end, mildest), Madhya Bhadra (middle, moderate), Mukha Bhadra (mouth/face, most severe).
BHADRA_DOSHA.general: Auspicious-work obstruction, sacrament difficulty, daily-work reduction.

BHADRA_EXALTED.name: Supreme Bhadra — Mercury exalted (Virgo) in kendra. Apex intellect-yoga conferring sharp analytical skill.
BHADRA_EXALTED.prose: Supreme Bhadra represents the ultimate heights of intellectual capacity within the Pancha Mahapurusha framework. In Virgo (specifically at its deep exaltation point of 15 degrees), Mercury is uniquely positioned to simultaneously activate its exaltation, own-sign, and moolatrikona status. This triple-dignity alignment delivers a pristine, unfiltered flow of cognitive energy. The native is endowed with a phenomenal intellect, exceptional clarity of speech, and an outstanding capacity for mathematics, logic, and systems analysis. Unlike base Bhadra, the exalted status ensures that the native's intellectual output receives widespread public acclaim and institutional recognition. This configuration produces elite scholars, international diplomats, leading editors, and pioneering technology visionaries.
BHADRA_EXALTED.career: World-class scholarship, high-stakes diplomacy, editorial leadership, and mathematical research
BHADRA_EXALTED.mind: Apex analytical intellect, flawless memory, multi-lingual proficiency, and unmatched wit
BHADRA_EXALTED.wealth: Vast wealth generated through intellectual property, high-level trade, and strategic advisory services

BHADRA_FROM_MOON.name: Bhadra from Moon — Mercury angular from the Moon in dignity. Confers a highly analytical, articulate mind.
BHADRA_FROM_MOON.prose: Chandra Bhadra Yoga is established when Mercury occupies a kendra from the natal Moon while in its own sign or exaltation sign. In Vedic chart synthesis, while a Lagna-based Bhadra manifests as external intellectual success, Chandra Bhadra refines the internal thought processes and cognitive agility of the native. The alignment of the Moon (emotions and perception) with Mercury (logic and speech) creates a pristine synthesis of emotional intelligence and logical deductive reasoning. The native possesses an incredibly sharp, articulate mind, with native talents for strategic planning, creative writing, and rapid mathematical computation. When Mercury is angular from both the Lagna and the Moon simultaneously, it creates a supreme academician or a premier diplomat whose counsel is sought globally.
BHADRA_FROM_MOON.mind: Phenomenal cognitive agility, sharp eloquence, retentive memory, and highly strategic trade instincts

BHAGYA_9_LORD_KENDRA.name: Bhagya — 9th-lord in kendra. Fortune-lord well-anchored in pillar-houses.
BHAGYA_9_LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Bhagya 9-Lord-Kendra is the canonical fortune yoga (BPHS Ch.34; Phaladeepika 6.31). It forms when the 9th-lord — significator of fortune, paternal welfare, dharma, and divine grace — occupies a kendra (1st/4th/7th/10th house) from the Lagna. The 9th-lord in a structural-pillar house anchors the bhagya stream of the chart in the foundational supports of the life: body (1st), home (4th), partnerships (7th), and career (10th).

Classical commentary describes these natives as having sustained good fortune across the lifespan, paternal support, fortunate timing in opportunities, and an underlying dharmic orientation that draws auspicious circumstances. Career inclinations include law (especially as judge or counsel), higher education, advisory roles, religious vocations, and trades that engage with foreign cultures (since the 9th also signifies long journeys and the foreign-realm).

**Cancellation.** The yoga is cancelled when the 9th-lord falls in a dusthana (6/8/12) — encoded inline. Trikona placement is mutually exclusive with the kendra placement at runtime, so the cancellation is doctrinal documentation rather than active diluter.
BHAGYA_9_LORD_KENDRA.career: Law (judge/counsel), higher education, advisory, religious vocations, foreign trade
BHAGYA_9_LORD_KENDRA.spirituality: Dharmic orientation that attracts auspicious circumstances
BHAGYA_9_LORD_KENDRA.wealth: Sustained good fortune across the lifespan; opportunity-timing

BHAGYA_9_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Bhagya — 9th-lord in own/exalted/mooltrikona dignity.
BHAGYA_9_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose:
Bhagya 9-Lord-Own/Exalt forms when the 9th-lord — whichever planet it is — occupies its own sign, exaltation, or mooltrikona dignity. Unlike the kendra and trikona variants which depend on structural placement, this rule depends on **dignity alone**. The dignified 9th-lord acts on its bhagya-significations directly through its own strength regardless of which house it occupies.

Classical commentary describes these natives as having self-generated fortune — they don't depend on external circumstances to support their dharmic life-direction. Paternal authority, independent decision-making capacity, and durable religious reputation are typical signatures.
BHAGYA_9_LORD_OWN_EXALT.wealth: Resources arrive through inner conviction rather than external structure

BHAGYA_9_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Bhagya — 9th-lord in trikona. Fortune flows through dharmic alignment.
BHAGYA_9_LORD_TRIKONA.prose:
Bhagya 9-Lord-Trikona forms when the 9th-lord occupies a trikona (1/5/9) from the Lagna. Where the kendra-variant anchors fortune in structural-pillar houses, the trikona-variant flows fortune through *dharmic alignment* — purva-punya (past-life merit), intellectual capacity (5th), and inner dharma (9th itself).

Classical commentary distinguishes the two: kendra-bhagya manifests as external opportunity-structure; trikona-bhagya manifests as inward merit-current. These natives are drawn to philosophy, dharmic teaching, scriptural research, and roles where inner conviction translates directly to outer effect (acharyas, lineage-keepers, dharmic activists).
BHAGYA_9_LORD_TRIKONA.career: Philosophy, dharmic teaching, scriptural research, lineage-keeping
BHAGYA_9_LORD_TRIKONA.spirituality: Past-life merit (purva-punya) manifesting as fortune; deep dharmic conviction
BHAGYA_9_LORD_TRIKONA.wealth: Earnings through dharmic work; merit-driven prosperity

BHAGYA_BENEFIC_9_AND_KENDRA.name: Bhagya — benefic in 9th + benefic in kendra. Comprehensive support.
BHAGYA_BENEFIC_9_AND_KENDRA.prose:
Bhagya-Benefic-Compound forms when ANY benefic (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, or unafflicted Moon) occupies the 9th AND another benefic occupies any kendra (1/4/7/10). The compound provides both bhagya-flow (9th) and structural support (kendra) simultaneously.

Classical commentary describes these natives as having fortune that arrives through external structural support — career foundations are durable, family relationships are harmonious, and the life-direction is dharmically aligned, all reinforcing each other. Distinct from solitary 9-lord-kendra (one mechanism) by carrying *two* benefic engagements.
BHAGYA_BENEFIC_9_AND_KENDRA.career: Durable career foundations; multiple supportive engagements
BHAGYA_BENEFIC_9_AND_KENDRA.relationships: Harmonious family bonds reinforce career trajectory

BHAGYA_LORDS_TRIKONA_EXCHANGE.name: Bhagya — Lagna-lord and 9th-lord in mutual exchange. Supreme dharma-self link.
BHAGYA_LORDS_TRIKONA_EXCHANGE.prose:
Bhagya-Lords-Trikona-Exchange (Bhagya-Lagna Parivartana) is the supreme tier of Bhagya yogas — TIER_1 alongside Maha-Bhagya. It forms when the Lagna-lord occupies the sign of the 9th-lord AND the 9th-lord occupies the sign of the Lagna-lord, completing a mutual structural exchange.

The parivartana doctrinally locks self-significator (Lagna-lord) and dharma-significator (9th-lord) into a reinforcing structure — the chart owner's identity and life-direction are unified. Classical commentary places these natives among history's great dharmic leaders: the lifelong path of self is the path of dharma.
BHAGYA_LORDS_TRIKONA_EXCHANGE.career: Dharmic leadership; self-directed life carrying historic weight
BHAGYA_LORDS_TRIKONA_EXCHANGE.spirituality: Identity and life-direction unified; lifelong dharmic alignment

BHAGYA_YOGA.name: Bhagya Yoga — 9th lord in own house. Providential luck, divine protection, and dharmic righteousness anchored.
BHAGYA_YOGA.prose:
Bhagya Yoga — According to Phaladeepika, Chapter 6. This highly auspicious yoga is formed when the 9th lord (bhagya-adhipati) is posited in its own house, the 9th. Under the classical doctrine of 'lord-in-own-house' (swagriha-raksha), a planet occupying its own domain bestows supreme Bhava Bala (house-strength) to that sector, effectively safeguarding and magnifying the entire fortune, grace, and spiritual foundation of the horoscope.

The native is blessed with extraordinary good fortune, an untarnished moral reputation, paternal blessings, and the seamless acquisition of inherited properties. While categorized under wealth configurations, its primary significations are spiritual alignment and general luck; material abundance flows as a natural, effortless byproduct. Doctrinal indicators include high-tier academic achievements, spiritual or ethical leadership, and major financial prosperity generated through international travels or cross-cultural ventures.
BHAGYA_YOGA.career: Distinction in higher academia, spiritual or philosophical leadership, and international success
BHAGYA_YOGA.material: Vast paternal inheritance, acquisition of secure assets, and effortless wealth
BHAGYA_YOGA.spirituality: Extraordinary providential grace, righteous lifestyle, and ethical excellence

BHAKOOT_DOSHA.name: Bhakoot Dosha — Moon-rashi 6-8 / 2-12 / 5-9 relation per Muhurta Chintamani 6.
BHAKOOT_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi Ch.6, Bhakoot Koot fails when the bride/groom Moon-rashis form 6-8 (ṣaḍ-aṣṭaka — sixth/eighth), 2-12 (dvi-dvādasha), or 5-9 (nava-pancama) relations. Confers marital disharmony, ideological conflicts, financial-disputes risk, and mental tension. Among the heaviest Aṣṭa-Kūṭa failures (along with Nāḍī). Classical exceptions: same Rāśi (zeroes out), planetary-friendship neutralisation between Moon-lords.
BHAKOOT_DOSHA.general: Marital disharmony, ideological conflicts, financial disputes, mental tension.

BHARATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA_FROM_MERCURY.name: Bharati — benefic in kendra from Mercury. Supreme scholarship and articulate teaching.
BHARATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA_FROM_MERCURY.prose:
Bharati Yoga — Saravali Ch.40 — forms when a natural benefic (Jupiter, Venus, or unwounded Moon) occupies a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) reckoned *from Mercury*, not from the Lagna. Named after Bharati (the goddess of speech), the yoga signals supreme scholarship, oratory, and pedagogic mastery.

Natives become eminent scholars, orators, writers, editors, or teachers. Mercury's communication-karaka function fuses with the benefic's purifying influence to produce vak-shakti (speech-power). Classical commentary cites this configuration in the charts of literary laureates, research luminaries, and lineage-founding teachers.
BHARATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA_FROM_MERCURY.career: Eminent teaching, literature, oratory, editorial work, research

BHATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_3.name: Bhatr-Sukha — benefic in 3rd. Younger sibling welfare.
BHATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_3.prose: Bhatr-Sukha (literally "sibling-happiness") is described in Saravali Ch.40. It forms when a benefic occupies the 3rd house. Classical commentary describes harmonious sibling relationships, support from younger brothers/sisters, and an emotional buffer in initiative-undertakings. Cancelled when a malefic also occupies the 3rd.
BHATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_3.mind: Sense of being supported in initiative-undertakings
BHATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_3.relationships: Harmonious younger-sibling bonds; emotional support network

BHERI.name: Bheri Yoga — Jupiter, Venus, Lagna-lord in mutual kendras. Royal leadership per Saravali 34.
BHERI.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Bheri Yoga arises when Jupiter, Venus, and the Lagna-lord occupy kendras from each other. Confers royal leadership, military command, high office, and dharmic governance. The yoga's name (bheri = war-drum) signals divine-trumpet fame — the native's ascendancy is publicly proclaimed.
BHERI.general: Royal leadership, military command, high office, dharmic governance.

BRAHMA_DOSHA.name: Brahma Dosha — Jupiter weak/papa-aspected in 9th per BPHS 84. Brāhmaṇa-curse karma.
BRAHMA_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.84, Brahma Dosha = Jupiter in 9th (dharma-bhāva) weakly placed or aspected by malefics. Confers past-life Brāhmaṇa-curse karma, dharma-lineage difficulties, guru-disrespect dosha, and obstacles in dharmic education. Classical interpretation: past-life offense against priestly/teacher class. Remedies: Brahma-Gāyatrī recitation, Brāhmaṇa-bhojan (feeding priests), Vedic-study penance.
BRAHMA_DOSHA.general: Brāhmaṇa-curse karma, dharma-lineage difficulties, guru-disrespect dosha, dharma-education obstacles.

BRAHMA_RAJA.name: Brahma-Raja Yoga — Jupiter, Venus, Mercury all in kendras. Brahmic wisdom + royal honour per Saravali 34.
BRAHMA_RAJA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Brahma-Raja Yoga arises when Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury all simultaneously occupy kendras (1/4/7/10). The triad of intellectual benefics in the chart's pillars confers brahmic wisdom, dharmic royal recognition, mastery of all scriptures, and supreme fame. A Mahā-Raja-Yoga reserved for sages, scholar-kings, and supreme intellectual eminence.
BRAHMA_RAJA.general: Brahmic wisdom, dharmic royal honour, scriptural mastery, supreme fame.

BUDDHA.name: Buddha Yoga — exalted Mercury in kendra aspected by benefic per Saravali 34.
BUDDHA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Buddha (enlightened-one) Yoga = Mercury exalted/own-sign in a kendra, aspected by benefic. Confers Bodhi-like wisdom, mastery of all scriptures, dharmic-teacher capability, and dedicated sādhanā disposition. Buddha-radiance personality. Common in scholar-teachers and contemplatives whose intellect is informed by spiritual practice.
BUDDHA.general: Bodhi-like wisdom, scriptural mastery, dharmic-teacher capability, sādhanā disposition.

BUDDHI_VIDYA_MERCURY_4.name: Buddhi-Vidya — Mercury well-placed in 4th. Analytical, articulate intellect.
BUDDHI_VIDYA_MERCURY_4.prose:
Buddhi-Vidya forms when Mercury — natural significator of intellect (buddhi), language, and analytical reasoning — occupies the 4th house in own, exalted, mooltrikona, friendly, or neutral dignity. Phaladeepika 13 holds that intellect-karaka in the education-house grants sharpness of mind, linguistic facility, and analytical depth.

Natives excel in mathematics, logic, communication, writing, editing, journalism, and data analysis. Debilitated Mercury cancels the yoga — a wounded intellect-karaka in the comfort-house produces educational struggle and articulation difficulties rather than the intended effect.

BUDHADITYA.name: Budhāditya Yoga — Sun-Mercury conjunction. Intellect, eloquence, royal recognition per BPHS 11.
BUDHADITYA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.11, Budhāditya Yoga forms when Sun and Mercury share a sign. The native gains intellect, eloquence, mathematical/scientific skill, and royal recognition. Full effect requires Mercury to not be combust (within ~14° of Sun) — when too close, Mercury's rays are absorbed and the yoga is dampened. Phaladeepika Ch.14 ranks it among the foremost Raja-yogas. Common in academics, executives, and analytic-profession leaders.
BUDHADITYA.general: Intellect, eloquence, mathematical/scientific skill, royal recognition, higher education.

CHAKRA.name: Chakra Yoga — 7 grahas in odd houses (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11) per BPHS 36. Cakravarti capability.
CHAKRA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Chakra Yoga = 7 grahas in the six odd houses (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11). The "discus/wheel" pattern confers Cakravarti (universal-emperor) capability, victory in all directions, king-of-kings fame, and reputation comparable to the eight directional guardians. One of the supreme Akriti yogas.
CHAKRA.general: Cakravarti capability, all-direction victory, king-of-kings fame, eight-direction-guardian reputation.

CHAMARA.name: Chamara — Lagna-lord exalted in kendra + Jupiter aspects Lagna.
CHAMARA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Chamara Yoga occurs when the Lagna-lord is placed in a kendra in its own or exalted sign, and is aspected by Jupiter. "Chamara" refers to the royal fly-whisk waved beside kings — the ancient symbol of sovereignty and state patronage. The native receives stellar reputation, immense wealth, longevity, and deep learning in sciences and scriptures. A highly refined combination for leadership and state honors.

CHANDRA_LAGNA_KENDRA_BENEFIC.name: Chandra-Lagna Kendra-Benefic — Moon in Lagna with benefics in quadrants from it. Magnetic charisma, public acclaim.
CHANDRA_LAGNA_KENDRA_BENEFIC.prose: Chandra-Lagna Kendra-Benefic — Based on Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra Chapter 34, Verse 15. This yoga is formed when the Moon resides in the 1st house (Lagna) and natural benefics occupy angular houses (kendras) from it. The emotional radiance of the Moon at the physical focal point, backed by supportive benefic pillars, grants the native immense personal charisma, public acclaim, and loyal companions.
CHANDRA_LAGNA_KENDRA_BENEFIC.relationships: Loyal and highly supportive friendships and networks

CHANDRA_MANGAL.name: Chandra-Mangal — Moon and Mars conjunct. Mind fused with action.
CHANDRA_MANGAL.prose:
Chandra-Mangal — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — Moon and Mars conjunct in any sign. Moon (mind-karaka) fused with Mars (energy-karaka) integrates imagination with action, producing the classical signature for entrepreneurial acumen and self-made wealth.

The native receives commercial drive, market-instinct, and decisive judgment under pressure. Modern interpretation rates this as one of the strongest "self-made wealth" indicators in the corpus. The flip side: Mars' aggression fused with Moon's emotional sensitivity can produce mental tension or impulsive emotional outbursts — wealth is robust, mental peace depends on benefic aspects.

CHANDRA_MANGAL_DHANA.name: Chandra-Maṅgala Dhana Yoga — full wealth-significator union per Phaladeepika 6.
CHANDRA_MANGAL_DHANA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Chandra-Maṅgala Dhana Yoga = full union of wealth-significators (Moon-Mars conjunction OR mutual aspect). Distinct from raja.yogas' RAJA_KARAKA_MOON_MARS (kendra-only). Confers abundant wealth, self-earned prosperity, bold business fame, and warrior-radiance. Among the foremost wealth yogas in the corpus.
CHANDRA_MANGAL_DHANA.general: Abundant wealth, self-earned prosperity, bold business, warrior radiance.

CHANDRA_TRIKONA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.name: Chandra-Trikona Benefic-Aspect — Moon in a trine aspected by a benefic. Emotional grace and maternal welfare.
CHANDRA_TRIKONA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.prose: Chandra-Trikona Benefic-Aspect — According to Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra Chapter 34, Verse 12. When the Moon occupies a trine (trikona: 1st, 5th, or 9th house) and receives a aspect from a natural benefic, this highly supportive yoga is activated. It aligns the native's emotional mind (manas) with dharma and creativity, bringing emotional stability, exceptional blessings from the mother, and a smooth rise in fortune.
CHANDRA_TRIKONA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.material: Gradual, highly protective rise in prosperity
CHANDRA_TRIKONA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.mind: Dharmic alignment of the mind, emotional tranquility
CHANDRA_TRIKONA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.relationships: Superb maternal connection, blessings from elders

CHANDRA_VIDYA_MOON_4_OWN_EXALT.name: Chandra-Vidya — Moon in 4th in own/exalted. Intuitive, emotionally-rooted learning.
CHANDRA_VIDYA_MOON_4_OWN_EXALT.prose:
Chandra-Vidya forms when the Moon — natural significator of mother (matr), mind (manas), and the 4th-house itself — occupies the 4th in own (Cancer), exalted (Taurus), or mooltrikona dignity. All three of the Moon's karaka-roles unify in this placement, producing an unusually pure expression of the 4th-bhava.

Learning happens through emotional resonance rather than logical analysis: the native absorbs material when it is felt as well as understood. Excellence emerges in literature, the arts, psychology, caregiving, poetry, and memory-dependent disciplines. Maternal welfare is exceptionally strong. Cancer (own-sign) tilts toward emotional-domestic learning; Taurus (exaltation) tilts toward aesthetic-sensual learning.

CHAPA.name: Chapa Yoga — 7 grahas in 10-11-12-1-2-3-4 sequentially per BPHS 36. Bow-like sharp action.
CHAPA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Chapa Yoga = 7 grahas spanning 10 through 4 (clockwise). The "bow" pattern confers sharp/projectile action, military or hunter temperament, multi-adversary success, and wealth growth. Like Ishu (the arrow) but with the bow itself — power-storage and aimed release.
CHAPA.general: Bow-like sharp action, military/hunter temperament, multi-adversary success, wealth growth.

CHAPA_PHALADEEPIKA.name: Chāpa Yoga (named-classical) — Mars-Jup-Ven in kendra-trikoṇa per Saravali 34.
CHAPA_PHALADEEPIKA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Chāpa-named-classical = Mars + Jupiter + Venus in kendras/trikoṇas in benefic placements. The bow-pattern (named-classical sense) confers archery-like strike capability, multi-adversary success, bold business, and military leadership. Distinct from nabhasha.yogas' CHAPA (pure 7-graha geometric Akriti); this is the named-classical specific-planet variant.
CHAPA_PHALADEEPIKA.general: Bow-like strike capability, multi-adversary success, bold business, military leadership.

CHATRA.name: Chatra Yoga — 7 grahas in 7th through 1st (clockwise) per BPHS 36. Royal-parasol protection.
CHATRA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Chatra Yoga = 7 grahas in 7-8-9-10-11-12-1 sequentially. The "royal-parasol" pattern confers king-like protection, royal-lineage connections, all-direction auspicious shade, and elevated royal standing. Often signature of those who enjoy institutional/family-name protection.
CHATRA.general: Royal-parasol protection, royal-lineage connections, all-direction auspicious cover, elevated royal standing.

CHATUSSAGARA.name: Chatussāgara Yoga — all planets in 4 kendras per Saravali 34. Four-ocean-encompassing might.
CHATUSSAGARA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Chatussāgara (four-oceans) Yoga = all planets confined to the four kendras (1, 4, 7, 10), none placed elsewhere. Confers four-ocean-encompassing prosperity (the four cardinal directions of life), eight-direction-guardian capability, and Cakravarti-like power. Among the supreme Raja-yogas in the corpus.
CHATUSSAGARA.general: Four-ocean prosperity, all-direction wealth, Cakravarti-like might, eight-guardian capability.

CHIRANJIVI_KENDRA_BENEFICS.name: Chiranjivi — benefics in kendra with strong Jupiter-Venus. Near-immortal life.
CHIRANJIVI_KENDRA_BENEFICS.prose: Chiranjivi Kendra-Benefics — Phaladeepika Ch.11 — natural benefics in kendras AND both Jupiter and Venus simultaneously strong (own/exalted/mooltrikona/friendly). Jupiter (longevity-karaka) and Venus (bhoga-karaka, life-sweetness) jointly empowered produce the classical "near-immortal" indicator. The yoga's name traces to its appearance in the charts of long-lived rishis in classical commentary. Indicates extraordinary span tilting toward 120 years with comfortable quality. No remedy required.

DAGDHA_RASHI_DOSHA.name: Dagdha Rashi Dosha — a graha in a sign burnt by the birth tithi. Scorched significations.
DAGDHA_RASHI_DOSHA.prose: Per Jyotirvidyabharanam (also in Muhurta Chintamani), each birth tithi "burns" two signs (e.g. Pratipada burns Libra & Capricorn; Shashthi burns Aries & Leo; Chaturdashi burns four). Any of the seven true grahas occupying a burnt (dagdha) sign has its significations scorched — the house it sits in and rules expresses weakly, with effort that resets. Remedy: propitiation of the lord of the burnt sign and Navagraha-shanti.
DAGDHA_RASHI_DOSHA.general: Diminished significations of the grahas in burnt signs; effort that resets.

DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_6_12.name: Dainya Parivartana 6-12 — debt and dissipation looped.
DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_6_12.prose:
Dainya Parivartana 6-12 — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — 6th-lord in 12th, 12th-lord in 6th. Enemy-disease karaka and expense-karaka exchange — disease-drains-income, expense-generates-conflict.

The native experiences long-term debt, chronic medical expenses, and disputes arising from foreign or hidden quarters. Building financial stability is structurally difficult — earnings dissolve into health-or-litigation expenditure. Remedy: pacification of both lords, Hanuman-upasana, dana-dharma.

DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_6_8.name: Dainya Parivartana 6-8 — chronic conflict and disease loop.
DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_6_8.prose:
Dainya Parivartana 6-8 — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — 6th-lord in 8th, 8th-lord in 6th. Mutual exchange between two dusthana-lords — distinct from Vipareeta-Raja, where ONE dusthana-lord goes into ANOTHER and produces protection. Here the EXCHANGE keeps both lords structurally trapped in dusthana relationship.

The native experiences chronic enemy-conflict, recurring health-crisis, and a sustained loop of litigation and debt. Doctrinal note: Vipareeta produces purification via one-direction transit; Dainya makes both dusthana-conditions permanent through reciprocal anchoring — chronic affliction rather than protection.

DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_8_12.name: Dainya Parivartana 8-12 — isolation, dissolution, hidden affairs.
DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_8_12.prose:
Dainya Parivartana 8-12 — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — 8th-lord in 12th, 12th-lord in 8th. Mortality-karaka and dissipation-karaka exchange — the two deepest dusthana significators interlocked.

The native experiences chronic isolation, hidden-affairs tendency, resource-dissolution, and family/social estrangement. Modern reading: "reclusive or institutional life" — life in monasteries, research institutes, hospitals, prisons, or foreign residence. Note: in spiritual/moksha-orientation contexts this same configuration can serve sadhana, supporting deep contemplative life rather than indicating affliction.

DAMA.name: Dama Yoga — 7 planets in 6 signs per BPHS 36. Showy nature, multi-faceted.
DAMA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Dama Yoga = 7 grahas in 6 signs. Native displays a showy/performative temperament (dama = rope/garland — sequential connection), multi-faceted activity, hierarchically-ordered conduct, and even wealth accumulation. Brihat Jataka 12 — life forms a "rope of beads" with each phase distinct yet linked.
DAMA.general: Showy temperament, multi-faceted activity, ordered conduct, even wealth gain.

DAMINI.name: Damini Yoga — 7 grahas in 10-11-12-1 per BPHS 36. Lightning-like radiance, sudden fame.
DAMINI.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Damini Yoga = 7 grahas in the celestial-zenith span of 10-11-12-1. The "lightning" pattern confers electric radiance, unexpected career fame, sudden honour, and dazzling personality. Common in those whose rise is meteoric and whose presence commands attention.
DAMINI.general: Lightning-like radiance, unexpected fame, sudden honour, dazzling personality.

DANDA.name: Daṇḍa Yoga (named-classical) — exalted Saturn in kendra/trikoṇa aspected by benefic per Saravali 34.
DANDA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Daṇḍa-named-classical = Saturn exalted/own-sign in kendras/trikoṇas, aspected by benefic. Distinct from nabhasha.yogas' DANDA Akriti (sequential 10-1 placement). The named-classical version confers daṇḍa-bearing-king-like ruling power, judicial conduct, long-term authority, and high-office stability.
DANDA.general: Ruling power, judicial conduct, long-term authority, high-office stability.

DANDA_AKRITI.name: Danda Yoga — 7 grahas in 10-11-12-1 sequentially per BPHS 36. Sceptre-like ruler.
DANDA_AKRITI.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Danda Yoga = 7 grahas spanning karma-lābha-vyaya-tanu sequentially (10-11-12-1). The "sceptre" pattern confers ruling-class karma, judicial conduct, and authoritative position. Sceptre-bearing-king-like personality. Common in judges, magistrates, and authority-figures whose office gives them disciplinary power.
DANDA_AKRITI.general: Ruling-class karma, judicial conduct, authoritative position, sceptre-bearer personality.

DARIDRA_11_12.name: Daridra 11-12 — 11th-lord in 12th house. Financial gains leak continuously into expenditure and loss.
DARIDRA_11_12.prose: Daridra 11-12 — 11th-lord in 12th — gains leak directly to expenses; accumulation structurally difficult. Foreign-income, charitable outflow, luxury-spending tendency. Remedy: 11th-lord pacification, budget-discipline.
DARIDRA_11_12.material: Foreign-income leaking to expense, no accumulation

DARIDRA_11_6.name: Daridra 11-6 — 11th-lord in 6th house. Gains restricted by debts, service-roles, and chronic opposition.
DARIDRA_11_6.prose: Daridra 11-6 — 11th-lord in 6th — binds gain-flow to enemy/debt/illness domain. Income tends to come through service-roles, medical or legal work, or sustained struggle against opposition. Frequent debt-rollovers, modest income offset by recurring expenses. Remedy: 11th-lord pacification, seva-dana.

DARIDRA_11_8.name: Daridra 11-8 — 11th-lord in 8th house. Financial flows tied to sudden transformations and volatile losses.
DARIDRA_11_8.prose: Daridra 11-8 — 11th-lord in 8th — binds gain to the sudden-loss/transformation house. Income often comes via unexpected sources or inheritance, but is equally vulnerable to sudden loss. Insurance, research, hidden-income domains feature. Remedy: 11th-lord pacification, Ganesha-upasana.
DARIDRA_11_8.material: Unexpected income offset by unexpected loss

DARIDRA_11_LORD_DEBIL_DUSTHANA.name: Daridra 11-Lord-Debil-Dusthana — 11th-lord debilitated AND in dusthana. Severe financial strain and failed ventures.
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DEBIL_DUSTHANA.prose: Daridra 11-Lord-Debil-Dusthana — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — The most severe classical financial affliction, occurring when the 11th-lord is simultaneously debilitated AND in a dusthana (6, 8, 12). With the gain-significator severely damaged, the native experiences chronic financial distress, recurrent business failures, and betrayal by trusted partners. Remedy: 11th-lord shanti, Brihat-Lakshmi homa, daily Shri-Sukta.
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DEBIL_DUSTHANA.material: Severe and chronic lack of income; investments repeatedly turning into losses; heavy debts
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DEBIL_DUSTHANA.mind: Constant high anxiety, feeling structurally trapped financially, loss of sleep
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DEBIL_DUSTHANA.relationships: Experiencing fraud or betrayal by close friends, business partners, or older siblings

DARIDRA_11_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Daridra 11-Lord-Dusthana — 11th-lord in dusthana. Obstruction of expected profits, bonuses, and social leverage.
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Daridra 11-Lord-Dusthana — BPHS Ch.34 — forms when the 11th-lord (labha-natha, gain-significator) occupies a dusthana. The gain-flow itself is wounded; expected income, social-network leverage, and project-completion all suffer. Remedy: 11th-lord pacification, Surya-upasana, conscious cultivation of mitra-satsanga.
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DUSTHANA.career: Projects stalling near the finish line, requiring massive compensatory effort
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DUSTHANA.material: Expected business revenues or increments failing to materialize on time
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DUSTHANA.relationships: Unreliable friendships, lack of social or community support

DARIDRA_2_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Daridra 2-Lord-Dusthana — 2nd-lord in dusthana. Financial accumulation severely obstructed; family-of-origin strain.
DARIDRA_2_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Daridra 2-Lord-Dusthana — BPHS Ch.34 — forms when the 2nd-lord (wealth-lord) occupies a dusthana (6, 8, 12). Because the significator of savings is wounded in hostile houses, the native struggles structurally with capital accumulation; income may arrive, but drains quickly. Clinical signs include chronic debt, family disputes, or speech challenges. Remedy: 2nd-lord pacification, Lakshmi-upasana, Thursday-vrata.
DARIDRA_2_LORD_DUSTHANA.relationships: Family-of-origin financial friction or property disputes

DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_6_LORD.name: Daridra — 2nd-lord conjunct 6th-lord. Wealth-flow directly bound to medical bills, litigation, and debt cycles.
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_6_LORD.prose: Daridra 2-Lord-with-6-Lord — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when the 2nd-lord and 6th-lord conjoin in any house. The wealth-significator fuses with the significator of debts and conflict, structurally binding income to medical bills, litigation costs, or chronic loan servicing. Remedy: Pacification of both lords, Hanuman-upasana, seva-dana.
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_6_LORD.career: Professional services marked by high effort and low financial return
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_6_LORD.material: Recurring expenditures on health, legal battles, or high interest loans
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_6_LORD.mind: Persistent financial worry and anxiety regarding career stability

DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_8_LORD.name: Daridra — 2nd-lord conjunct 8th-lord. Wealth exposed to sudden losses, unexpected accidents, and asset volatility.
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_8_LORD.prose: Daridra 2-Lord-with-8-Lord — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when the 2nd-lord and 8th-lord conjoin. The wealth-significator fuses with the sudden-loss/transformation significator, making savings highly volatile and vulnerable to sudden events like theft, accidents, or inheritance disputes. Remedy: Pacification of both lords, Ganesha-upasana, Guru-shanti.
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_8_LORD.material: Sudden financial shocks, theft, or heavy repair/accident costs
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_8_LORD.mind: Deep uncertainty regarding long-term financial survival and security
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_8_LORD.spirituality: Potential conversion to delayed gains via Vipareeta-Raja mechanisms

DARIDRA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Daridra 9-Lord-Dusthana — 9th-lord in dusthana. Hard work fails to convert to fortune; low parental/guru support.
DARIDRA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Daridra 9-Lord-Dusthana — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when the 9th-lord (bhagya-natha) occupies a dusthana. The fortune-significator is wounded; past-life merit fails to express as material wealth in the present life. Remedy: 9th-lord pacification, Guru-upasana, pitri-tarpana.
DARIDRA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA.material: Chronically poor luck, feeling that massive efforts yield very little result
DARIDRA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA.relationships: Strained relationship with the father or spiritual preceptors; lack of inheritance
DARIDRA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA.spirituality: Past-life merits blocked from materializing, feeling spiritually unsupported

DARIDRA_CHANDRA.name: Daridra (Moon) — Moon in dusthana. Emotional and material poverty.
DARIDRA_CHANDRA.prose:
Daridra-Chandra — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — Moon in dusthana (6th, 8th, or 12th) from Lagna. The manas-karaka in a wounded house signals both emotional and material poverty.

The native experiences sustained insecurity, chronic financial strain, maternal health concerns, and difficulty accumulating emotional reserves. Note the cancellation: Moon in Taurus (exalted) or Cancer (own-sign), even within a dusthana, neutralizes the yoga — own-house rescue applies at the dignity-level. Classical remedy: Chandra-Gayatri, Monday vrata, milk-dana, mother-service.

DARIDRA_DOSHA.name: Daridra Dosha — 2nd/11th lord weak/afflicted per Phaladeepika 6. Wealth-reduction.
DARIDRA_DOSHA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Daridra (poverty) Dosha = 2nd lord (wealth) or 11th lord (gains) weakly placed (in dusthana, combust, or with malefic conjunction). Confers wealth-reduction, sustained financial hardship, debt accumulation. The dosha-form parallel to daridra.yogas; this house-based reading specifies the lord-affliction trigger explicitly. Mitigated by lord-strength remediation (gemstone, mantra, charity).
DARIDRA_DOSHA.general: Wealth reduction, sustained financial hardship, debt accumulation tendency.

DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_12_DEBIL.name: Daridra — Lagna-lord in 12th house and debilitated. Wounded constitutional vitality triggers structural poverty.
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_12_DEBIL.prose: Daridra Lagna-Lord-12-Debil — Saravali Ch.40 (Daridra Anishta-Yoga) — forms when the Lagna-lord simultaneously occupies the 12th house AND sits in debilitated dignity. Both the self-axis and the constitutional vitality are wounded; this is structural rather than situational poverty. Remedy: Lagna-lord pacification, ishta-deva upasana, sustained personal tapas.
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_12_DEBIL.career: Severe struggles in foreign land; feeling alienated or isolated professionally
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_12_DEBIL.material: Structural, long-term difficulty in escaping debt; self-inflicted wealth drains
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_12_DEBIL.mind: Chronic lack of self-confidence, vital energy, and decision-making clarity

DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_WITH_12_LORD.name: Daridra — Lagna-lord conjunct 12th-lord. Native drives self-defeating expenditures; potential for spiritual path.
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_WITH_12_LORD.prose: Daridra Lagna-Lord-with-12-Lord — Saravali Ch.40 — forms when the Lagna-lord and 12th-lord conjoin in any house. The self-significator fuses with the expense/loss-significator, structurally orienting personal desire toward expenditure. Remedy: pacification of both lords, Gayatri-japa, meditation, budget-discipline.
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_WITH_12_LORD.material: Self-defeating expenditures, business errors driven by poor oversight, luxury drain
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_WITH_12_LORD.mind: Lack of practical financial self-discipline and budget boundary issues
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_WITH_12_LORD.spirituality: Can indicate a beautiful transition toward spiritual vairagya or monastic leanings

DARIDRA_LAKSHMI_BHANGA.name: Daridra Lakshmi-Bhanga — 11th house and Venus afflicted. Structural blockages in wealth flow and creative projects.
DARIDRA_LAKSHMI_BHANGA.prose: Daridra Lakshmi-Bhanga — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when the 11th house (labha-sthana) AND Venus (lakshmi-karaka) are simultaneously afflicted by malefic occupation or aspect. The lakshmi-flow itself is structurally obstructed. Remedy: Lakshmi-upasana, Shri-Sukta-patha, Friday-vrata, 11th-lord pacification.
DARIDRA_LAKSHMI_BHANGA.career: Creative or luxury-based business ventures repeatedly facing obstacles or collapse
DARIDRA_LAKSHMI_BHANGA.material: Chronically blocked financial channels, inability to generate passive or indirect income
DARIDRA_LAKSHMI_BHANGA.relationships: Lack of support from influential friends; social network yields no benefit

DARIDRA_MOON_SATURN_12.name: Daridra — Moon-Saturn conjunct in 12th. Emotional constriction coupled with chronic financial leakage and insomnia.
DARIDRA_MOON_SATURN_12.prose: Daridra Moon-Saturn-12 — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when the Moon and Saturn jointly occupy the 12th house. The Moon (manas-karaka) fuses with Saturn (chronic-restriction karaka) in the expense-house, producing a structural link between psychological constriction and financial leakage. Remedy: Moon-Saturn pacification, Monday/Saturday vrata, meditation practice.
DARIDRA_MOON_SATURN_12.material: Continuous, slow leakage of funds through hidden or foreign channels
DARIDRA_MOON_SATURN_12.mind: Severe sleep-disturbances, chronic anxiety regarding financial survival
DARIDRA_MOON_SATURN_12.relationships: Anxiety tied to maternal health issues or emotional isolation from family

DARIDRA_SARVA_MALEFIC_KENDRA.name: Daridra — all malefics in kendra houses. Core pillars of life (body, home, partner, career) uniformly obstructed.
DARIDRA_SARVA_MALEFIC_KENDRA.prose: Daridra Sarva-Malefic-Kendra — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when ALL natural malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu) occupy kendras (1, 4, 7, 10). Kendras are the foundation-pillars of personality; uniform malefic occupation wounds the structural foundation that financial advancement rests on. Remedy: Navagraha-shanti, Hanuman-upasana.
DARIDRA_SARVA_MALEFIC_KENDRA.career: Severe difficulties in stabilizing profession; frequent obstacles from authorities
DARIDRA_SARVA_MALEFIC_KENDRA.material: Compromised financial foundation; difficulty establishing long-term wealth assets
DARIDRA_SARVA_MALEFIC_KENDRA.mind: Constant feeling of being squeezed by domestic, relational, or career struggles

DARIDRA_TRIKA_LUMINARY.name: Daridra Trika-Luminary — Sun and Moon in 6/8/12. Depressed self-identity, low mental resilience, and health drains.
DARIDRA_TRIKA_LUMINARY.prose: Daridra Trika-Luminary — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when both luminaries — Sun (atma-karaka) and Moon (manas-karaka) — simultaneously occupy trika-houses (6, 8, 12). Both the self-significator and the mind-significator are wounded; foundational vitality and emotional resilience suffer together. Remedy: Surya-Chandra shanti, Sunday/Monday vrata, Gayatri-japa.
DARIDRA_TRIKA_LUMINARY.career: Struggle to build authority or long-term career recognition due to low self-belief
DARIDRA_TRIKA_LUMINARY.material: Unpredictable and recurring health-related expenses draining financial reserves
DARIDRA_TRIKA_LUMINARY.mind: Unstable self-esteem, psychological fatigue, vulnerability to emotional depression

DHANA_2_11_KENDRA.name: Dhana Yoga — 2nd and 11th lords in kendras. Auspicious integration of revenue generation and asset accumulation.
DHANA_2_11_KENDRA.prose:
Dhana Yoga — According to Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Chapter 40, Verse 5. This yoga manifests when both the 2nd lord (dhana-adhipati, the significator of accumulated wealth) and the 11th lord (labha-adhipati, the significator of gains and revenue) occupy angular houses (kendras: 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th). The simultaneous placement of the accumulation-significator and the gain-significator in the structural pillars of the horoscope creates a highly auspicious integration of cash inflow and capital retention.

The native is blessed with the twin virtues of continuous earning (the 11th lord's function) and successful preservation of assets (the 2nd lord's function), providing immunity from financial volatility. Doctrinal effects include commercial prosperity, diverse streams of income, and intergenerational family wealth. This yoga manifests with pronounced strength during the dasha or bhukti of the participating planetary lords.
DHANA_2_11_KENDRA.career: Exceptional commercial success and multi-source revenue generation
DHANA_2_11_KENDRA.material: Steady and sustained financial inflow coupled with excellent asset preservation
DHANA_2_11_KENDRA.mind: Long-term financial security, stability, and peace of mind

DHANA_5_9_KENDRA.name: Lakshmi Yoga — 5th and 9th lords in kendras. Supreme alignment of past-life merit, righteousness, and divine grace.
DHANA_5_9_KENDRA.prose:
Lakshmi Yoga — According to Phaladeepika, Chapter 6. This highly celebrated yoga occurs when the 5th lord (purva-punya-karaka, the significator of past-life merit) and the 9th lord (bhagya/dharma-karaka, the significator of supreme fortune and righteousness) are both situated in angular houses (kendras: 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th). Doctrinally, the convergence of the two supreme trine lords (representing Goddess Lakshmi) into the angular pillars of the chart (representing Lord Vishnu) channels the divine grace of Goddess Lakshmi directly into the native's destiny.

Regarded as the pinnacle of classical wealth yogas, it yields prosperity arising from accumulated past-life virtue, dharmic acquisition of wealth, and a constant flow of auspicious opportunities. The effects transcend material assets, encompassing exceptional quality of life, profound public honor, noble character, and lifelong good fortune. Royal-tier affluence or a highly prominent public position is standard under this configuration, manifesting strongly during the dasha or bhukti of the involved lords.
DHANA_5_9_KENDRA.material: Royal-tier prosperity, abundant resources, and sustained high quality of life
DHANA_5_9_KENDRA.relationships: Exceptional public honor, noble social circle, and lifelong auspicious fortune
DHANA_5_9_KENDRA.spirituality: Direct grace of Goddess Lakshmi, spiritual elevation, and manifestation of past-life merit

DHANA_JUPITER_2_5.name: Dhana Yoga — Benefic Jupiter in 2nd or 5th house. Divine wisdom and ethical grace yielding progressive prosperity.
DHANA_JUPITER_2_5.prose:
Dhana Jupiter in 2nd or 5th House — According to Jataka Parijata, Chapter 5. This auspicious yoga is formed when Jupiter (Guru), the supreme natural significator (karaka) of wealth, wisdom, and expansion, occupies either the 2nd house (dhana-bhava, accumulation) or the 5th house (purva-punya-bhava, intellect and past-life merit). Jupiter's presence as the significator of the house itself stabilizes the financial core of the native—granting access to intergenerational inheritance and family wealth in the 2nd house, or fostering intellect-driven prosperity in the 5th house.

The native experiences progressive, long-term financial growth characterized by ethical means and dharmic discipline rather than aggressive or high-risk speculation. Significant financial success is achieved through intellectual pursuits, higher education, advisory roles, teaching, or financial consultancy. This yoga yields its most stable and rewarding fruits during the major or sub-periods of Jupiter.
DHANA_JUPITER_2_5.career: Distinction in advisory, educational, judicial, or financial consultancy services
DHANA_JUPITER_2_5.material: Sustained wealth accumulation, access to ancestral estates, and stable assets
DHANA_JUPITER_2_5.spirituality: Grace of Guru, ethical wisdom, and activation of past-life meritorious karma

DHANA_PARIVARTANA_1_2.name: Dhana Parivartana — Lagna and 2nd lords exchange signs. Auspicious synthesis of identity and accumulated assets.
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_1_2.prose:
Dhana Parivartana Yoga (1st & 2nd Lords Exchange) — Doctrinally anchored in Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Chapter 40. This exceptional configuration occurs when the Lagna lord (representing self-identity, constitution, and fame) and the 2nd lord (representing accumulated wealth, family assets, and speech) undergo a mutual exchange of signs (parivartana). This profound connection fuses the core identity of the native directly with their financial destiny, making them an active embodiment of prosperity.

The native and wealth operate in a symbiotic, closed loop—the native's unique personal aptitude, credibility, and brand directly magnetize prosperity, making financial opportunities seek them out rather than require aggressive outward pursuit. Doctrinal traits include an influential personal brand, an innate capacity for asset accumulation, and a seamless stewardship of family or inherited estates. Unlike the transaction-heavy 2nd-11th exchange, this yoga is strictly identity-centered, meaning that income flow is anchored to the native's individual skills, speech, and reputation. It registers its peak development during the major/sub-periods of the participating planetary lords.
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_1_2.career: Stellar reputation-based income, organic growth of personal brand, and distinguished status
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_1_2.material: Highly personalized wealth creation, robust bank reserves, and inherited asset stewardship
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_1_2.mind: Unification of personal dignity and material abundance, high self-esteem

DHANA_PARIVARTANA_2_11.name: Dhana Parivartana — 2nd and 11th lords exchange signs. Supreme compounding integration of revenue and reserves.
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_2_11.prose:
Dhana Parivartana Yoga (2nd & 11th Lords Exchange) — Doctrinally based on Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Chapter 40. This highly potent yoga is formed when the 2nd lord (dhana-adhipati) resides in the 11th house, and the 11th lord (labha-adhipati) simultaneously resides in the 2nd house. In classical Vedic astrology, mutual sign exchanges (parivartanas) represent the most dynamic class of planetary combinations, and this specific variant directly fuses the house of accumulated assets (2nd) with the house of incoming revenue (11th).

The native experiences a perfectly integrated financial cycle: every unit of income is immediately retained and capitalized, while the accumulated capital itself actively generates further diverse streams of revenue. This creates an unshakeable commercial structure, exceptionally suited for large-scale entrepreneurship, corporate ventures, and compounding generational wealth. Compared to other wealth configurations, this yoga is strictly and powerfully focused on transactional and compounding financial abundance. Manifests with spectacular force during the major/sub-periods of the participating lords.
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_2_11.career: Vast commercial expansion, supreme entrepreneurial milestones, and market dominance
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_2_11.material: Compounding cash flow, perfect integration of revenue and reserves
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_2_11.mind: Unparalleled financial security and strategic peace of mind

DHANA_VENUS_2.name: Dhana Yoga — Aesthetic Venus in 2nd house. Material prosperity arising from artistic design, luxury, and elegance.
DHANA_VENUS_2.prose:
Dhana Venus in 2nd House — Doctrinally based on Saravali, Chapter 21. This yoga is formed when Venus (Shukra), the natural significator of beauty, luxury, artistic refinement, and conjugal bliss, is placed in the 2nd house (dhana-bhava). Venus's artistic and bhoga-karaka (enjoyment) properties projected onto the house of accumulated wealth channel financial prosperity through creative, sensory, and aesthetic industries.

The native gains wealth through active participation in design, visual arts, luxury merchandise, high fashion, gastronomy, or diplomacy. Furthermore, this placement is a classical indicator of conjugal prosperity, where marriage serves as a major turning point, initiating a dramatic upward trajectory in the native's net worth and bringing shared material prosperity through the spouse. Manifests prominently during Venusian planetary cycles.
DHANA_VENUS_2.career: Illustrious success in fine arts, fashion design, cosmetics, hospitality, or luxury trade
DHANA_VENUS_2.material: Luxury-tier wealth, high-end real estate, fine vehicles, and rare artifacts
DHANA_VENUS_2.relationships: Conjugal prosperity, financial empowerment through marriage, and a supportive spouse

DHENU.name: Dhenu Yoga — Moon in 2nd aspected by benefic per Phaladeepika 6. Kāmadhenu-like wealth.
DHENU.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Dhenu Yoga = Moon in 2nd house aspected by benefic. Confers Kāmadhenu (wish-fulfilling-cow) like wealth, abundant prosperity, cattle-wealth (in agrarian classical context), family support, and aptitude for dairy/agricultural work. The name signals continuous wealth-flow like milk from the celestial cow.
DHENU.general: Kāmadhenu-like wealth, abundant prosperity, cattle/dairy wealth, family support, agricultural aptitude.

DHWAJA.name: Dhwaja Yoga — 2nd + 11th lords in kendra with benefics. Flag-like fame per Phaladeepika 6.
DHWAJA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Dhwaja Yoga arises when the 2nd and 11th lords occupy a kendra alongside natural benefics. The native's fame stands "like a flag" (dhwaja) — visible to all, stable, wealth-anchored. A reputational Raja-yoga particularly powerful for those whose public visibility itself becomes their fortune.
DHWAJA.general: Flag-like fame, stable wealth-fame, public visibility, elevated standing.

DURUDHARA.name: Durudhara Yoga — Planets in both the 2nd and 12th houses from the Moon. Comprehensive life support and balance.
DURUDHARA.prose: Durudhara Yoga — As explained in Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 6. This yoga is formed when planets (excluding the Sun and nodes) occupy both the 2nd and 12th houses from the Moon. This is the synthesis of both Sunapha and Anapha. The mind (Moon) is beautifully balanced and supported from both sides, granting the native wealth, social status, domestic peace, and emotional maturity.
DURUDHARA.material: Perfect synthesis of self-made and inherited wealth
DURUDHARA.mind: Superb emotional equilibrium, comprehensive mental security

DURUDHURA_STRICT.name: Durudhura (strict) — benefics on BOTH sides of Moon. Supreme Moon-axis.
DURUDHURA_STRICT.prose:
Durudhura (strict-form) — Brihat Jataka 13.6 — benefics in BOTH the 2nd AND 12th from the Moon. Among the three Moon-axis yogas (Sunapha, Anapha, Durudhura), the strict-Durudhura is the supreme tier — manas-karaka benefically protected on both sides simultaneously.

The native receives both pure earned wealth (right-side benefic) AND pure inherited refinement (left-side benefic) at once. Doctrinally the structural opposite of Kemadruma — comprehensive support and integrated prosperity. Modern reading: charts of cultivated heirs of historic wealth-lineage often display this.

DUR_BHAGYA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA_DEBIL.name: Dur-Bhagya — 9th-lord in dusthana or debilitated. Divine grace and fortune heavily obstructed; paternal stress.
DUR_BHAGYA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA_DEBIL.prose: Dur-Bhagya 9-Lord-Dusthana-Debil — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when the 9th-lord (bhagya-natha) occupies a dusthana (6, 8, 12) or sits in debilitated dignity. The fortune-significator itself is wounded, so the karaka-domain — luck cycles, paternal welfare, dharmic alignment, long-distance ventures — operates under chronic obstruction. Remedy: Surya-Guru upasana, Gayatri-japa, pitri-tarpana.
DUR_BHAGYA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA_DEBIL.career: Effort-reward mismatch, obstacles in long-distance ventures

DUR_BHAGYA_JUPITER_DEBIL_LAGNA_OR_9.name: Dur-Bhagya — debilitated Jupiter in Lagna or 9th house. Wisdom axis compromised; poor judgment and advisory risks.
DUR_BHAGYA_JUPITER_DEBIL_LAGNA_OR_9.prose: Dur-Bhagya Jupiter-Debil-Lagna-or-9 — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when Jupiter occupies its debilitation sign (Capricorn) in either the Lagna or the 9th house. Jupiter is the supreme dharma-karaka and bhagya-karaka simultaneously; debilitation in the body-house or fortune-house wounds the wisdom-axis itself. Remedy: Guru-Gayatri, Brihaspati-shanti, satsanga with authentic teachers.
