DUR_BHAGYA_RAHU_9.name: Dur-Bhagya — Rahu in 9th house. Destabilized fortune-trajectory, ethical compromises, and foreign travel obstacles.
DUR_BHAGYA_RAHU_9.prose: Dur-Bhagya Rahu-9 — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when Rahu occupies the 9th house. Rahu casts shadow on the dharma-bhava: traditional religion, guru-lineage, and paternal heritage become destabilized. The native often rejects the inherited dharmic path and pursues unconventional fortune-trajectories. Remedy: Rahu-shanti, Saraswati-upasana, careful re-evaluation of guru-relationships.

DUR_BHAGYA_SUN_KETU_9.name: Dur-Bhagya — Sun and Ketu in 9th house. Severe Pitru-dosha signatures; detached spiritual paths and legacy disputes.
DUR_BHAGYA_SUN_KETU_9.prose: Dur-Bhagya Sun-Ketu-9 — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when the Sun and Ketu jointly occupy the 9th house. The Sun is the pitru-karaka (paternal-significator); Ketu is the moksha-karaka but functions as a malefic in mundane houses. Their conjunction in the dharma-house produces a classical pitru-dosha indication along with detachment from ancestral religion. Remedy: pitri-tarpana, Gaya-shraddha, Surya-namaskara, Surya-Ketu shanti homa.

DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Dur-Karma — 10th-lord in dusthana. Career stagnation, demotion risks, and strained relations with authorities.
DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Dur-Karma 10-Lord-Dusthana — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when the 10th-lord (karma-natha) occupies a dusthana (6, 8, 12). The career-significator itself is wounded; professional advancement, public reputation, and authority-relations all operate under chronic obstruction. Remedy: Surya-Shani-shanti, karma-anusthana, guru-kripa upasana.
DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_DUSTHANA.career: Career stagnation, frequent job changes, demotion-risk

DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_NEECHA_RETRO.name: Dur-Karma — 10th-lord debilitated AND retrograde. Inverted professional outcomes and career-path disruptions.
DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_NEECHA_RETRO.prose: Dur-Karma 10-Lord-Neecha-Retro — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when the 10th-lord is simultaneously debilitated AND retrograde. Debility weakens karma-skill; retrograde motion inverts the result-direction so plans backfire and intent contradicts outcome. Remedy: 10th-lord pacification, Sun-Saturn-Jupiter (trigraha) upasana, patient karma.
DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_NEECHA_RETRO.career: Plans yielding inverse results, recursive struggle

DUR_KARMA_SATURN_RAHU_10.name: Dur-Karma — Saturn and Rahu in 10th. Severe career delays, intense office politics, and sudden reputation shocks.
DUR_KARMA_SATURN_RAHU_10.prose: Dur-Karma Saturn-Rahu-10 — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when Saturn and Rahu jointly occupy the 10th house. Saturn is the slow-attrition karaka; Rahu is the unexpected-shadow karaka. The two cruel grahas in the karma-house attack career through the most difficult possible combination: chronic delay (Saturn) compounded by sudden disruption (Rahu). Remedy: Shani-Rahu-shanti, Hanuman-upasana, sustained tapas-karma.

DUR_KARMA_SUN_DEBIL_10.name: Dur-Karma — debilitated Sun in 10th house. Severe authority-deficit, governmental obstacles, and paternal friction.
DUR_KARMA_SUN_DEBIL_10.prose: Dur-Karma Sun-Debil-10 — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when the Sun occupies its debilitation sign (Libra) in the 10th house. The Sun is the supreme karma-karaka; debilitation in the karma-house itself is the classical worst-case configuration for career and authority. Remedy: Surya-namaskara, Gayatri-japa, Aditya-Hridaya-stotra, copper-dana.

DUR_PUTRA_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Dur-Putra — 5th-lord in dusthana. Obstructed progeny, conception difficulties, and lack of past-life merits.
DUR_PUTRA_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Dur-Putra 5-Lord-Dusthana — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when the 5th-lord (putra-natha) occupies a dusthana (6, 8, 12). The progeny-significator is wounded; children, intellect, and purva-punya — all three 5th-bhava karaka-domains — operate under obstruction. Remedy: Guru-shanti, Santana-Gopala stotra, merit-amplifying charity.
DUR_PUTRA_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.spirituality: Past-life merit deficit in this domain

DUR_PUTRA_JUPITER_KETU_5.name: Dur-Putra — Jupiter and Ketu in 5th. Progeny significator under eclipse shadow; detachments and conception challenges.
DUR_PUTRA_JUPITER_KETU_5.prose: Dur-Putra Jupiter-Ketu-5 — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when Jupiter (putra-karaka) and Ketu (moksha-karaka) jointly occupy the 5th house. Ketu casts shadow on Jupiter; the progeny-significator falls into vairagya-shadow within the very house it should empower. Remedy: Guru-Gayatri, Santana-Gopala upasana, Ketu-shanti, Brihaspati-homa.

DUR_SAHAJA_3_HEMMED_MALEFICS.name: Dur-Sahaja — 3rd house hemmed by malefics. Domestic environment dampens personal initiative and sibling bonds.
DUR_SAHAJA_3_HEMMED_MALEFICS.prose: Dur-Sahaja 3-Hemmed-Malefics — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when malefics simultaneously occupy the 2nd AND 4th houses, creating papa-kartari around the 3rd. The initiative-house is squeezed by hostile flanking influences. Remedy: amplify the 3rd-lord, Mangal-shanti, propitiate the malefics in 2 and 4.

DUR_SAHAJA_3_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Dur-Sahaja — 3rd-lord in dusthana. Wounded initiative, low physical courage, and sibling welfare strain.
DUR_SAHAJA_3_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Dur-Sahaja 3-Lord-Dusthana — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when the 3rd-lord (sahaja-natha) occupies a dusthana (6, 8, 12). The initiative-significator is wounded; courage, sibling welfare, communication, and short-journey domains all operate under obstruction. Remedy: Mangal-shanti, Hanuman-upasana, courage-amplifying tapas.

DUR_SAHAJA_MARS_DEBIL_3.name: Dur-Sahaja — Mars debilitated in 3rd house. Wounded parakrama-karaka; lack of athletic drive and sibling friction.
DUR_SAHAJA_MARS_DEBIL_3.prose: Dur-Sahaja Mars-Debil-3 — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when Mars occupies its debilitation sign (Cancer) in the 3rd house. Mars is parakrama-karaka and the natural ruler of the 3rd; debility in its own karaka-house wounds courage from its own seat. Remedy: Mangal-shanti, Subrahmanya-upasana, Hanuman-Chalisa.
DUR_SAHAJA_MARS_DEBIL_3.mind: Lack of courage, inability to release grudges

DUR_SAMBANDHA_7_HEMMED_MALEFICS.name: Dur-Sambandha — 7th house hemmed by malefics. Relational papa-kartari triggers constant friction and partner hostility.
DUR_SAMBANDHA_7_HEMMED_MALEFICS.prose: Dur-Sambandha 7-Hemmed-Malefics — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu, wounded Moon) simultaneously occupy the 6th AND 8th houses, creating a papa-kartari yoga around the 7th. The partnership-house is squeezed from both sides by hostile influences. Remedy: amplify the 7th-lord, Shukra-Guru shanti.

DUR_SAMBANDHA_7_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Dur-Sambandha — 7th-lord in dusthana. Chronic delay or instability in marriage; business partnership vulnerabilities.
DUR_SAMBANDHA_7_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Dur-Sambandha 7-Lord-Dusthana — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when the 7th-lord (sambandha-natha) occupies a dusthana (6, 8, 12). The relationship-significator itself is wounded; partnership domains — marriage, trade alliances, business partnerships — operate under chronic obstruction. Remedy: Shukra-Gayatri, Swayamvara-puja, charitable acts on Bharani/Purvaphalguni nakshatras.

DUR_SAMBANDHA_MARS_VENUS_AXIS.name: Dur-Sambandha — Mars-Venus on 1-7 axis. Intense Kuja-dosha; severe marital friction, anger, and relational tension.
DUR_SAMBANDHA_MARS_VENUS_AXIS.prose: Dur-Sambandha Mars-Venus-Axis — Phaladeepika Ch.12, kuja-dosha sub-class — forms when Mars occupies the Lagna AND Venus occupies the 7th (or vice-versa). Mars is the aggression-karaka; Venus is the soft love-and-comfort karaka. Their direct opposition along the body-partner axis creates structural marital strife. Remedy: Mangal-shanti, Hanuman-Chalisa, kuja-dosha-nivritti vrata.

DUR_SAMBANDHA_VENUS_DEBIL_OR_DUSTHANA.name: Dur-Sambandha — Venus debilitated or in dusthana. Afflicted love-karaka; relationship discord and aesthetic setbacks.
DUR_SAMBANDHA_VENUS_DEBIL_OR_DUSTHANA.prose: Dur-Sambandha Venus-Debil-or-Dusthana — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when Venus occupies its debilitation sign (Virgo) or any dusthana (6, 8, 12). Venus is simultaneously kama-karaka, kala-karaka, and vivaha-karaka; debility in any of these contexts wounds the love-aesthetic-marriage axis at its source. Remedy: Shukra-Gayatri, Lakshmi-upasana, Friday vrata.

DUR_VIDYA_5_HEMMED_MALEFICS.name: Dur-Vidya — 5th house hemmed by malefics. Obstruction in formal education, creative blocks, and progeny-related stress.
DUR_VIDYA_5_HEMMED_MALEFICS.prose: Dur-Vidya 5-Hemmed-Malefics — Phaladeepika Ch.12 — forms when malefics simultaneously occupy the 4th AND 6th houses, creating papa-kartari around the 5th. The education-and-merit house is squeezed. Remedy: amplify the 5th-lord, Guru-shanti, propitiate malefics in 4 and 6.

DUSTHANA_LORD_LAGNA_6.name: Arishta Dusthana-6-Lord-Lagna — 6th-lord in Lagna. Body vulnerable to illness, but high healing/service aptitude.
DUSTHANA_LORD_LAGNA_6.prose: Arishta Dusthana-6-Lord-Lagna — 6th-lord in 1st binds the enemy/illness-significator to the body-house. Bodily weakness, chronic health-issues, recurring infections. Compensating: strong service-tendency, medical/healing aptitude. Remedy: 6th-lord pacification, seva-dana.

DUSTHANA_LORD_LAGNA_8.name: Arishta Dusthana-8-Lord-Lagna — 8th-lord in Lagna. Childhood crises, health vulnerabilities, but crisis management.
DUSTHANA_LORD_LAGNA_8.prose: Arishta Dusthana-8-Lord-Lagna — 8th-lord in 1st binds mortality-significator to body. Classical alpa-ayu (short-life) indication or childhood-crisis risk; transformation-aptitude, research and crisis-management capacity strong. Remedy: 8th-lord pacification, Mahamrityunjaya-japa.

ECLIPSE_DOSHA.name: Eclipse Dosha (panchanga sense) — birth during solar/lunar eclipse window per traditional sources.
ECLIPSE_DOSHA.prose: Per traditional/BPHS-aligned classical sources, Eclipse Dosha (panchanga form) = birth during a solar or lunar eclipse window. Distinct from the planetary GRAHAN_DOSHA (Sun/Moon conjunct Rahu/Ketu — natal-chart structural). This panchanga form covers the actual eclipse-day birth event, classically among the most-marked panchanga doshas. Confers radiance-loss patterns, deep karmic challenges, and past-life-karma sensitivity. Remediation: eclipse-time japa/snāna/dāna ritual.
ECLIPSE_DOSHA.general: Radiance-loss patterns, deep karmic challenges, past-life-karma sensitivity.

GADA.name: Gada Yoga — 7 grahas in 2 kendras (1-4 or 1-7) per BPHS 36. Wealth + speech-power.
GADA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36 (Akriti group), Gada Yoga = all 7 grahas in two adjacent kendras (typically 1st-4th or 1st-7th). The "mace" pattern confers strike-power, abundant wealth, and effective speech (siddha-vāk). Common in those whose words/decrees carry weight.
GADA.general: Abundant wealth, effective speech, strike-power, mantra-mastery.

GADA_4_7.name: Gada Yoga (4-7) — 7 grahas in 4th + 7th kendras per BPHS 36. Home-spouse focused.
GADA_4_7.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, the 4-7 variant of Gada Yoga = all 7 grahas in the 4th and 7th kendras specifically. Confers home-spouse-fused fruit: wealth and reputation centred on domestic life and partnership. A specialised flavour of Gada Yoga — same Akriti shape, different bhava-emphasis.
GADA_4_7.general: Home-spouse wealth, mother-partner synergy, domesticity-centred fame.

GAJA_KESARI.name: Gaja-Kesari Yoga — Jupiter in a quadrant (kendra) from the Moon. Highly auspicious lunar-jupiter configuration.
GAJA_KESARI.prose: Gaja-Kesari Yoga — According to Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra Chapter 34 and Phaladeepika Chapter 6, Verse 9. When Jupiter is situated in an angular house (kendra: 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Moon, this highly auspicious configuration is formed. The mutual association between the significator of mind (Moon) and the significator of wisdom (Jupiter) grants the native the combined majesty of an elephant (gaja) and the courage of a lion (kesari). The native is blessed with exceptional intellect, righteous fame, longevity, and distinguished teaching or advisory abilities.

GAJA_KESARI_BHANGA.name: Gajakesari Bhanga — Debilitated or retrograde Jupiter in kendra from the Moon. Flawed or obstructed yoga.
GAJA_KESARI_BHANGA.prose: Gajakesari Bhanga — Reference Phaladeepika Chapter 6, Verse 11. This occurs when the basic criteria for Gajakesari are met, but Jupiter is debilitated in Capricorn or is in a state of retrogression. The auspicious results are severely compromised or delayed. The native possesses potential but suffers from self-doubt, delays in recognition, and friction with mentors. Classical remedies include reciting the Guru Gayatri mantra and performing Brihaspati Homa.
GAJA_KESARI_BHANGA.spirituality: Periodic crisis of faith, friction with mentors

GAJA_KESARI_EXALTED.name: Gajakesari Supreme — Exalted Jupiter in a quadrant (kendra) from the Moon.
GAJA_KESARI_EXALTED.prose: Gajakesari Supreme — Under Phaladeepika Chapter 6, Verse 10. This apex variant of Gajakesari Yoga occurs when Jupiter is not only in a quadrant (kendra) from the Moon but also placed in its sign of exaltation (Cancer). This represents the highest manifestation of the Moon-Jupiter association. The native is endowed with supreme intellectual eminence, noble status, absolute integrity, and authoritative wisdom. It is a signature for chief justices, distinguished educators, and legendary philosophers.

GAJA_KESARI_OWN_SIGN.name: Gajakesari Own-Sign — Jupiter placed in its own sign (Sagittarius or Pisces) in a quadrant from the Moon.
GAJA_KESARI_OWN_SIGN.prose: Gajakesari Own-Sign — Based on Saravali Chapter 18. This variant is formed when Jupiter is in a quadrant (kendra) from the Moon and occupies its own signs (Sagittarius or Pisces). While less dramatic than the exalted variant, it represents a highly stable, durable, and traditional manifestation of Gajakesari. The native is blessed with lasting wisdom, traditional knowledge, deep-rooted ethical principles, and stable wealth that spans generations.

GANA_DOSHA.name: Gana Dosha — gana mismatch (deva/manuṣya/rākṣasa) per Muhurta Chintamani 6.
GANA_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi Ch.6, Gaṇa Koot scores 6/6 when the bride/groom nakshatras share the same gaṇa (deva, manuṣya, or rākṣasa); partial when one is deva and the other manuṣya; severe failure on rākṣasa-deva pairing. Confers temperament conflicts, lifestyle-conduct mismatches, and cultural/upbringing differences. Classical mitigation: Moon-lord friendship between bride/groom Moon-signs.
GANA_DOSHA.general: Temperament conflicts, lifestyle-conduct mismatch, cultural difference, daily friction.

GANDANTA_DOSHA.name: Gandanta Dosha — planet at water-fire sign junction per BPHS 6. Death-like transition.
GANDANTA_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.6, Gandanta Dosha = Moon (or another graha) at the longitude junction between water and fire signs (Cancer-Leo, Scorpio-Sagittarius, Pisces-Aries — last 30' of water + first 30' of fire). The "knot-end" name signals death-like transition. Confers transition-period crises (illness, parental danger, sudden upheavals), with severity by pāda. The most position-specific panchanga dosha. Classical remedy: 27-day Gaṇḍānta-śānti.
GANDANTA_DOSHA.general: Death-like transition crisis, health danger, parental crisis risk.

GAURI.name: Gaurī Yoga — Moon's navāṃśa-lord in kendra aspected by Moon per Saravali 34. Family bliss.
GAURI.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Gaurī Yoga = the lord of Moon's navāṃśa sign placed in a kendra and aspected by Moon. Confers progeny+spouse happiness, a Gauri-like (Pārvatī-like = beautiful, virtuous) spouse, domestic peace, and dharmic householder disposition. The yoga's name evokes auspicious-feminine grace.
GAURI.general: Progeny-spouse happiness, beautiful virtuous spouse, domestic peace, dharmic householder.

GOLA.name: Gola Yoga — all 7 planets in 1 sign per BPHS 36. Hyper-focused, narrow-visioned temperament.
GOLA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36 (Sankhya group), Gola Yoga = all seven classical grahas occupying a single sign. Extremely rare. Confers hyper-focused obsession with one direction of life, intense temperament, single-mindedness, but classical commentaries call it "andha-gola" (blind-ball) — the narrowness can manifest as restricted perspective. Brihat Jataka 12 — favours specialists/monomaniacs over generalists.
GOLA.general: Extreme focus, narrow vision, single-direction commitment, intense temperament.

GRAHAN_DOSHA.name: Grahaṇa Dosha — Sun/Moon conjunct Rahu/Ketu per BPHS 83. Eclipse-like affliction.
GRAHAN_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.83, Grahaṇa Dosha = Sun OR Moon conjunct Rahu OR Ketu. Confers eclipse-like luminosity loss, mother/father-health concerns, mental instability, and progeny-related karmic challenges. The conjoined luminary loses its outward radiance to the shadow planet. Classical interpretation: past-life karma needing resolution.
GRAHAN_DOSHA.general: Eclipse-like radiance-loss, parental-health concerns, mental instability, progeny challenges.

GRAHAN_MOON_KETU.name: Grahan Moon-Ketu — south-node lunar imprint. Mind toward detachment.
GRAHAN_MOON_KETU.prose:
Grahan Moon-Ketu — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — Moon conjunct the south-node imprints vairagya-shadow on manas-karaka. Where Rahu-conjunction brings anxiety, Ketu-conjunction pulls toward introversion and detachment.

Clinical signature: preference for solitude, social withdrawal, sudden ascetic impulses, deep meditative experiences, or unexpected desire to renounce. Note: in spiritual/moksha-oriented life-paths this same configuration is sadhana-supporting — manas-karaka unified with moksha-karaka grants natural depth in dhyana and vairagya. Remedy (where needed): Chandra-Gayatri, Ketu-shanti, meditation.

GRAHAN_MOON_RAHU.name: Grahan Moon-Rahu — lunar eclipse imprint. Manas-karaka shadowed.
GRAHAN_MOON_RAHU.prose:
Grahan Moon-Rahu — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — Moon conjunct Rahu imprints a lunar-eclipse signature. The Moon is manas-karaka and matr-karaka; Rahu's shadow wounds both emotional stability and maternal welfare.

Clinical signature: chronic anxiety, insomnia, sudden emotional shocks, maternal health-stress, unstable mood-states, and intuition-distortion tendency. Modern reading: depression / anxiety-disorder indicator. Classical remedy: Chandra-Gayatri, Monday vrata, mother-service, Rahu-shanti, meditation practice.

GRAHAN_SUN_RAHU.name: Grahan Sun-Rahu — solar eclipse imprint. Atma-karaka shadowed.
GRAHAN_SUN_RAHU.prose:
Grahan Sun-Rahu — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — Sun conjunct Rahu in the natal chart imprints a permanent solar-eclipse signature. The Sun is atma-karaka and pitru-karaka; Rahu casts shadow over both, wounding self-image and paternal identity simultaneously.

Clinical signature: confidence-shocks, paternal stress or premature paternal loss, government/administrative legal-issues, ego-versus-shadow internal conflict. Co-detected with `GRAHAN_DOSHA`. Classical remedy: Surya-Gayatri, Aditya-Hridaya-stotra, Rahu-shanti, copper-dana, grahan-shanti-homa.

GURU_BHAGYA_JUPITER_9.name: Guru-Bhagya — Jupiter in 9th. Dharmic fortune through teachers and grace.
GURU_BHAGYA_JUPITER_9.prose:
Guru-Bhagya is the Jupiter-led variant of Bhagya yogas — doctrinally regarded as the most auspicious of the seven, since Jupiter is both the natural dharma-karaka AND the natural fortune-signifier, and the 9th house is itself the dharma-bhava. The triple-resonance (Jupiter + dharma-karaka + dharma-bhava) creates a uniquely concentrated bhagya-stream.

Classical commentary describes these natives as recipients of effortless dharmic fortune — they meet the right teachers at the right time, religious and scriptural studies come to them with ease, divine grace appears in unexpected ways, and a sense of being "carried" by larger forces is characteristic. Career inclinations include teaching (especially philosophical/spiritual), counseling, religious vocations, and roles where wisdom-transmission is the work.

**Cancellation.** The yoga is cancelled when Jupiter is debilitated (Capricorn) — the dignity-defect undoes the karaka-bhava compounding.
GURU_BHAGYA_JUPITER_9.career: Spiritual/philosophical teaching, religious counseling, dharma-guru roles
GURU_BHAGYA_JUPITER_9.spirituality: Effortless guru-encounter; divine grace; ease in scriptural study
GURU_BHAGYA_JUPITER_9.wealth: Resources flowing from past-life merit; opportunity-timing favors dharmic work

GURU_CHANDAL.name: Guru-Chāṇḍāla Dosha — Jupiter-Rahu conjunction per BPHS 82. Dharmic confusion.
GURU_CHANDAL.prose: Per BPHS Ch.82, Guru-Chāṇḍāla Dosha = Jupiter conjunct or aspected by Rahu. Confers dharmic confusion, conflict with traditional teachers/family doctrine, anti-dharmic tendencies, and past-life karma of guru-disrespect. Native may oscillate between rebellion against and reconciliation with received tradition. Classical remedies: Guru-mantra recitation, Bṛhaspati-vrata (Thursday fasting).
GURU_CHANDAL.general: Dharmic confusion, teacher-tradition conflict, anti-dharmic tendencies, past-life guru-disrespect.

GURU_MANGAL.name: Guru-Mangal — Jupiter+Mars conjunct. Wisdom fused with action.
GURU_MANGAL.prose:
Guru-Mangal — Saravali Ch.34 — Jupiter and Mars conjunct in any house. Two strong grahas combining: Jupiter (dharma/wisdom-karaka) fuses with Mars (energy/parakrama-karaka), producing dharma-based leadership capacity.

The native receives the classical "principled actor" archetype — religious warrior, ethical reformer, or martial-spiritual leader. Caveat: Mars' aggression combined with Jupiter's rigid principle can manifest either as righteous courage (with benefic aspects on either) or as zealotry/combat-tendency (with afflictions). Doctrinally rated mixed-positive.

GURU_SHUKRA.name: Guru-Shukra — Jupiter+Venus conjunct. Two great benefics unified.
GURU_SHUKRA.prose:
Guru-Shukra — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — Jupiter (deva-guru) and Venus (asura-guru) conjunct. Doctrinally one of the supreme-benefic combinations: the two preceptor-grahas — teachers of devas and asuras — unite their wisdom in a single house.

The native receives extraordinary education, wealth, artistic skill, and philosophical depth simultaneously: philosophy-and-arts, scripture-and-music, dharma-and-luxury. Caveat: because the two gurus traditionally teach opposite cosmic camps, mild moral ambivalence or compartmentalized lives can occur; but in benefic houses the yoga is strongly auspicious.

GURU_VIDYA_JUPITER_4.name: Guru-Vidya — Jupiter well-placed in 4th. Higher learning, dharmic depth.
GURU_VIDYA_JUPITER_4.prose:
Guru-Vidya forms when Jupiter — natural significator of higher learning (uchcha-vidya), dharma, philosophy, and counsel — occupies the 4th house in own, exalted, mooltrikona, friendly, or neutral dignity. Phaladeepika 13 holds this as the supreme teaching-yoga: the higher-learning-karaka in the education-house grants doctrinal depth, scriptural mastery, and pedagogic charisma.

Natives excel in philosophy, theology, law, higher-education teaching, and advisory professions. The Jupiter-in-4 placement also confers respectability, the trust of students or junior peers, and the capacity to build lineage (shishya-parampara). Debilitated Jupiter cancels the yoga — a wounded dharma-karaka in the comfort-house produces hollow erudition or dogmatism rather than wisdom.

HALA_AKRITI.name: Hala Yoga — 7 grahas in 2-6-10 trikoṇa per BPHS 36. Plough-like cultivator-leader.
HALA_AKRITI.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, the base Hala Akriti = 7 grahas in the 2-6-10 trikoṇa-of-trines. The "plough" pattern confers cultivator-leadership, landed-property growth, and fame through patient hard labour. Common in those who turn raw land/resources into wealth.
HALA_AKRITI.general: Cultivator-leadership, landed-property growth, labour-fame, patient karma.

HALA_AKRITI_3_7_11.name: Hala Yoga (3-7-11) — 7 grahas in 3-7-11 trikoṇa per BPHS 36. Entrepreneurial cultivator.
HALA_AKRITI_3_7_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, the 3-7-11 Hala variant = 7 grahas in the parākrama-kalatra-lābha trikoṇa. Entrepreneurial-cultivator pattern: wealth via self-effort, fame mediated through partner, friend/family expansion. The most growth-oriented of the three Hala variants.
HALA_AKRITI_3_7_11.general: Entrepreneurial cultivator, self-effort wealth, partner-mediated fame, friend-family expansion.

HALA_AKRITI_4_8_12.name: Hala Yoga (4-8-12) — 7 grahas in mokṣa trikoṇa per BPHS 36. Renunciation or hidden wealth.
HALA_AKRITI_4_8_12.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, the 4-8-12 Hala variant = 7 grahas in the mokṣa-trikoṇa. Confers renunciation tendency or hidden wealth (legacy/insurance/research-finds), mokṣa-aptitude, and inward-turned karma. The most introverted of the three Hala variants — same plough-like form, but cultivating the inner field.
HALA_AKRITI_4_8_12.general: Renunciation tendency, hidden wealth, mokṣa-aptitude, inward-turned work.

HAMSA.name: Hamsa Yoga — Jupiter in kendra and dignity. Confers deep wisdom, spiritual authority, and moral integrity.
HAMSA.prose: Hamsa Yoga is the third of the Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas (BPHS Ch. 76, v. 3), representing the zenith of Jupiterian grace and wisdom. It occurs when Jupiter is situated in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) from the Ascendant or the Moon while in its sign of exaltation (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius/Pisces). As Jupiter is the primary significator (karaka) of wisdom, law, and spirituality, this yoga infuses the consciousness with pure sattva. The native possesses an innate understanding of higher principles, absolute integrity, and a magnetic moral compass that earns broad societal respect. Historically celebrated as the marker of royal advisors and prime justices, in modern contexts, it elevates individuals to supreme judicial offices, university chancellorships, and international humanitarian leadership.
HAMSA.body: Luminous, dignified physical stature, gentle expressions, and a serene, magnetic aura
HAMSA.career: Chief justices, spiritual pathfinders, university chancellors, and elite strategic advisors to governments
HAMSA.mind: Deep philosophical synthesis, scriptural fluency, absolute ethical clarity, and deep compassion
HAMSA.wealth: Enduring wealth accumulated through righteous endeavors, philanthropy, and intellectual legacy

HAMSA_BHANGA.name: Hamsa Bhanga — Jupiter combust or retrograde in kendra. Hamsa-yoga effects are rendered unstable or delayed.
HAMSA_BHANGA.prose: Hamsa Bhanga is formed when the astronomical components of Hamsa Yoga are present, but Jupiter is simultaneously combust (asta) by the Sun or retrograde (vakri). Jupiter retrogrades for approximately four months every year, making this a frequent occurrence. Under this influence, the native's deep philosophical wisdom and righteous intentions are not easily visible or appreciated by society. The combust status can lead to feelings of isolation, ethical self-doubt, or difficulty in finding a true guide (guru). The retrograde status turns Jupiter's expansive energy inward, prompting the native to constantly re-evaluate their beliefs, sometimes leading to serial changes in spiritual paths. Performing Jupiter Gayatri japa and supporting charitable causes are classical remedies.
HAMSA_BHANGA.career: Academic, judicial, or advisory career is prominent but encounters significant bureaucratic delays or lack of recognition
HAMSA_BHANGA.mind: Exceptional philosophical depth coexisting with extreme caution, over-thinking, and practical hesitation
HAMSA_BHANGA.spirituality: Deep spiritual curiosity coupled with recurring crises of faith and periodic resets of one's belief system

HAMSA_EXALTED.name: Supreme Hamsa — Jupiter exalted (Cancer) in kendra. Apex wisdom-yoga conferring spotless moral authority.
HAMSA_EXALTED.prose: Supreme Hamsa represents the grandest and most auspicious of all Pancha Mahapurusha configurations. When Jupiter—the foremost natural benefic and significator of wisdom—is placed in its sign of deep exaltation, Cancer (at 5 degrees), within an angular house from the Lagna or Moon, it creates an unparalleled flow of sattva (purity). Cancer, being a sensitive and receptive water sign ruled by the Moon, allows Jupiter's wisdom to manifest as profound emotional intelligence, absolute integrity, and a magnetic moral compass. The native is naturally sought after for guidance, possessing the rare capacity to uplift entire communities. Historically celebrated as the marker of royal advisors and prime justices, in modern times it elevates individuals to chief justices of supreme courts, prestigious university chancellorships, and world-renowned humanitarian leadership.
HAMSA_EXALTED.career: Chief justice of the supreme court, university chancellor, prestigious spiritual guide, or global humanitarian leader
HAMSA_EXALTED.mind: Apex philosophical comprehension, flawless judgment, deep compassion, and spiritual maturity
HAMSA_EXALTED.spirituality: Supreme dharmic authority, globally recognized righteousness, and profound spiritual realization

HAMSA_FROM_MOON.name: Hamsa from Moon — Jupiter angular from the Moon in dignity. Confers a wise, compassionate, and dharmic mind.
HAMSA_FROM_MOON.prose: Chandra Hamsa Yoga is constructed when Jupiter occupies a kendra from the natal Moon while positioned in its own or exaltation sign. In Vedic chart interpretation, the Ascendant represents outer destiny, whereas the Moon governs the inner emotional landscape (manas). Therefore, Chandra Hamsa predominantly spiritualizes the native's consciousness. The alignment of the receptive Moon with the wise, expansive energy of Jupiter produces profound emotional intelligence, high moral integrity, and an innate capacity for compassion. The native possesses an unshakeable faith in higher laws and is naturally drawn to philosophy, scriptural studies, and altruistic endeavors. When Jupiter is angular from both the Lagna and the Moon simultaneously, it represents the supreme Hamsa configuration, elevating the native to the status of a globally honored spiritual guide or chief justice.
HAMSA_FROM_MOON.mind: Profound philosophical depth, pure satvic wisdom, unwavering moral compass, and deep compassion

HAMSA_TRIKONA.name: Hamsa-Trikona — Jupiter in 1st (kendra+trikona). Apex Jupiter-placement.
HAMSA_TRIKONA.prose:
Hamsa-Trikona — Saravali Ch.38 — Jupiter in a house that is BOTH a kendra AND a trikona. Doctrinally only the Lagna (1st) qualifies as both. A variant of Hamsa-Mahapurusha — Jupiter in dual-classification produces the apex Jupiter-placement.

The native receives supreme dharmic conviction, extraordinary teaching capacity, and royal honor. Distinct from base Hamsa: this configuration combines digbala AND trikona-strength simultaneously. Classical signature for chief justices, kulagurus, dharma-shastra-pioneers, eminent teachers.

HARSHA.name: Harsha — 6th-lord in 6/8/12. Confers victory over enemies, debt, and disease.
HARSHA.prose:
Harsha is the first of the three canonical Vipareeta-Raja Yogas (BPHS Ch.34; Phaladeepika 6.36). It forms when the 6th-lord — significator of enemies, disease, and debt — falls into one of the three dusthana houses (6th, 8th, or 12th). Per the doctrinal "double negative inversion," the malefic-house lord caught in another malefic house has its destructive potential turn back on itself, yielding paradoxically auspicious results.

The yoga grants victory over adversaries, freedom from debt, recovery from illness, and unexpected royal favor through the very domains that ordinarily threaten. Classical commentary places Harsha natives in roles that thrive on adversity — insurance, law (especially defense and prosecution), surgery and emergency medicine, security services, and conflict resolution.

**Purity caveat.** Phaladeepika 6.36 commentary stresses that the yoga loses effect when the 6th-lord is associated with non-dusthana lords (1, 2, 5, 9, 10, 11). Mixing dilutes the pure double-negative. The cancellation rules on this yoga encode the purity doctrine — six lord-conjunction predicates that fire when the 6th-lord meets any non-dusthana lord.
HARSHA.body: Recovery from illness, resilience under physical stress
HARSHA.career: Medicine (especially surgery), law (defense/prosecution), insurance, security services, emergency response
HARSHA.mind: Capacity to thrive under adversity, calm in crisis
HARSHA.relationships: Defeats enemies; loyal supporters emerge in difficulty
HARSHA.wealth: Freedom from debt, unexpected financial rescue

ISHU.name: Ishu Yoga — 7 grahas in 4th through 7th sequentially per BPHS 36. Arrow-like sharp work.
ISHU.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Ishu Yoga = 7 grahas in 4-5-6-7 sequentially. The "arrow" pattern confers piercing/precise work, military or hunter-like temperament, and capacity to defeat many adversaries. More aggressive flavour than Yupa's ritual-work.
ISHU.general: Arrow-like precise work, military/hunter temperament, multi-adversary success.

JAIMINI_AK_AmK_BOTH_OWN_EXALT.name: AK + AmK both well-placed AND benefic in own/exalted.
JAIMINI_AK_AmK_BOTH_OWN_EXALT.prose:
Jaimini AK-AmK-Both-Own-Exalt — Saravali Ch.30 — AK AND AmK both in kendra/trikona AND a benefic (Mercury/Jupiter/Venus/Moon) in own/exalted/mooltrikona dignity. Three-tier alignment.

The native receives stable karaka-placement plus dignified benefic-support — triple-source amplification. Classical signature for high-eminence personalities.

JAIMINI_AK_AmK_KENDRA_TOGETHER.name: AK + AmK both in kendras — soul-counsel royal alignment.
JAIMINI_AK_AmK_KENDRA_TOGETHER.prose:
Jaimini AK-AmK-Kendra — Phaladeepika Ch.18 — both Atmakaraka AND Amatyakaraka in kendras. The soul-significator and counsel-significator simultaneously anchored in foundation-pillars produce the classical "ruler-and-counsel" alignment.

The native receives top-tier leadership, advisor-team support, and royal-tier eminence. Doctrinally the apex among Jaimini Raja-Yogas.

JAIMINI_AK_AmK_PARIVARTANA_PROXY.name: AK in Lagna + AmK in 10th — supreme self-counsel-career.
JAIMINI_AK_AmK_PARIVARTANA_PROXY.prose: Jaimini AK-Lagna + AmK-10 proxy — Phaladeepika Ch.18 — AK in Lagna AND AmK in 10th. A specialized form of AK-AmK-Kendra: identity-anchored leadership with counsel-supported career. The Jaimini analog of natal Maha-Parivartana 1-10.

JAIMINI_AK_AmK_TRIKONA_TOGETHER.name: AK + AmK both in trikonas — soul-counsel dharma-link.
JAIMINI_AK_AmK_TRIKONA_TOGETHER.prose:
Jaimini AK-AmK-Trikona — Phaladeepika Ch.18 — both AK and AmK in trikonas. Distinct from the kendra variant by tilting more dharmic/advisory than royal.

The native receives dharma-rooted advisory work, higher teaching, and philosophical guru-status. Suited to consultancy, judiciary, religious leadership.

JAIMINI_AK_DK_KENDRA_TOGETHER.name: AK + DK both in kendras — soul-spouse path-aligned.
JAIMINI_AK_DK_KENDRA_TOGETHER.prose: Jaimini AK-DK-Kendra — Phaladeepika Ch.18 — both AK and DK in kendras. Soul-path and spouse-path aligned. Classical signature for soulmate-marriage: deep partner-intimacy, marriage as a vehicle for self-development, shared dharmic path. Spouse becomes one of life's primary catalysts.

JAIMINI_AK_DUSTHANA_BHANGA.name: AK Bhanga — AK in 6/8/12. Soul-path obstruction.
JAIMINI_AK_DUSTHANA_BHANGA.prose:
Jaimini AK-Bhanga — Saravali Ch.30 — Atmakaraka in dusthana (6, 8, 12). The soul-significator in wounded houses signals soul-path mis-alignment.

The native experiences inner doubt, recurring re-questioning of life-direction, spiritual struggle. Note: in moksha-orientation contexts the same configuration's tapas-through-struggle eventually produces deep self-realization — the rule reads negative for normal life-purpose but sadhana-supporting for renunciation paths.

JAIMINI_AK_KENDRA.name: AK in kendra — soul-path well-anchored in chart pillars.
JAIMINI_AK_KENDRA.prose:
Jaimini AK-Kendra — Jaimini Sutras Ch.1-4. In the chara-karaka scheme, Atmakaraka (AK) is the planet with highest degrees-within-sign; the dynamic significator of the soul-path. AK in kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) anchors the soul-path in the chart's structural pillars: body / home / partnership / career.

The native receives natural alignment with life-purpose, character clarity, and structural leadership capacity. Doctrinally a strong Jaimini auspicious indicator.

JAIMINI_AK_LAGNA.name: AK in Lagna — soul fully expressed as identity. Supreme.
JAIMINI_AK_LAGNA.prose:
Jaimini AK-Lagna — Phaladeepika Ch.18 — AK in Lagna. Doctrinally the supreme Jaimini placement: soul-significator manifests directly in body-significator. Personality IS the soul-path.

The native receives self-realization, charisma, self-evident life-direction, and inner leadership-power. Distinguished personality; classical commentary places this configuration as equivalent in strength to Karakamsa-Lagna (Karakamsa as derived Lagna).

JAIMINI_AK_PK_TRIKONA_TOGETHER.name: AK + PK both in trikonas — soul-progeny dharma-link.
JAIMINI_AK_PK_TRIKONA_TOGETHER.prose:
Jaimini AK-PK-Trikona — Phaladeepika Ch.18 — both AK and PK in trikonas. Soul-path and progeny-path aligned in dharma-trikonas.

The native receives intellectual growth through children, dharma-rooted family-vocation, and teacher-disciple lineage potential.

JAIMINI_AK_TRIKONA.name: AK in trikona — soul-path dharma-aligned (1/5/9).
JAIMINI_AK_TRIKONA.prose:
Jaimini AK-Trikona — Jaimini Sutras — AK in trikona (1, 5, 9). The soul-path aligns with dharma, purva-punya (past-life merit), and bhagya (fortune).

The native receives life-direction through scriptural study, devotion, and spiritual depth. Moksha-leaning tendency, connection to guru-shishya lineage, manifestation of past-life merit. Distinct from kendra-tier in tilting more inward/dharmic.

JAIMINI_AK_WITH_BENEFIC_CONJUNCTION_KEND.name: AK in kendra + benefic in same kendra — soul + grace.
JAIMINI_AK_WITH_BENEFIC_CONJUNCTION_KEND.prose: Jaimini AK-with-Benefic-Kendra — Saravali Ch.30 — AK in kendra AND a natural benefic in any kendra. The native receives benefic grace on the soul-path, effortless eminence, unexpected support. Benefic strengthens the atma-karaka function.

JAIMINI_AmK_10.name: AmK in 10th — counsel-significator in karma-bhava.
JAIMINI_AmK_10.prose: Jaimini AmK-10 — Jaimini Sutras — Amatyakaraka (counsel-significator) in 10th house (karma/authority-domain). The native fits the classical archetype of advisor, minister, trusted aide to authority. Natural aptitude for diplomatic, legal, senior-administrative roles; the skill of counseling power becomes life-direction.
JAIMINI_AmK_10.career: Advisor, minister, trusted aide to authority

JAIMINI_BK_3.name: BK in 3rd — strong sibling welfare indicator.
JAIMINI_BK_3.prose: Jaimini BK-3 — Jaimini Sutras — Bhratrikaraka in 3rd (natural sahaja-bhava). The native enjoys sibling welfare, parakrama (initiative), and strong communication skill. Mutual sibling support, entrepreneurial drive, success in short-journey/communication-linked work.

JAIMINI_DK_7.name: DK in 7th — supreme Jaimini spouse indicator.
JAIMINI_DK_7.prose:
Jaimini DK-7 — Jaimini Sutras — Darakaraka (dynamic-spouse-significator) in 7th house (natural kalatra-domain). Same structural form as PK-5: dynamic karaka meets natural karaka-house — supreme Jaimini spouse indicator.

The native receives stable marriage, deep partner-intimacy, and long-term companionship. Classical signature for love-marriage or deep marital bond.

JAIMINI_DK_AK_SAME_HOUSE_PROXY.name: AK + DK both in 7th — supreme soulmate indicator.
JAIMINI_DK_AK_SAME_HOUSE_PROXY.prose:
Jaimini DK-AK-Same-House — Saravali Ch.30 — AK AND DK both in the 7th house. Atma-significator and spouse-significator unified in the partnership-house. Doctrinally the supreme classical "soulmate-marriage" indicator.

The spouse becomes a vehicle for the soul-path; conjugal life is the primary medium of spiritual journey. Distinct from AK-DK-Kendra: this is the specific 7th-house variant.
JAIMINI_DK_AK_SAME_HOUSE_PROXY.spirituality: Conjugal life as primary spiritual journey

JAIMINI_DK_KENDRA.name: DK in any kendra — broad spouse-fortune.
JAIMINI_DK_KENDRA.prose: Jaimini DK-Kendra — Jaimini Sutras — DK in any kendra. Broader form of DK-7 (which is supreme); any kendra placement still confers spouse-welfare, partner-cooperation, and marriage-anchored life-stability.

JAIMINI_GK_DUSTHANA_VIPAREETA.name: GK in 6/8/12 — Vipareeta-style enemy self-destroys.
JAIMINI_GK_DUSTHANA_VIPAREETA.prose:
Jaimini GK-Dusthana Vipareeta — Phaladeepika Ch.18 — Gnatikaraka (enemy/rival-significator) in dusthana (6, 8, 12). The enemy-significator in its own dusthana inverts to enemy-defeat through Vipareeta-Raja-style logic.

The native receives weakened opponents, litigation victories, and rivals self-destructing. Positive but external (enemy-defeat) rather than inner peace.

JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_JUPITER_PROXY.name: Karakamsa-Jupiter proxy — wisdom on soul-path.
JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_JUPITER_PROXY.prose:
Jaimini Karakamsa-Jupiter proxy — BPHS Ch.32 (Karakamsa-Adhyaya). Classical Karakamsha = navamsa-sign of AK; engine's rasi-proxy: Jupiter in trikona AND AK in kendra/trikona. Classical commentary permits both navamsa and rasi readings.

The native receives guru-grace on the soul-path, philosophical depth, and dharmic teaching. Classical Karakamsha-Jupiter is doctrinally famous for conferring philosophical-guru status.

JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_MOON_PROXY.name: Karakamsa-Moon proxy — maternal grace on soul-path.
JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_MOON_PROXY.prose: Jaimini Karakamsa-Moon proxy — BPHS Ch.32 — Moon in trikona AND AK well-placed. The native receives maternal welfare, emotional stability, and manas-supported soul-path.

JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_SUN_PROXY.name: Karakamsa-Sun proxy — paternal grace on soul-path.
JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_SUN_PROXY.prose: Jaimini Karakamsa-Sun proxy — BPHS Ch.32 — Sun in trikona (5, 9) AND AK well-placed. The native receives paternal welfare, royal-favor, government support, and an authority-rooted soul-path.

JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_VENUS_PROXY.name: Karakamsa-Venus proxy — refinement on soul-path.
JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_VENUS_PROXY.prose: Jaimini Karakamsa-Venus proxy — BPHS Ch.32 — Venus in trikona AND AK well-placed. The native receives an arts-rooted soul-path, aesthetic refinement, conjugal welfare, and luxury-vocation potential.

JAIMINI_MK_4.name: MK in 4th — strong maternal welfare indicator.
JAIMINI_MK_4.prose: Jaimini MK-4 — Jaimini Sutras — Matrikaraka in 4th (natural matr-bhava). Two karaka-layers aligned. The native enjoys maternal longevity, deep maternal affection, and stable home-environment. Family stability, home/real-estate, family-business prospects favored.

JAIMINI_PK_5.name: PK in 5th — supreme Jaimini progeny indicator.
JAIMINI_PK_5.prose:
Jaimini PK-5 — Jaimini Sutras — Putrakaraka (dynamic-progeny-significator) in 5th house (natural progeny-domain). Doctrinally the supreme Jaimini progeny indicator: dynamic karaka meets natural karaka-house.

The native receives healthy progeny, merit-rooted intelligence, and creative gifts. The configuration produces the strongest classical signature when both natural-5th-house and chara-PK are simultaneously dignified.

JAIMINI_PK_TRIKONA.name: PK in trikona — progeny + dharma alignment.
JAIMINI_PK_TRIKONA.prose: Jaimini PK-Trikona — Jaimini Sutras — PK in trikona. Broader form of PK-5; trikona placement aligns progeny with dharma and merit. The native receives intellectually-gifted, dharma-rooted, merit-bearing children.

JAIMINI_TRIPLE_KENDRA_KARAKAS.name: AK + AmK + DK all in kendras — supreme triple alignment.
JAIMINI_TRIPLE_KENDRA_KARAKAS.prose:
Jaimini Triple-Kendra-Karakas — Phaladeepika Ch.18 — AK, AmK, AND DK all simultaneously in kendras. Supreme alignment of three primary chara-karakas.

The native receives top-tier leadership, advisor-team support, AND spouse-support — three streams stable. Doctrinally a uniquely high tier among Jaimini Raja-Yogas.

JAYA.name: Jaya Yoga — exalted 10th lord in Lagna aspected by Mercury-Jupiter per Saravali 34.
JAYA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Jaya (victory) Yoga = 10th lord exalted/own-sign in Lagna, aspected by Mercury and Jupiter. Confers victory in all karma, the eight royal-marks fusion, sustained authority growth, and aiśvarya (sovereign-prosperity) capability. The "victory" name signals continuous winning in chosen domains.
JAYA.general: All-karma victory, royal-marks fusion, sustained authority, aiśvarya capability.

JUPITER_5_PUTRA_KARAKA.name: Putra-Karaka — Jupiter well-placed in 5th. Supreme classical progeny indicator.
JUPITER_5_PUTRA_KARAKA.prose:
Putra-Karaka Yoga — Jupiter in the 5th, in own, exalted, mooltrikona, friendly, or neutral dignity. Jupiter is the natural significator of progeny (putra-karaka); when the karaka occupies its own karaka-house in dignified strength, the configuration becomes the supreme classical progeny indicator.

Natives enjoy healthy, long-lived, prosperous children — typically multiple. Offspring carry strong intellectual and dharmic qualities; the first child is often especially auspicious. Debilitated Jupiter in the 5th cancels — a wounded putra-karaka in the putra-bhava reverses to obstruction rather than blessing.

JUP_IN_1.name: Jupiter in Lagna: Raja Yoga. Wisdom, dharma, longevity, dignified persona, guru's grace per Phaladeepika 8 / BPHS 21.
JUP_IN_1.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Jupiter in Lagna confers wisdom, religiosity, longevity, a dignified persona, and natural teacher-student affection. BPHS Ch.21 ranks this among the highest Raja-yoga placements — the kāraka of jñāna in the body-bhava grants self-purification, learning growth, and guru's grace as life-long fixtures. The native often becomes a counselor, teacher, or moral authority within their circle.
JUP_IN_1.general: Raja Yoga, wisdom, dharmic disposition, longevity, dignified persona, guru's grace, scriptural learning.

JUP_IN_10.name: Jupiter in 10th: kāraka-kendra Raja Yoga. High office, dharmic profession, royal honour per Phaladeepika 8.
JUP_IN_10.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Jupiter in the 10th forms a kāraka-kendra Raja Yoga — high office, dharmic profession (teaching, religion, law, philosophy, judiciary), royal recognition, and untarnished reputation. BPHS Ch.21 — kāraka-kendra union confers elevated career fruits. Common in judges, professors, and ethical statesmen.
JUP_IN_10.general: Kāraka-kendra Raja Yoga, high office, dharmic profession, royal recognition, untarnished reputation.

JUP_IN_11.name: Jupiter in 11th: Lābha-Dharma Yoga. Continuous wealth, dharmic friend-family per Phaladeepika 8.
JUP_IN_11.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Jupiter in the 11th forms a Lābha-Dharma Yoga — continuous wealth growth, dharmic friend-circles, and steady fulfilment of desires. BPHS Ch.21 — Jupiter in the gain-bhava augments all life-domains. Common in those whose income flows from dharmic work or who become philanthropists in later life.
JUP_IN_11.general: Lābha-Dharma Yoga, continuous wealth, dharmic friend-family, desire-fulfilment, elder sibling support.

JUP_IN_2.name: Jupiter in 2nd — Vāk-Dhana yoga (named-classical) per Phaladeepika 8. Wealth + dharmic speech.
JUP_IN_2.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8 (named-classical variant), Jupiter in 2nd = Vāk-Dhana yoga. Confers abundant wealth-accumulation, dharmic/teaching speech, family support, and higher-education capability. Distinct from Jupiter-in-2nd basic placement (in planet-house.yogas — that's the dhana-flavoured general reading; this named variant emphasises the speech-wisdom aspect).
JUP_IN_2.general: Sweet-wealth speech, abundant accumulation, dharmic/teaching voice, family support, higher education.

JUP_IN_4.name: Jupiter in 4th: maternal happiness, home, vehicles, dharmic householder, heart-peace per Phaladeepika 8.
JUP_IN_4.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Jupiter in the 4th confers maternal happiness, ample home and vehicles, a dharmic householder disposition, and inner contentment. BPHS Ch.21 — Jupiter in the comfort-bhava forms a kendra-kāraka union, augmenting domestic prosperity and ancestral property. Often produces those who manage family religious institutions or ancestral land.
JUP_IN_4.general: Maternal happiness, home/vehicles, dharmic householder, heart-peace, ancestral property growth.

JUP_IN_5.name: Jupiter in 5th: kāraka-kāraka Raja Yoga. Progeny, mantra-siddhi, learning, fame per Phaladeepika 8 / BPHS 21.
JUP_IN_5.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Jupiter in the 5th forms a kāraka-kāraka Raja Yoga — Jupiter (kāraka of progeny + wisdom) in the bhava of progeny + past-merit. The native enjoys progeny, mantra-siddhi, learning, and royal fame. BPHS Ch.21 ranks this as one of the supreme placements; common in spiritual teachers, scholars, and dharmic statesmen.
JUP_IN_5.general: Kāraka-kāraka Raja Yoga, progeny, mantra-siddhi, learning, royal fame.

JUP_IN_7.name: Jupiter in 7th: dharmic spousal yoga, learned partner, ethical business per Phaladeepika 8 / BPHS 21.
JUP_IN_7.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Jupiter in the 7th confers a dharmic spousal yoga — a learned/scholarly partner, ethical business, and gainful foreign travel. BPHS Ch.21 — Jupiter in kalatra-bhava produces a religiously-inclined spouse and ethical business conduct. Caveat: in rare configurations, the placement's dharmic pull can manifest as celibacy/late-marriage when Jupiter dominates the bhava without other relationship indicators.
JUP_IN_7.general: Dharmic spousal yoga, scholarly partner, ethical business, foreign travel gains, fame via marriage.

JUP_IN_9.name: Jupiter in 9th: supreme Dharma Raja Yoga (kāraka-kāraka-trikoṇa). Highest fortune per Phaladeepika 8.
JUP_IN_9.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Jupiter in the 9th forms the supreme Dharma Raja Yoga — kāraka-kāraka-trikoṇa, where Jupiter (kāraka of dharma + fortune) sits in the dharma-bhava itself. The native enjoys the highest fortune, deep guru's grace, mastery of scriptures, and unwavering dharmic disposition. BPHS Ch.21 calls this the most celebrated of all Jupiter placements. Signature of legendary saints, scholars, and just rulers.
JUP_IN_9.general: Supreme Dharma Raja Yoga, highest fortune, guru's grace, scriptural mastery, dharmic life.

JUP_IN_9_EXALTED.name: Exalted Jupiter in 9th — Mahā-Bhāgya-Dharma yoga per Phaladeepika 8. Supreme Raja Yoga.
JUP_IN_9_EXALTED.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Jupiter exalted (Cancer) in 9th = Mahā-Bhāgya-Dharma yoga. The supreme intersection of fortune-significator + fortune-bhāva + exaltation status. Confers highest fortune, deep guru-grace, mastery of all scriptures, and dharmic royal recognition. Among the rarest and most exalted single-placement yogas in the corpus.
JUP_IN_9_EXALTED.general: Supreme Raja Yoga, highest fortune, deep guru-grace, scriptural mastery, dharmic royal recognition.

JUP_SAT_CONJ.name: Jupiter-Saturn conjunction — Mahā-Saṅkrānti per Saravali 15. Long-term stability, deep dharma.
JUP_SAT_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Jupiter-Saturn conjunction = Mahā-Saṅkrānti Yoga (the rare 20-year cyclical great-conjunction). Confers long-term stable karma, deep religious disposition, organisational/business mastery, and society-architect capability. The unique blend of wisdom (Jupiter) + structure (Saturn) creates legacy-building natives. Common in institution-founders, dharmic CEOs, long-tenure judges.
JUP_SAT_CONJ.general: Mahā-Saṅkrānti Yoga, long-term stability, deep dharma, organisational mastery, society-architect capability.

JUP_VEN_MER_CONJ.name: Jupiter-Venus-Mercury triple conjunction — Sarasvatī triveṇī per Saravali 15.
JUP_VEN_MER_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Jupiter-Venus-Mercury triple conjunction = Sarasvatī triveṇī yoga. The three natural-benefic significators (wisdom + art + intellect) in same-sign confluence confer supreme learning, artistic fame, dharmic royal recognition, mantra-siddhi, and mastery of all scriptures. Among the most exalted triple-conjunctions in the corpus.
JUP_VEN_MER_CONJ.general: Sarasvatī triveṇī, supreme learning, artistic fame, dharmic royal recognition, mantra-siddhi.

KAHALA.name: Kahala — 4th and 9th lords in kendra. Kettledrum yoga.
KAHALA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Kahala Yoga is formed when the 4th lord of comforts and the 9th lord of highest fortune are both strongly placed in kendras. "Kahala" represents a kettledrum or war-trumpet, indicating victory, public proclamation, and leadership. The native is blessed with abundant vehicles, real-estate assets, and command over groups, organizations, or security forces. A powerful configuration for sports captains, security chiefs, and prominent executive administrators.

KAHALA_CHANDRA.name: Kahala-Chandra Yoga — Moon and Mars mutually placed in angular houses (kendras). Martial leadership and determination.
KAHALA_CHANDRA.prose: Kahala-Chandra Yoga — Bounded by Phaladeepika Chapter 6, Verse 14. This yoga arises when the Moon and Mars are positioned in mutual quadrants (kendras). The combination of the emotional Moon and the highly energetic Mars in structural pillars produces a classic signature of a commander or leader. The native possesses outstanding administrative capacity, real estate holdings, and physical courage.
KAHALA_CHANDRA.career: Military command, high-ranking security executive, project director
KAHALA_CHANDRA.material: Abundant land, vehicles, and assets built through action
KAHALA_CHANDRA.mind: Unyielding determination, physical and mental resilience

KAHALA_MUKHYA.name: Kahala-Mukhya Yoga — 9th + 10th lord linkage. Military leadership, royal lineage per Phaladeepika 6.
KAHALA_MUKHYA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Kahala-Mukhya Yoga arises when the 9th and 10th lords are linked (conjunction/aspect/exchange) — confers military/strategic leadership, royal-lineage connections, and karma-dharma-fame synergy. A specialised Mahā-Raja-Yoga distinct from the broader Dharma-Karmādhipati pattern.
KAHALA_MUKHYA.general: Military leadership, royal-lineage connections, karma-dharma fame, high office.

KALANIDHI.name: Kalānidhi Yoga — Jupiter in 2nd/5th aspected by/conjunct Mer-Ven per Phaladeepika 6.
KALANIDHI.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Kalānidhi (treasury-of-arts) Yoga = Jupiter in 2nd or 5th, aspected/conjunct by Mercury and Venus. Confers mastery of all arts, knowledge of multiple sciences, melodious singing voice, and royal recognition. The "art-treasury" name signals the native becomes a repository of cultural knowledge. Common in polymath performers and renaissance scholars.
KALANIDHI.general: All-art mastery, multi-science knowledge, melodious voice, royal recognition.

KALPADRUMA.name: Kalpa-Druma Yoga — Lagna-lord → dispositor → nakshatra-lord chain per Jataka Parijata 5.
KALPADRUMA.prose: Per Jataka Parijata Ch.5, Kalpa-Druma Yoga is the nakshatra-level dispositor variant of Pārijāta — Lagna-lord → its dispositor → its nakshatra-lord chain, all well-placed. Like the celestial wish-fulfilling tree (kalpa-druma), the yoga grants every desire. Slightly broader than Pārijāta because nakshatra-dispositor adds an additional rung but the same all-fulfilling flavour.
KALPADRUMA.general: All-desire fulfilment, infinite wealth, heaven-like joy, supreme fame.

KALSARPA.name: Kālasarpa Dosha — all 7 grahas between Rahu-Ketu axis per Mansagari 4. Multi-domain strain.
KALSARPA.prose: Per Mansagari Ch.4, Kālasarpa Dosha = all 7 classical grahas confined to one side of the Rahu-Ketu axis (Full Kalsarpa) or 6-of-7 on one side (Partial). Confers multi-domain karmic struggle, mental tension, unexpected obstacles, and serpent-karma significations. Two flavours: Ascending (more planets toward Rahu — outward struggle) vs Descending (toward Ketu — inward struggle). 12 named variants by Rahu's house position (Anant, Kulika, Vasuki, Sankhpal, Padma, Mahapadma, Takshak, Karkotak, Shankha-chuda, Ghatak, Vishdhar, Sheshnag).
KALSARPA.general: Multi-domain karmic struggle, mental tension, unexpected obstacles, serpent-karma effects.

KARMA_10_LORD_KENDRA.name: Karma — 10th-lord in kendra. Vocational lord well-anchored in pillar-houses.
KARMA_10_LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Karma 10-Lord-Kendra is the canonical career-anchoring yoga (BPHS Ch.18). It forms when the 10th-lord — significator of profession, public reputation, and dharmic action — occupies a kendra (1st/4th/7th/10th house) from the Lagna. The 10th-lord in a structural-pillar house anchors the karma stream of the chart in the body (1st), home (4th), partnerships (7th), or career-house itself (10th).

Classical commentary describes these natives as having durable career foundations, public recognition, and the support of authority-class structures. Career inclinations include administration, civil service, executive leadership, and roles requiring sustained public engagement. The yoga is doctrinally regarded as a foundational Tier-2 indication of vocational success.
KARMA_10_LORD_KENDRA.career: Durable career foundations, executive leadership, civil service
KARMA_10_LORD_KENDRA.wealth: Public reputation; resources flow through professional standing

KARMA_10_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Karma — 10th-lord in own/exalted/mooltrikona dignity.
KARMA_10_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose:
Karma 10-Lord-Own/Exalt forms when the 10th-lord — whichever planet it is — occupies its own sign, exaltation, or mooltrikona dignity. The dignified 10th-lord acts on its karma-significations directly through its own strength regardless of which house it occupies.

Classical commentary describes these natives as having self-generated career trajectories — they don't depend on external structure to support their professional ambitions. Independent authority, entrepreneurship, and durable reputation are typical signatures.

KARMA_10_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Karma — 10th-lord in trikona. Career aligned with dharma.
KARMA_10_LORD_TRIKONA.prose:
Karma 10-Lord-Trikona forms when the 10th-lord occupies a trikona (1/5/9) from the Lagna. Where the kendra-variant anchors career in structural-pillar houses, the trikona-variant flows career through dharmic alignment — purva-punya, intellect (5th), or inner dharma (9th).

Classical commentary describes these natives as drawn to philosophical teaching, dharma-counseling, scriptural research, and roles where inner conviction translates directly into public effect (acharyas, lineage-keepers, dharmic activists). Career trajectory unfolds through merit rather than structural opportunity.
KARMA_10_LORD_TRIKONA.career: Philosophical teaching, dharma-counseling, scriptural research, lineage-keeping
KARMA_10_LORD_TRIKONA.mind: Dharmic conviction translating to public effect
KARMA_10_LORD_TRIKONA.spirituality: Past-life merit (purva-punya) manifesting as career trajectory

KARMA_KARAKA_JUPITER_10.name: Jupiter in 10th — advisory / judicial / teaching profession.
KARMA_KARAKA_JUPITER_10.prose: Jupiter in 10th brings the dharma-karaka and counsel-significator into the karma-bhava. Classical commentary places these natives in roles where wisdom, ethical guidance, and teaching are central: judiciary, higher education, religious leadership, financial/legal advisory, philosophical writing. The yoga is cancelled when Jupiter is debilitated (Capricorn).
KARMA_KARAKA_JUPITER_10.career: Judiciary, higher education, religious leadership, financial/legal advisory, philosophical writing
KARMA_KARAKA_JUPITER_10.spirituality: Dharmic profession; ethical guidance as livelihood

KARMA_KARAKA_MERCURY_10.name: Mercury in 10th — commerce, communication, analytical profession.
KARMA_KARAKA_MERCURY_10.prose: Mercury in 10th brings the analytical/commercial nature of Mercury into the karma-bhava. Classical commentary places these natives in commerce, journalism, accounting, technical communication, brokerage, and detailed analytical work. The yoga is cancelled when Mercury is debilitated (Pisces).
KARMA_KARAKA_MERCURY_10.career: Commerce, accounting, journalism, brokerage, technical communication, software engineering

KARMA_KARAKA_SATURN_10.name: Saturn in 10th — service, labor, durable goods, government bureaucracy.
KARMA_KARAKA_SATURN_10.prose: Saturn in 10th brings the service-significator into the karma-bhava with directional strength. Classical commentary describes these natives as administrators, engineers, mining/manufacturing magnates, leaders of large workforces, and senior government bureaucrats — those whose work involves sustained engagement with durable systems and labor classes. Success comes slowly but lasts. Cancelled when Saturn is debilitated (Aries).
KARMA_KARAKA_SATURN_10.career: Industry, construction, mining, government bureaucracy, service-class leadership
KARMA_KARAKA_SATURN_10.mind: Patience, discipline, capacity for sustained effort
KARMA_KARAKA_SATURN_10.wealth: Slow but durable accumulation; long-term reputation

KARMA_KARAKA_SUN_10.name: Sun in 10th — governmental / leadership profession.
KARMA_KARAKA_SUN_10.prose:
Sun in 10th — Karma-Karaka in own house. The Sun is the natural significator of authority, soul, and governance, and the 10th house is its directional-strength (digbala) station. Their combination creates the doctrinal compound of authority-significator in the authority-house.

Classical commentary places these natives in governmental and royal positions — civil service, political leadership, military command, public administration. The yoga is cancelled when the Sun is debilitated (Libra), since the dignity defect undoes the karaka-house compounding.
KARMA_KARAKA_SUN_10.career: Civil service, political leadership, military command, public administration
KARMA_KARAKA_SUN_10.mind: Natural authority; capacity to lead and command

KARMA_LORDS_EXCHANGE_1_10.name: Karma-Lagna Parivartana — 1-10 mutual exchange. Supreme career-identity link.
KARMA_LORDS_EXCHANGE_1_10.prose:
Karma-Lagna Parivartana is the supreme tier of Karma yogas — TIER_1 alongside Maha-Bhagya and Pure-Vipareeta. It forms when the Lagna-lord occupies the sign of the 10th-lord AND the 10th-lord occupies the sign of the Lagna-lord, completing a structural mutual exchange.

The parivartana doctrinally locks self-significator (Lagna-lord) and career-significator (10th-lord) into a reinforcing structure — the chart owner's identity and life-work are unified at the structural level. Classical commentary places these natives among history's great public-facing leaders whose career trajectory IS their life-narrative.
KARMA_LORDS_EXCHANGE_1_10.wealth: Sustained royal-class fortune; durable public stature

KARNA_ARISHTA.name: Karna-Arishta — malefic in 3rd house without benefic aspect. Compromised hearing capacity or recurring ear ailments.
KARNA_ARISHTA.prose: Karna-Arishta — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — malefic in the 3rd house with no benefic aspect or co-occupation. The 3rd-house governs the right ear and hearing in classical commentary; malefic occupation absent benefic-rescue produces hearing-loss or ear-disease indication. Remedy: 3rd-lord pacification, karna-raksha-stotra, Mercury-shanti.

KEDARA.name: Kedara Yoga — 7 planets in 4 signs per BPHS 36. Cultivator-like, multi-tasked.
KEDARA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Kedara Yoga = 7 grahas in 4 signs. Native is "cultivator-like" (kedara = field) — engaged in many parallel tasks, supports family, holds modest wealth, and tends toward divisional/sectoral career. Brihat Jataka 12 — life like a four-quartered field, each portion separately tended.
KEDARA.general: Cultivator-like temperament, multi-tasking, family support, modest wealth, sectoral career.

KEETA.name: Keeta — Mars and Saturn in 8th house. High vulnerability to toxic bites, accidents, and acute infections.
KEETA.prose: Keeta — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — forms when Mars and Saturn jointly occupy the 8th house. Mars contributes acute-trauma karaka function; Saturn contributes chronic-infection. The conjunction in the death-house signals insect-bite, snake-bite, accident, or chronic-infection risk. Remedy: Mars-Saturn pacification, Hanuman-upasana, infection-vigilance.

KEMADRUMA.name: Kemadruma — Moon isolated, no planet in 2/12 from Moon. Manas-isolation.
KEMADRUMA.prose:
Kemadruma — BPHS Ch.34 v.5 — no planet (excluding Sun, Rahu, Ketu) occupies the 2nd or 12th from the Moon. The manas-karaka is flanked on both sides by emptiness, producing the classical "Moon-isolation" affliction.

The native experiences chronic emotional insecurity, social isolation, financial struggle, and lack of supportive social network. However — the classical Kemadruma-Bhanga doctrine cancels this defect when the Moon is in a kendra or aspected by benefics. Remedy: Chandra-Gayatri, Monday vrata, mother-service.

KEMDRUM_DOSHA.name: Kemadruma Dosha — Moon isolated (no planets in 2/12 from Moon) per Brihat Jataka 13.
KEMDRUM_DOSHA.prose: Per Brihat Jataka Ch.13, Kemadruma Dosha = no planets in 2nd or 12th from Moon (Rahu/Ketu excluded by classical convention). Confers mental isolation, emotional difficulty, financial constraints, and relationship-disruption tendencies. Cancellation: any benefic planet placed adjacent to Moon (forming Sunapha, Anapha, or Durudhara yoga) neutralises Kemadruma.
KEMDRUM_DOSHA.general: Mental isolation, emotional difficulty, financial constraints, relationship disruption tendencies.

KENDRADHIPATI_DOSHA.name: Kendrādhipati Dosha — natural benefic owns a kendra per BPHS 34. Reduced auspicious power.
KENDRADHIPATI_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34, Kendrādhipati Dosha = a natural benefic (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, or Moon) owning a kendra (1/4/7/10) loses some of its auspicious power due to "kendra-lordship dosha". The benefic's shubha-quality is partially neutralised, though Raja-yoga-conferring capacity may remain. A subtle structural dosha — does not actively harm but reduces benefit. Cancellation: own-sign placement, exalted, or strong dignity.
KENDRADHIPATI_DOSHA.general: Reduced auspicious power, mild pāpa-tendency increase, residual Raja-yoga capacity.

KETU_IN_12.name: Ketu in 12th: supreme Mokṣa Yoga (kāraka-kāraka). Liberation-aptitude, subtle vision per BPHS 29.
KETU_IN_12.prose: Per BPHS Ch.29, Ketu in the 12th forms the supreme Mokṣa Yoga — kāraka-kāraka where Ketu (the mokṣa-significator) sits in the mokṣa-bhava itself. The native enjoys liberation-aptitude, subtle/visionary perception, foreign residence, sattvic renunciation, and fame for hidden charity. Phaladeepika Ch.8 — the supreme Ketu placement. Signature of saints, mystics, and ego-transcendent souls.
KETU_IN_12.general: Supreme Mokṣa Yoga, liberation-aptitude, subtle vision, foreign residence, sattvic renunciation, hidden charity.

KETU_IN_9.name: Ketu in 9th: Mokṣa-Dharma Yoga. Spiritual disposition, guru-grace, deep insight per BPHS 29.
KETU_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.29, Ketu in the 9th forms a Mokṣa-Dharma Yoga — spiritual disposition, guru-grace, deep insight, mastery of subtle scriptures, and past-life recall. Phaladeepika Ch.8 — Ketu's 9th-house placement is exceptionally auspicious for spiritual life. Common in mystics, esoteric scholars, and those whose dharmic life is interior rather than performative.
KETU_IN_9.general: Mokṣa-Dharma Yoga, spiritual disposition, guru's grace, deep insight, esoteric scriptural mastery.

KHALA_10_12.name: Khala Parivartana (10-12): good-house kendra-10 lord ↔ 12th dusthana. Mixed per Phaladeepika 13.
KHALA_10_12.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.13, Khala Yoga = a kendra/trikona lord (here kendra-10) falling via mutual exchange (parivartana) into a dusthana (here the 12th (loss/expense)). The rule's classical reading is "neither full Raja-yoga nor full affliction" — the bhava's significations are sustained but threatened by chronic minor obstacles. Severity tracks the lord's dignity in the dusthana; debilitation deepens the obstruction, exaltation/own-sign mitigates.
KHALA_10_12.general: Sustained 10-bhava significations under chronic minor obstruction, mixed karmic results, prolonged tests of patience.

The rule's classical reading is "neither full Raja-yoga nor full affliction" — the bhava's significations are sustained but threatened by chronic minor obstacles. Severity tracks the lord's dignity in the dusthana; debilitation deepens the obstruction, exaltation/own-sign mitigates.
KHALA_9_12.general: Sustained 9-bhava significations under chronic minor obstruction, mixed karmic results, prolonged tests of patience.

KHALA_9_6.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.13, Khala Yoga = a kendra/trikona lord (here trikona-9) falling via mutual exchange (parivartana) into a dusthana (here the 6th (enemies/disease/debt)). KHALA_9_6.general: Sustained 9-bhava significations under chronic minor obstruction, mixed karmic results, prolonged tests of patience.

KHYATI.name: Khyāti Yoga — exalted Jupiter in kendra per Saravali 34. All-direction fame.
KHYATI.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Khyāti (fame) Yoga = Jupiter exalted/own-sign in a kendra. Confers all-direction-pervading fame, dharmic royal recognition, mastery of all scriptures, and guru-radiance respect. Common in scholar-celebrities, spiritual teachers with mass followings, and judges/jurists of historic stature.
KHYATI.general: All-direction fame, dharmic royal recognition, scriptural mastery, guru-radiance.

KRISHNA_PAKSHA_DOSHA.name: Krishna-Paksha Dosha — waning-Moon birth per BPHS. Lunar-weakening tendency.
KRISHNA_PAKSHA_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS, Krishna-Paksha Dosha = birth in the waning Moon fortnight. Confers lunar-weakening tendency, mental-strength reduction, relationship-doubt patterns, and lower self-confidence relative to Shukla-paksha births. Severity intensifies as the tithi approaches Amāvasyā. The dosha is structural rather than symptomatic — it shapes baseline lunar-domain strength rather than firing on a specific day.
KRISHNA_PAKSHA_DOSHA.general: Lunar-weakening tendency, mental-strength reduction, relationship-doubt, lower self-confidence.

KUJA_BHANGA_ABSENT.name: Kuja-Bhanga absence — Mangal-cancellation prerequisites absent per Phaladeepika 9.
KUJA_BHANGA_ABSENT.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.9, Kuja-Bhaṅga (cancellation of Mars-dosha) is granted by 10 classical conditions: Mars in own-sign/exalted in dosha-houses, Jupiter aspect on Mars, benefics on both sides, partner with same Mangal Dosha, etc. When NONE of these apply, Kuja-Bhanga is absent → Mangal-Dosha's severity cannot be classically reduced. The dosha must be addressed via full śānti karma rather than cancellation. The "absence-of-cancellation" check is the marriage-engine's second-pass discriminator after Mangal detection.
KUJA_BHANGA_ABSENT.general: Mangal severity cannot be classically cancelled; full śānti karma required.

KURMA.name: Kūrma Yoga — benefics exalted in kendra/trikoṇa per Saravali 34. Tortoise-like steadiness.
KURMA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Kūrma (tortoise) Yoga = benefic planets exalted/own-sign in kendras and trikoṇas. Confers tortoise-like steadiness — patient, long-lived, slow-but-certain progress, and devotional disposition. Stable royal radiance. The classical mythology references Vishnu's Kurma avatar (the cosmic tortoise supporting creation).
KURMA.general: Tortoise-like steadiness, longevity, slow-certain capability, devotional faith, stable radiance.

KUSUMA.name: Kusuma Yoga — exalted Venus in kendra aspected by Moon per Phaladeepika 6.
KUSUMA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Kusuma (flower) Yoga = exalted Venus in a kendra aspected by Moon. Confers flower-like beauty, sweet personality, universally-pleasant manner, and artistic inclination. The name signals gentle-floral grace — common in performers, beauty-industry professionals, and delicate-natured creatives.
KUSUMA.general: Flower-like beauty, sweet personality, universally-pleasant manner, artistic inclination.

KUTA.name: Kuta Yoga — 7 grahas in 4th through 10th sequentially per BPHS 36. Mountain-peak position.
KUTA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Kuta Yoga = 7 grahas in 4-10 sequentially. The "peak/summit" pattern confers fixed elevated standing, exceptional patience, hidden/strategic work, and a mountaintop-like position. Native may be reclusive but commands respect from the height of their discipline.
KUTA.general: Fixed elevated standing, exceptional patience, hidden/strategic work, mountaintop position.

L10_IN_1.name: 10th lord in 1st: kāraka-karma Raja Yoga. Career fame via personal effort per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L10_IN_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 10th lord in Lagna forms a kāraka-karma Raja Yoga — career-significator residing in the body makes the personality itself the engine of professional fame. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — fame through personal exertion. Common in self-made entrepreneurs and athletes whose identity is inseparable from their work.
L10_IN_1.general: Raja Yoga, career fame, high office, fame through personal effort, royal recognition.

L10_IN_11.name: 10th lord in 11th: Karma-Lābha Yoga. Continuous career growth, friend-driven gains per BPHS 24.
L10_IN_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 10th lord in the 11th forms a Karma-Lābha Yoga — career fructifies continuously in the gain-bhava. The native enjoys steady professional growth, gains via friend/business networks, and rising office. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — comprehensive desire-fulfilment via career.
L10_IN_11.general: Karma-Lābha Yoga, continuous career growth, friend-business gains, rising office, comprehensive prosperity.

L10_IN_2.name: 10th lord in 2nd: career-earned family wealth, business reputation, shrewd speech per BPHS 24.
L10_IN_2.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 10th lord in the 2nd produces career-earned family prosperity, business reputation, and a practical/persuasive speaking style. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — karma-dhana synergy augments the family treasury. Common in salaried executives and successful traders who anchor family fortune to professional reputation.
L10_IN_2.general: Career-earned family wealth, business reputation, government salary, practical speech, executive income.

L10_IN_4.name: 10th lord in 4th: career-derived home/vehicle gains, stable residence per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L10_IN_4.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 10th lord in the 4th forms a karma-gṛha Yoga — career generates home, vehicles, and property gains; mother's involvement in career common; stable settled residence. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — karma augments comfort. Common in real-estate professionals and those who build family fortunes on landed assets.
L10_IN_4.general: Karma-gṛha Yoga, home/vehicle gains, mother-career synergy, stable residence, property Raja-yoga.

L10_IN_5.name: 10th lord in 5th: karma-trikoṇa Raja Yoga. Career fame through intellect per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L10_IN_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 10th lord in the 5th forms a karma-trikoṇa Raja Yoga — career fructifies through past-merit, generating fame through intellect and creative skill. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — high office through learning, business, or skilled work. Common in academics, creators, and successful speculators.
L10_IN_5.general: Raja Yoga, karma-trikoṇa union, intellect-driven fame, progeny-career synergy, speculation profits.

L10_IN_7.name: 10th lord in 7th: karma-kalatra Raja Yoga. Career via partner, foreign business per BPHS 24.
L10_IN_7.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 10th lord in the 7th forms a karma-kalatra Raja Yoga — career fame through the partner, foreign business profits, and partnership-driven advancement. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — kalatra-karma synergy. Common in family-business heirs, joint-venture entrepreneurs, and diplomats.
L10_IN_7.general: Raja Yoga, partner-driven career fame, foreign business, partnership work, high office.

L10_IN_9.name: 10th lord in 9th: Dharma-Karmādhipati Yoga (highest Raja Yoga in Parashara) per BPHS 24.
L10_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 10th lord in the 9th forms the Dharma-Karmādhipati Yoga — Parashara's most exalted Raja-yoga structure where karma fructifies through dharma. The native attains supreme fame, royal recognition, and harmonious karma-dharma alignment. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — śreṣṭhatama Raja-yoga. The signature yoga of legendary statesmen and dharmic kings.
L10_IN_9.general: Dharma-Karmādhipati Raja Yoga, supreme fame, royal recognition, karma-dharma alignment, highest office.

L11_IN_1.name: 11th lord in 1st: gains via personal effort, friend-circle expansion, desire-fulfilment per BPHS 24.
L11_IN_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 11th lord in Lagna confers gains through personal effort, expansion of friend-circles, and steady fulfilment of desires. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — lābha-tanu synergy augments all life-domains. The native's personality itself attracts gain-yielding networks.
L11_IN_1.general: Gains via personal effort, friend-circle expansion, desire-fulfilment, comprehensive gains, elder sibling support.

L11_IN_10.name: 11th lord in 10th: Karma-Lābha synergy. Continuous career gains, rising office per BPHS 24.

L11_IN_10.general: Karma-Lābha synergy, continuous career fame, business gains, rising office, comprehensive prosperity.

L11_IN_2.name: 11th lord in 2nd: dhana-lābha union. Continuous wealth via friends/family per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L11_IN_2.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 11th lord in the 2nd forms a Dhana-Lābha union — income fructifies in the wealth-bhava. L11_IN_5.name: 11th lord in 5th: Prajñā-Lābha Yoga. Gains via children/students, education income per BPHS 24.
L11_IN_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 11th lord in the 5th forms a Prajñā-Lābha Yoga — income fructifies through past-merit, granting continuous gains via intellect and skill. L11_IN_9.name: 11th lord in 9th: Bhāgya-Lābha union. Continuous gains via dharma/guru-grace per BPHS 24.
L11_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 11th lord in the 9th forms a Bhāgya-Lābha union — income fructifies in the fortune-bhava, granting continuous gains via dharmic work and guru-grace. L11_IN_9.general: Bhāgya-Lābha Yoga, dharmic earnings, inherited income, guru-grace wealth, foreign gains.

L12_IN_12.name: 12th lord in 12th: Vimala Vipareeta-Raja Yoga. Expense-control, mokṣa-aptitude per BPHS 34.
L12_IN_12.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34, the 12th lord in the 12th forms the Vimala Yoga — a Vipareeta-Raja Yoga where the loss-lord in its own bhava confers expense-control, mokṣa-aptitude, fame for hidden charity, and foreign gains. Phaladeepika Ch.6 — vimala-yogo dhana-saṃrakṣakaḥ. Native preserves wealth despite the placement's nominal "loss" reading.
L12_IN_12.general: Vimala Yoga, expense-control, mokṣa-aptitude, fame for hidden charity, foreign gains.

L12_IN_6.name: 12th lord in 6th: Vimala Vipareeta-Raja Yoga (canonical) per BPHS 34.
L12_IN_6.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34, the 12th lord in the 6th forms the canonical Vimala Yoga — loss-and-enemy mutually cancel, conferring expense control, victory over enemies, and fame for hidden charity. Native preserves wealth despite the placement's nominal "loss" reading.
L12_IN_6.general: Vimala Vipareeta-Raja Yoga, expense control, victory over enemies, hidden-charity fame.

L1_IN_10.name: 1st lord in 10th: full Raja Yoga (karma-pati equivalent). Career success, fame, royal honour per BPHS 24.
L1_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the Lagna-lord in the 10th forms another kāraka-kendra Raja Yoga where the body-lord directly empowers the karma-bhava. The native is industrious, famous, recipient of royal honour, and reaches high office through personal effort. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the native earns recognition strictly through their own deeds.
L1_IN_10.general: Career Raja Yoga, fame, high office, royal recognition, success through personal effort.

L1_IN_11.name: 1st lord in 11th: continuous gains, friend-circle support, fulfilment of desires per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L1_IN_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the Lagna-lord in the 11th (lābha-bhava) confers a sustained labha-yoga: continuous income growth, supportive friend-circles, fulfilment of desires, and elder-sibling affection. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the body-lord in the gain-house grants all-round desire-fulfilment. One of the strongest income-yoga placements in the corpus.
L1_IN_11.general: Continuous income growth, friend-circle support, desire-fulfilment, elder sibling affection, sustained gains.
