L1_IN_2.name: 1st lord in 2nd: self-earned wealth, family support, sweet speech, food/sense enjoyment per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L1_IN_2.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24 (Bhavadhipati-Phala-Adhyaya), the Lagna-lord posited in the 2nd bhava transfers the body-and-vitality significations into the wealth-and-family bhava: the native earns wealth through personal effort, supports family, and is endowed with persuasive speech. Phaladeepika Ch.13 confirms the native applies their own resources to acquisition. Strength varies with the lord's dignity — debilitated/combust dilutes the yield.
L1_IN_2.general: Self-earned wealth, family support, eloquence, food/sense enjoyment, accumulation through personal effort.

L1_IN_3.name: 1st lord in 3rd: courage, sibling support, self-effort, travel/communication per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L1_IN_3.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the Lagna-lord in the 3rd (parakrama-bhava) confers personal valour, sibling support, initiative, and gain through one's own arms (sva-bahu-bala). Phaladeepika Ch.13 confirms the native succeeds through personal effort, communication, and short journeys. The placement also strengthens writing and skilful self-expression.
L1_IN_3.general: Courage, sibling support, self-effort, short travels, communication and writing skills.

L1_IN_4.name: 1st lord in 4th: maternal happiness, home, vehicles, property, contentment per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L1_IN_4.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the Lagna-lord in the 4th (sukha-bhava) confers maternal affection, domestic happiness, vehicles, landed property, and inner contentment. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the body-lord in the comfort-house grants heart-peace and material ease. Often signals strong attachment to mother and ancestral home.
L1_IN_4.general: Maternal happiness, domestic comfort, vehicles, property, inner peace, social standing.

L1_IN_5.name: 1st lord in 5th: full Raja Yoga (kāraka-trikoṇa). Intellect, progeny, mantra-siddhi, royal honour per BPHS 24.
L1_IN_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the Lagna-lord in the 5th forms a complete Raja Yoga (the kāraka of self joins the trikoṇa-of-poorva-punya). The native is intelligent, blessed with worthy progeny, recipient of royal honour, and capable of mantra-siddhi. Phaladeepika Ch.13 confirms — the body-lord in putra-bhava bestows wisdom, children, and fame as merit-fruit. One of the most desired Lagna-lord placements.
L1_IN_5.general: Raja Yoga, intellect, progeny, mantra-siddhi, royal recognition, fruit of past merit.

L1_IN_7.name: 1st lord in 7th: spousal happiness, foreign travel/residence, business gains per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L1_IN_7.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the Lagna-lord in the 7th confers a marriage-oriented disposition, foreign travel/residence, and business profits. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the body-lord in kalatra-bhava produces a spouse-attached, travel-prone native. Strength of marriage depends on the lord's dignity; afflictions can produce dependency or relocation away from native land.
L1_IN_7.general: Spousal happiness, foreign travel/residence, business profits, partner-orientation, increased journeys.

L1_IN_9.name: 1st lord in 9th: full Raja Yoga, fortune, dharma, paternal happiness, guru's grace per BPHS 24.
L1_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the Lagna-lord in the 9th forms another kāraka-trikoṇa Raja Yoga (self joins the dharma-trikoṇa). The native is fortunate, religiously inclined, blessed with paternal happiness, and enjoys the fruit of past merit. Phaladeepika Ch.13 confirms — the body-lord in dharma-bhava attracts guru-grace and elevates fortune across all life-domains.
L1_IN_9.general: Fortune, dharmic disposition, paternal happiness, guru's grace, fruit of past merit, Raja Yoga.

L2_IN_1.name: 2nd lord in 1st: self-earned wealth, stable physique, money-orientation per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L2_IN_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 2nd lord (dhana-pati) placed in Lagna confers self-earned wealth, a stable physique, and an inherent orientation toward financial acquisition. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the wealth-lord taking residence in the body-house dedicates the native's vitality to earning. Strength of effect tracks the lord's dignity.
L2_IN_1.general: Self-earned wealth, stable physique, money-focused temperament, family support, financial respectability.

L2_IN_10.name: 2nd lord in 10th: career-earned wealth, business success, government salary per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L2_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 2nd lord in the 10th confers career-earned wealth, business reputation, and governmental salary. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the native sustains the family through self-earned career income. Common in entrepreneurs and salaried executives whose primary identity is professional.
L2_IN_10.general: Career-earned wealth, business success, government salary, executive income, profession-derived family support.

L2_IN_11.name: 2nd lord in 11th: full Dhana-Lābha Yoga. Continuous wealth-growth and desire-fulfilment per BPHS 24.
L2_IN_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 2nd lord in the 11th forms a complete Dhana-Lābha Yoga — continuous wealth growth, friend-circle support, and fulfilment of all desires. The 11th is the 10th-from-2nd (income-from-wealth). Phaladeepika Ch.13 — sustained accumulation. One of the most reliable wealth indicators in the corpus.
L2_IN_11.general: Continuous wealth growth, friend-derived gains, elder sibling support, family expansion, full desire-fulfilment.

L2_IN_5.name: 2nd lord in 5th: dhana-trikoṇa Yoga. Wealth via intellect, progeny, education, speculation per BPHS 24.
L2_IN_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 2nd lord in the 5th forms a Dhana-trikoṇa Yoga — wealth through wisdom, progeny, education, and past-life merit. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the native earns through learning and skill, with secondary gains from speculation/share-markets and from offspring.
L2_IN_5.general: Wealth via intellect, gains through children, education-driven income, speculation profits, royal/governmental patronage.

L2_IN_9.name: 2nd lord in 9th: dhana-trikoṇa Yoga. Inherited wealth, fortune-driven gains, dharmic income per BPHS 24.
L2_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 2nd lord in the 9th forms a Dhana-trikoṇa Yoga — inherited wealth, fortune-driven income, guru's grace augmenting prosperity, and gains through dharmic activity (teaching, religious work, philosophy). Phaladeepika Ch.13 confirms — destiny augments family wealth. Foreign gains common.
L2_IN_9.general: Inherited wealth, fortune-driven income, guru's grace, dharmic earnings, foreign income.

L3_IN_10.name: 3rd lord in 10th: Parākrama-Karma Yoga. Valour drives career, self-effort to high office per BPHS 24.
L3_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 3rd lord in the 10th forms a Parākrama-Karma Yoga — both bhavas are upachaya, so valour augments career: self-effort attains high office, elder-sibling involvement in career common, fame through entrepreneurial drive.
L3_IN_10.general: Parākrama-Karma Yoga, valour-driven career, self-effort high office, elder-sibling career synergy, entrepreneurial fame.

L3_IN_11.name: 3rd lord in 11th: Parākrama-Lābha Yoga. Continuous gains via self-effort, elder-sibling growth per BPHS 24.
L3_IN_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 3rd lord in the 11th forms a Parākrama-Lābha Yoga — gains through self-effort, supportive elder siblings, and friend/family expansion. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — comprehensive desire-fulfilment via the courage-gain loop. Common in entrepreneurs whose ventures expand through grit and personal networks.
L3_IN_11.general: Parākrama-Lābha Yoga, self-effort gains, elder-sibling growth, friend expansion, gainful travels.

L3_IN_3.name: 3rd lord in 3rd: Parākrama Yoga. Courage, self-effort prosperity, sibling support per BPHS 24.
L3_IN_3.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 3rd lord in its own bhava forms a Parākrama Yoga — confers personal valour, prosperity through self-effort, sibling support, and entrepreneurial drive. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the parākrama-lord in parākrama-bhava strengthens initiative. A favoured placement for athletes, soldiers, and self-made entrepreneurs.
L3_IN_3.general: Parākrama Yoga, self-effort prosperity, courage, sibling support, entrepreneurial drive, gainful travels.

L3_IN_6.name: 3rd lord in 6th: enemy-conquest yoga. Valour defeats foes, service-fame per BPHS 24.
L3_IN_6.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 3rd lord in the 6th forms an enemy-conquest yoga — valour-significator (3rd) in the enemy-bhava conquers foes through personal effort, earns service-fame, and cancels debt. The 6th is also an upachaya, augmenting the placement's positive growth.
L3_IN_6.general: Enemy-conquest yoga, valour over foes, service-fame, debt cancellation, courage-conferring.

L4_IN_1.name: 4th lord in 1st: kāraka-kendra Raja Yoga. Maternal happiness, property, heart-peace per BPHS 24.
L4_IN_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 4th lord in Lagna forms a kāraka-kendra Raja Yoga — comfort takes residence in the body, making the personality itself the engine of domestic prosperity. Native enjoys maternal happiness, property/vehicles, and inner peace. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — sukha-tanu synergy.
L4_IN_1.general: Sukha-tanu Raja Yoga, maternal happiness, property/vehicles, heart-peace, life-stability.

L4_IN_10.name: 4th lord in 10th: Sukha-Karma kendra-kendra Raja Yoga. Property-business fame per BPHS 24.
L4_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 4th lord in the 10th forms a Sukha-Karma kendra-kendra Raja Yoga — comfort fructifies in karma-bhava, granting fame through real-estate/property business and mother-career synergy. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — kendra-kendra Raja-yoga. Common in property tycoons and family-business CEOs.
L4_IN_10.general: Sukha-Karma Raja Yoga, property-business fame, mother-career synergy, stable reputation, high office.

L4_IN_4.name: 4th lord in 4th: Mātṛ-Gṛha Yoga. Ancestral property growth, mother's longevity per BPHS 24.
L4_IN_4.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 4th lord in its own bhava forms a Mātṛ-Gṛha Yoga — ancestral property growth, mother's longevity, stable residence, and inner contentment. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the comfort-lord in comfort-bhava augments comfort. The classic "rooted-life" placement.
L4_IN_4.general: Mātṛ-Gṛha Yoga, ancestral property growth, mother's longevity, stable residence, heart-peace.

L4_IN_5.name: 4th lord in 5th: kendra-trikoṇa Raja Yoga. Maternal joy fuels progeny, education flourishes per BPHS 41.
L4_IN_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 4th lord in the 5th forms a kendra-trikoṇa Raja Yoga — comfort-significator (4th = mother/home) fructifies in the past-merit bhava (5th), so maternal happiness translates into progeny welfare and educational success. Phaladeepika reading — domestic harmony catalyses the next generation's rise.
L4_IN_5.general: Kendra-trikoṇa Raja Yoga, maternal joy → progeny welfare, educational success, domestic harmony, ancestral-home growth.

L4_IN_9.name: 4th lord in 9th: Sukha-Trikoṇa Raja Yoga. Mother-dharma-property union per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L4_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 4th lord in the 9th forms a Sukha-trikoṇa Raja Yoga — comfort fructifies in the fortune-bhava, granting maternal happiness, ancestral home, dharmic householder disposition, and guru's grace. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — śreṣṭha Raja-yoga from sukha-trikoṇa synergy. Common in dharmic family-business heads.
L4_IN_9.general: Sukha-Trikoṇa Raja Yoga, mother-dharma synergy, ancestral home, guru's grace, dharmic householder.

L5_IN_1.name: 5th lord in 1st: full Raja Yoga. Intellect, progeny, religiosity, fruit of past merit per BPHS 24.
L5_IN_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 5th lord in Lagna forms a kāraka-trikoṇa Raja Yoga — past-merit (poorva-punya) takes residence in the body. The native is intelligent, blessed with worthy progeny, religiously inclined, and enjoys the fruit of past sukṛta. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the soul-essence anchored to the body grants comprehensive wisdom-prosperity.
L5_IN_1.general: Raja Yoga, intellect, progeny, mantra-siddhi, religious disposition, fruit of past merit.

L5_IN_10.name: 5th lord in 10th: Raja Yoga via karma-trikoṇa union. Career fame through intellect per BPHS 24.
L5_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 5th lord in the 10th forms a karma-trikoṇa Raja Yoga — past-merit fructifies in the karma-bhava. The native attains career fame through intellect and skill, receives royal recognition, and reaches high office through wisdom rather than mere effort. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — high office through learning, business, or skilled work.
L5_IN_10.general: Raja Yoga, career fame via intellect, royal recognition, high office, success through skilled work.

L5_IN_11.name: 5th lord in 11th: Prajñā-Lābha Yoga. Gains via children/students, education income, speculation per BPHS 24.
L5_IN_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 5th lord in the 11th forms a Prajñā-Lābha Yoga — past-merit fructifies in the gain-bhava. The native earns through children, students, friends, education, and speculation/share-markets. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — comprehensive desire-fulfilment. A favoured placement for educators, mentors, and investment specialists.
L5_IN_11.general: Wisdom-gains, gains via children/students, education income, speculation profits, friend-derived wealth.

L5_IN_2.name: 5th lord in 2nd: dhana-trikoṇa Yoga. Intellect-driven wealth, progeny-derived family expansion per BPHS 24.
L5_IN_2.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 5th lord in the 2nd forms a Dhana-trikoṇa Yoga — past-merit fructifies in the wealth-bhava. The native earns through intellect/speech and gains family expansion through worthy progeny. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — coffer-augmentation through learning and skill. Sweet, persuasive speech is a hallmark.
L5_IN_2.general: Intellect-driven wealth, progeny-derived gains, education income, persuasive speech, royal treasury access.

L5_IN_4.name: 5th lord in 4th: maternal/progeny happiness, domestic dharma, heart-peace per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L5_IN_4.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 5th lord in the 4th confers maternal happiness, blessed progeny, domestic dharma, and inner contentment. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — past-merit fructifies in the comfort-bhava. The native's emotional life is rooted in family and faith.
L5_IN_4.general: Maternal happiness, progeny happiness, domestic comfort, heart-peace, dharmic family disposition.

L5_IN_7.name: 5th lord in 7th: spousal happiness, fame via partner, progeny + business gains per BPHS 24.
L5_IN_7.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 5th lord in the 7th confers spousal happiness, fame derived through the partner, progeny-yoga, and business profits. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — past-merit fructifies in the partnership-bhava. The marriage itself functions as a vehicle for the native's elevation.
L5_IN_7.general: Spousal happiness, fame via partner, progeny, business profits, gainful travels.

L5_IN_9.name: 5th lord in 9th: Mahā-Raja Yoga (dual-trikoṇa union). Supreme fortune, guru-grace per BPHS 24.
L5_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 5th lord in the 9th forms a dvi-trikoṇa Yoga — past-merit unites with destiny. The native enjoys supreme fortune, profound religiosity, guru's grace, mastery of scriptures, and exceptional fame. Phaladeepika Ch.13 calls this the most powerful Raja-yoga structure for sustained life-elevation. Often produces saints, scholars, and kingmakers.
L5_IN_9.general: Mahā-Raja Yoga, supreme fortune, guru's grace, dharmic mastery, scriptural learning, exceptional fame.

L6_IN_10.name: 6th lord in 10th: Sevā-Karma Yoga. Service-class career fame, adversarial-arena success per BPHS 24.
L6_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 6th lord in the 10th forms a Sevā-Karma Yoga — enemy-significator (6th) in the career-bhava produces service-class career fame, success in adversarial arenas, and medical/legal/litigation profession. Both upachaya bhavas — moderate Raja-yoga flavour.
L6_IN_10.general: Sevā-Karma Yoga, service-class career fame, adversarial-arena success, medical/legal profession.

L6_IN_11.name: 6th lord in 11th: Śatru-Lābha Yoga. Wealth via adversarial-service work per BPHS 24.
L6_IN_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 6th lord in the 11th forms a Śatru-Lābha Yoga — adversarial/service work (medicine, law, security, litigation) yields continuous wealth, debt under control, and elder-sibling adversarial-arena fame. Both upachaya bhavas — sustained moderate prosperity.
L6_IN_11.general: Śatru-Lābha Yoga, adversarial-service wealth, debt under control, elder-sibling success in adversarial arenas.

L6_IN_3.name: 6th lord in 3rd: Parākrama-Śatru Yoga. Valour defeats enemies per BPHS 24.
L6_IN_3.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 6th lord in the 3rd forms a Parākrama-Śatru Yoga — valour-channelled aggressiveness defeats enemies, courage augments, debt under control. Both upachaya bhavas, yielding moderately auspicious fruit.
L6_IN_3.general: Parākrama-Śatru Yoga, valour over enemies, courage, debt under control, sibling-fuelled drive.

L6_IN_6.name: 6th lord in 6th: Harṣa Vipareeta-Raja Yoga. Victory over enemies, freedom from disease/debt per BPHS 34.
L6_IN_6.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34, the 6th lord in the 6th forms the Harṣa Yoga — a Vipareeta-Raja Yoga where the dusthana-lord in its own dusthana yields auspicious results (vipareeta nyāya). The native conquers enemies, recovers from disease, escapes debt, and gains personal fame. Phaladeepika Ch.6 — duṣṭeśo duṣṭe śubhadaḥ. One of the three classical Vipareeta-Raja-yogas.
L6_IN_6.general: Harṣa Yoga, victory over enemies, freedom from disease, debt-cancellation, personal fame.

L6_IN_8.name: 6th lord in 8th: Harṣa Vipareeta-Raja Yoga (canonical) per BPHS 34. Enemy-death destruction → triumph.
L6_IN_8.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34 vv.17-19, the 6th lord in the 8th forms the canonical Harṣa Yoga — one of the three classical Vipareeta-Raja yogas where mutual destruction of enemy-and-death yields triumph: victory over enemies, longevity, debt cancellation, and hidden-wealth gains. Often signature of those who turn life-or-death adversity into spectacular comebacks.
L6_IN_8.general: Harṣa Vipareeta-Raja Yoga, victory over enemies, longevity, debt cancellation, hidden-wealth gains.

L7_IN_1.name: 7th lord in 1st: spouse-driven growth, foreign reputation, partnership-orientation per BPHS 24.
L7_IN_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 7th lord in Lagna confers spouse-driven elevation, fame in foreign lands, and a partnership-centric personality. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the kalatra-lord in the body-house bonds the native's identity to the partner. Marriage often becomes the pivot of life-trajectory; foreign settlement common.
L7_IN_1.general: Spouse-driven growth, foreign reputation, partnership-orientation, business profits, frequent travel.

L7_IN_10.name: 7th lord in 10th: kāraka-kendra Raja Yoga. Career fame via partner, foreign business per BPHS 24.
L7_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 7th lord in the 10th forms a karma-kalatra Raja Yoga — career fame derived through the partner, foreign business success, and royal recognition. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — high office through partnership-business or marriage. Common in CEOs of family-business empires and diplomats.
L7_IN_10.general: Raja Yoga, fame via partner, foreign business profits, royal recognition, high office through partnership.

L7_IN_4.name: 7th lord in 4th: spouse-derived domestic happiness, stable marriage per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L7_IN_4.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 7th lord in the 4th confers a spouse-derived domestic harmony, stable marriage, ancestral property gains via partnership, and harmonious mother-spouse relations. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — the kalatra-lord in the comfort-bhava produces heart-peace.
L7_IN_4.general: Spouse-derived home, stable marriage, ancestral property gains, mother-spouse harmony, heart-peace.

L7_IN_5.name: 7th lord in 5th: kendra-trikoṇa Raja Yoga. Spouse-driven progeny + fame per BPHS 41.
L7_IN_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 7th lord in the 5th forms a kendra-trikoṇa Raja Yoga — partner-significator (7th) fructifies in past-merit (5th), so the marriage itself catalyses progeny welfare, the partner becomes a fame-vehicle, and partnership-business yields profits.
L7_IN_5.general: Kendra-trikoṇa Raja Yoga, spouse-driven progeny, fame via partner, partnership-business profits.

L7_IN_9.name: 7th lord in 9th: spouse-driven fortune, dharmic partner, foreign pilgrimage per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L7_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 7th lord in the 9th confers a fortunate marriage — destiny opens through the partner, the spouse is dharmic/scholarly, and foreign religious travel is common. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — guru-grace flows through the partnership. Often produces matches across cultures or with religiously inclined partners.
L7_IN_9.general: Spouse-driven fortune, dharmic partner, foreign pilgrimage, guru's grace via spouse, religious income.

L8_IN_12.name: 8th lord in 12th: Sarala Vipareeta-Raja Yoga (canonical) per BPHS 34.
L8_IN_12.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34, the 8th lord in the 12th forms the canonical Sarala Yoga — death-and-loss mutually cancel, conferring longevity, hidden-wealth gains, mokṣa-aptitude, and freedom from death-anxiety. The most longevity-augmenting of the three classical Vipareeta-Raja yogas.
L8_IN_12.general: Sarala Vipareeta-Raja Yoga, longevity, hidden-wealth gains, mokṣa-aptitude, freedom from death-anxiety.

L8_IN_8.name: 8th lord in 8th: Sarala Vipareeta-Raja Yoga. Longevity, hidden wealth, mṛityunjaya per BPHS 34.
L8_IN_8.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34, the 8th lord in the 8th forms the Sarala Yoga — a Vipareeta-Raja Yoga where the death-lord in its own bhava confers longevity, hidden wealth (legacy/insurance/research-finds), occult power, and a "death-conqueror" reputation. Phaladeepika Ch.6 — sarala-yogo dīrghāyuṣaḥ kārakaḥ. The most longevity-augmenting of the three Vipareeta-Raja-yogas.
L8_IN_8.general: Sarala Yoga, longevity, hidden wealth, occult power, death-conqueror fame.

L9_IN_1.name: 9th lord in 1st: kāraka-trikoṇa Raja Yoga. Supreme fortune, dharma, guru's grace per BPHS 24.
L9_IN_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 9th lord in Lagna forms a kāraka-trikoṇa Raja Yoga — fortune itself takes residence in the body, and the native's very personality becomes the engine of fortune. Phaladeepika Ch.13 ranks this among the highest Raja-yogas. Native is exceptionally fortunate, religiously inclined, and protected by guru's grace.
L9_IN_1.general: Raja Yoga, supreme fortune, dharmic disposition, guru's grace, paternal happiness, self-driven fortune.

L9_IN_10.name: 9th lord in 10th: Dharma-Karmādhipati Yoga — supreme Raja Yoga in Parashara per BPHS 41.
L9_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 9th lord in the 10th forms the Dharma-Karmādhipati Yoga — Parashara's most exalted Raja-yoga, where karma fructifies through dharma. Native attains supreme fame, royal recognition, and harmonious karma-dharma alignment. Phaladeepika Ch.6 — śreṣṭhatama Raja-yoga. (Same yoga also appears in house-lord.yogas; the rule-engine produces both detections, which is doctrinally correct — the yoga is so foundational that it appears in multiple classical taxonomies.)
L9_IN_10.general: Dharma-Karmādhipati Raja Yoga, supreme fame, royal recognition, karma-dharma alignment, highest office.

L9_IN_11.name: 9th lord in 11th: Bhāgya-Lābha Yoga. Continuous fortune-growth, dharmic friend-gains per BPHS 24.
L9_IN_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 9th lord in the 11th forms a Bhāgya-Lābha Yoga — fortune fructifies continuously in the gain-bhava. Native gains through dharmic friend-circles, possesses a dharmic family, and enjoys steady fulfilment of desires. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — comprehensive desire-fulfilment via fortune-gain synergy.
L9_IN_11.general: Bhāgya-Lābha Yoga, continuous fortune-growth, dharmic friend-gains, desire-fulfilment, elder sibling support.

L9_IN_2.name: 9th lord in 2nd: dhana-trikoṇa Yoga. Inherited wealth, dharmic earnings, sweet religious speech per BPHS 24.
L9_IN_2.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 9th lord in the 2nd forms a Dhana-trikoṇa Yoga — fortune residing in the wealth-bhava augments family prosperity. Inherited wealth flows readily, the native earns through dharmic work (teaching, religion, philosophy), and possesses sweet religiously-inflected speech. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — fortune-coffer augmentation.
L9_IN_2.general: Dhana-trikoṇa Yoga, inherited wealth, dharmic earnings, religious speech, guru-grace wealth.

L9_IN_4.name: 9th lord in 4th: maternal happiness, ancestral home, dharmic householder path per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L9_IN_4.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 9th lord in the 4th confers maternal happiness, ancestral home/property, and a dharmic householder disposition. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — fortune in the comfort-bhava grants heart-peace and elevates the family's social-religious standing. Often produces those who manage family temples or ancestral institutions.
L9_IN_4.general: Maternal happiness, ancestral property, dharmic householder path, heart-peace, property growth.

L9_IN_5.name: 9th lord in 5th: Mahā-Raja Yoga (dual-trikoṇa). Fortune-progeny union, supreme grace per BPHS 24.
L9_IN_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 9th lord in the 5th forms a dvi-trikoṇa Mahā-Raja Yoga — fortune unites with past-merit. The native is exceptionally fortunate, blessed with dharmic progeny, deeply favoured by the guru, and capable of mantra-siddhi. Phaladeepika Ch.13 ranks this with 5th-in-9th as the highest forms of Raja-yoga.
L9_IN_5.general: Mahā-Raja Yoga, dual-trikoṇa union, fortune-progeny synergy, guru's grace, mantra-siddhi, deep dharmic life.

L9_IN_7.name: 9th lord in 7th: spouse-driven fortune, dharmic partner, foreign pilgrimage per BPHS 24 / Phaladeepika 13.
L9_IN_7.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the 9th lord in the 7th confers fortune-elevation through the partner — the spouse is dharmic/scholarly, foreign religious travel is common, and guru-grace flows through the partnership. Phaladeepika Ch.13 — bhāgya-kalatra synergy. Often produces partnerships where the spouse becomes the destiny-maker.
L9_IN_7.general: Spouse-driven fortune, dharmic partner, foreign pilgrimage, guru's grace, partnership growth.

LAGNADHI.name: Lagnādhi Yoga — benefics in 6/7/8 from Lagna per Phaladeepika 6. Body-bhāva protection.
LAGNADHI.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Lagnādhi Yoga = benefics in 6, 7, 8 from Lagna (vs. Adhi Yoga from Moon). The Lagna-flavoured variant confers body-bhāva protection, all-round auspiciousness, and Adhi-Yoga-like fame. Mirror of chandra.yogas ADHI_YOGA but anchored to Lagna instead of Moon.
LAGNADHI.general: Lagna protection, all-round auspiciousness, Adhi-Yoga-like fame, royal recognition.

LAGNA_LORD_12.name: Arishta Lagna-Lord-12 — Lagna-lord in 12th house. Vairagya-tinted life, foreign residence, and high spending.
LAGNA_LORD_12.prose: Arishta Lagna-Lord-12 — Lagna-lord in 12th binds self to expense/foreign-residence/moksha house. Vairagya-tinted personality, foreign-residence tendency, hidden expenses. Spiritual or charitable inclination, or success in indirect/behind-the-scenes work. Remedy: Lagna-lord pacification, meditation.

LAGNA_LORD_6.name: Arishta Lagna-Lord-6 — Lagna-lord in 6th house. Life marked by struggle, health concerns, but strong combat capacity.
LAGNA_LORD_6.prose: Arishta Lagna-Lord-6 — Lagna-lord in 6th binds the self-significator to the enemy/illness/debt domain. Personality marked by sustained struggle; chronic health concerns, debt-pressure, litigation tendency. However the fighting-capacity is unusually strong — military, athletics, advocacy careers thrive here. Remedy: Lagna-lord pacification, Hanuman-upasana.

LAGNA_LORD_8.name: Arishta Lagna-Lord-8 — Lagna-lord in 8th house. Wounded vitality, sudden crises, balanced by deep intuitive wisdom.
LAGNA_LORD_8.prose: Arishta Lagna-Lord-8 — Lagna-lord in 8th binds self to the death/transformation house. Foundational vitality wounded; chronic illness, sudden crises. Compensating gift: research-aptitude, depth-psychology, occult/mantic capacity. Remedy: Lagna-lord pacification, Guru-upasana.
LAGNA_LORD_8.mind: Vitality deficit, chronic illness, sudden crises

LAKSHMI_BHAGYA_VENUS_9.name: Lakshmi-Bhagya — Venus in 9th well-placed. Artha-fortune through grace.
LAKSHMI_BHAGYA_VENUS_9.prose:
Lakshmi-Bhagya is the Venus-led variant. It forms when Venus — natural artha-karaka and signifier of beauty, refinement, and prosperity — occupies the 9th house in own (Taurus/Libra), exalted (Pisces), mooltrikona, friend, or neutral dignity. The combination of artha-karaka and bhagya-bhava signifies prosperity flowing through cultural refinement and Lakshmi's grace.

Classical commentary describes these natives as enjoying refined material life — fine homes, beautiful surroundings, vehicles, jewelry — coupled with cultural cultivation in arts, music, design, and the diplomatic crafts. The fortune comes through aesthetic/cultural channels rather than through stern austerity (Sun) or scholarly discipline (Jupiter). Career inclinations: design, fine arts, luxury trade, diplomacy, fashion, hospitality, performing arts.
LAKSHMI_BHAGYA_VENUS_9.career: Design, fine arts, luxury trade, diplomacy, fashion, hospitality, performing arts
LAKSHMI_BHAGYA_VENUS_9.wealth: Affluence with refinement; fine homes, vehicles, ornaments

LAKSHMI_CHANDRA.name: Lakshmi-Chandra Yoga — Moon and Venus mutually placed in angular houses (kendras). Blessings of Goddess Lakshmi.
LAKSHMI_CHANDRA.prose: Lakshmi-Chandra Yoga — Reference Phaladeepika Chapter 6, Verse 18. This highly auspicious yoga is formed when the Moon and Venus are positioned in mutual quadrants (kendras). This configuration unites the lunar manas-karaka and the Venusian bhoga-karaka in the structural pillars of the chart, invoking the direct grace of Goddess Lakshmi. The native is blessed with aesthetic refinement, immense prosperity, and harmonious domestic relationships.
LAKSHMI_CHANDRA.material: Immense prosperity, luxury vehicles, and real estate
LAKSHMI_CHANDRA.relationships: Marital bliss, emotional harmony with partner

LIPI_BUDDHI_MERCURY_3.name: Lipi-Buddhi — Mercury in 3rd well-placed. Writing, eloquence, intellect.
LIPI_BUDDHI_MERCURY_3.prose:
Lipi-Buddhi (literally "writing-and-intellect") forms when Mercury occupies the 3rd house in own/exalted/friend dignity (Phaladeepika 13). Mercury rules communication, intellect, and detailed analysis; the 3rd house rules written word and short-form expression. The combination produces strong communicators.

Classical commentary places these natives in writing, journalism, translation, teaching, brokerage, and any role where verbal-analytical precision matters. Cancelled when Mercury is debilitated (Pisces).
LIPI_BUDDHI_MERCURY_3.career: Writing, journalism, translation, teaching, brokerage, technical communication
LIPI_BUDDHI_MERCURY_3.mind: Analytical sharpness, articulate expression, retentive memory

MAALA.name: Maala Yoga — benefics only in houses 4/7/10 per BPHS 36. Flower-garland-like all-round joy.
MAALA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36 (Dala group), Maala Yoga = benefic planets exclusively occupy the lower three kendras (4th, 7th, 10th). The "garland of flowers" pattern confers all-round auspiciousness — domestic happiness, marital joy, career fame, and pleasant relationships in every direction. One of the most reliably-positive Nabhasha yogas.
MAALA.general: All-round auspiciousness, domestic happiness, marital joy, career fame, garland-like reputation.

MADHYARISHTA_8_LORD_RETROGRADE_8.name: Madhyarishta — 8th-lord retrograde in 8th house. Trigger for unexpected mid-life crisis during its dasha.
MADHYARISHTA_8_LORD_RETROGRADE_8.prose: Madhyarishta 8-Lord-Retrograde-8 — Saravali Ch.41 — 8th-lord simultaneously retrograde and in 8th. The mortality-significator in its own house with inverted motion produces an acute mid-life crisis indication, especially during its dasha/antardasha. Remedy: 8th-lord pacification, Mahamrityunjaya-japa.

MADHYARISHTA_LAGNA_8_LORDS_DUSTHANA.name: Madhyarishta — Lagna and 8th lords in dusthana. Compromised physical constitution triggers mid-life crises.
MADHYARISHTA_LAGNA_8_LORDS_DUSTHANA.prose: Madhyarishta Lagna-8-Lords-Dusthana — Saravali Ch.41 — Lagna-lord and 8th-lord both occupying dusthanas (6, 8, 12). Both the body-significator and the mortality-significator weakened; classical reading points to mid-life serious health-crisis indication. Remedy: pacification of both lords, Mahamrityunjaya-japa, guru-kripa upasana.

MADHYARISHTA_MOON_HEMMED_4.name: Madhyarishta — Moon in 4th house hemmed by malefics. Deep emotional stress, insomnia, and domestic friction.
MADHYARISHTA_MOON_HEMMED_4.prose: Madhyarishta Moon-Hemmed-4 — Saravali Ch.41 — Moon in 4th house with malefics in 3rd and 5th, creating papa-kartari around the manas-bhava. Both mind-karaka and mind-house wounded; mental tension, insomnia, family-stress in mid-life. Remedy: Chandra-shanti, Monday-vrata, mind-pacification meditation.

MADHYARISHTA_SUN_MARS_6.name: Madhyarishta — Sun and Mars in 6th house. Intense mid-life conflicts or health crises, balanced by enemy defeat.
MADHYARISHTA_SUN_MARS_6.prose: Madhyarishta Sun-Mars-6 — Saravali Ch.41 — Sun-Mars in 6th. Atma-karaka and Mars-aggression in the enemy/illness house signal mid-life acute conflict, fevers, litigation. Compensating: powerful enemy-defeating capacity, success in military/legal/competitive contexts. Remedy: Sun-Mars pacification.

MADHYAYU_BALANCED_LORDS.name: Madhyayu — Lagna-lord and 8th-lord balanced. Middle-life indication.
MADHYAYU_BALANCED_LORDS.prose: Madhyayu Balanced-Lords — BPHS Ch.43 — Lagna-lord and 8th-lord balanced in strength: both in kendra/trikona, similar dignity, or one strong with the other moderately strong. The balance signals middle-life longevity (32-72 years). This is a doctrinally neutral indicator — neither positive nor negative, simply a span-determinant. No remedy required.

MADHYAYU_JUPITER_TRIKONA.name: Madhyayu — Jupiter in trikona. Middle-life with dharmic protection.
MADHYAYU_JUPITER_TRIKONA.prose: Madhyayu Jupiter-Trikona — Phaladeepika Ch.11 — Jupiter in a trikona (1, 5, 9). Jupiter is the longevity-karaka and supreme benefic; trikona placement provides dharmic-protection that prevents Alpayu without quite reaching Purnayu. Solid middle-life span. Remedy: Guru-kripa amplification (Gayatri, Guru-stotra) for span-extension.

MADHYAYU_LAGNA_KENDRA_8_DUSTHANA.name: Madhyayu — Lagna-lord in kendra, 8th-lord in dusthana. Middle-life.
MADHYAYU_LAGNA_KENDRA_8_DUSTHANA.prose: Madhyayu Lagna-Kendra-8-Dusthana — BPHS Ch.43 — Lagna-lord in kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) while 8th-lord in dusthana (6, 8, 12). Self-significator strong in pillar-houses while mortality-significator weakened in wounded houses — favorable asymmetry tilting toward longer middle-life. Pure Purnayu requires additional positive indicators; this on its own delivers middle-life. No remedy required.

MAHA_BHAGYA_DAY_OR_NIGHT_BIRTH.name: Maha-Bhagya — Lagna + Sun + Moon all same-parity signs (odd or even).
MAHA_BHAGYA_DAY_OR_NIGHT_BIRTH.prose:
Maha-Bhagya is the supreme tier among Bhagya yogas (Phaladeepika 6.34) — described as the foundational royal/great-fortune indication. The classical formulation distinguishes by gender and birth-time:

- **Male, day-birth (Sun above the horizon)**: Lagna AND Sun AND Moon all in **odd signs** (Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius)
- **Female, night-birth (Sun below the horizon)**: all three in **even signs** (Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces)

The parity-matching of the three primary chart-points across the gender-and-time-of-day pairing is doctrinally the strongest single indicator of great fortune. Classical commentary describes these natives as kings, queens, exceptional public figures, eminent administrators, and people whose lives carry historic significance. The yoga's TIER_1 classification places it alongside Pure-Vipareeta-Raja and Triple-Vipareeta among the supreme classical configurations.

The rule is purely structural — no lord-placement, no dignity, no aspect requirement. The parity-pattern alone suffices.
MAHA_BHAGYA_DAY_OR_NIGHT_BIRTH.career: Royal/political leadership, eminent administration, historic public roles
MAHA_BHAGYA_DAY_OR_NIGHT_BIRTH.spirituality: Sustained dharmic alignment as background to material success
MAHA_BHAGYA_DAY_OR_NIGHT_BIRTH.wealth: Supreme fortune; durable wealth across the lifespan

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_10.name: Maha Parivartana 1-10 — self inseparable from career.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_10.prose:
Maha Parivartana 1-10 — BPHS Ch.34 v.13 — the strongest career-identity yoga. Lagna-lord in 10th, 10th-lord in Lagna. Self-significator and karma-significator swap, making identity inseparable from career.

The native is defined by their profession — vocation and personality fuse into a single light. Doctrinally the most powerful parivartana variant for "name and fame"; classical signature for popular figures, public-stage personalities, and authority-centered eminence.

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_4.name: Maha Parivartana 1-4 — self and home interlinked.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_4.prose:
Maha Parivartana 1-4 — BPHS Ch.34 v.13 — Lagna-lord in 4th and 4th-lord in Lagna. Mutual exchange between the self-significator and the home-significator structurally integrates personality with home/comfort.

Domestic happiness, vehicles, maternal welfare, and emotional stability arrive as part of the native's very identity — household values sit at the center of selfhood. Natural fit for family-business or home-rooted vocations.

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_7.name: Maha Parivartana 1-7 — self and partner mirror each other.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_7.prose:
Maha Parivartana 1-7 — BPHS Ch.34 v.13 — Lagna-lord and 7th-lord exchange signs. The self-significator and partnership-significator mutually swap, producing the classical "self-mirror" structure.

Marriage tends to be long-term stable; native and partner reflect each other at the personality level — values, disposition, and life-direction align. Natural success in partnerships (business or marital).

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_4_10.name: Maha Parivartana 4-10 — kendra-axis exchange (sukha-karma).
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_4_10.prose:
Maha Parivartana 4-10 — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — 4th-lord in 10th, 10th-lord in 4th. Mutual exchange between two kendra-lords (sukha and karma) anchors structural strength in the chart's foundation-pillars.

Professional advancement is supported by home-environment stability; career and family-stability mutually reinforce. Natural fit for long-term enterprise, home-based offices, or real-estate-linked business.

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_4_7.name: Maha Parivartana 4-7 — home and partnership integrated.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_4_7.prose:
Maha Parivartana 4-7 — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — 4th-lord in 7th, 7th-lord in 4th. Home-significator and partnership-significator exchange, integrating two family-centric karaka-domains.

Domestic life and conjugal life form a single unit — partner is active in home-building; the home environment supports marital stability. Family business, joint property holdings, or home-rooted vocations supported by spousal cooperation.

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_5_10.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati 5-10 — supreme classical Raja-Yoga.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_5_10.prose:
Dharma-Karmadhipati 5-10 — BPHS Ch.34 v.13 — 5th-lord in 10th and 10th-lord in 5th. Trikona-Kendra exchange unifies purva-punya with karma — one of the strongest classical Raja Yogas in the corpus.

Intellectual capacity and authority compound each other; native's position is rooted in inherited merit AND professional accomplishment. Classical signature for leaders, education-administrators, intellectual authorities. Mirror of the 9-10 variant — both rules together produce the apex Raja-Yoga.

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_5_7.name: Maha Parivartana 5-7 — merit-and-marriage interlinked.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_5_7.prose:
Maha Parivartana 5-7 — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — 5th-lord in 7th, 7th-lord in 5th. Exchange between purva-punya (merit) and partnership integrates inherited fortune with conjugal life.

Marriage tends to be merit-driven and stable; partner is intellectually congenial, progeny arrives naturally. Love-marriage or arts/music-centered conjugal life is a classical signature.

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_7_10.name: Maha Parivartana 7-10 — partnership and career interlinked.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_7_10.prose:
Maha Parivartana 7-10 — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — 7th-lord in 10th, 10th-lord in 7th. Two kendra-lord exchange unifies partnership-domain with career-domain.

Career evolves through partnership or joint-business; spouse provides direct vocational support. Classical signature for diplomats, joint enterprise founders, or co-leadership eminence.

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_9_10.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati 9-10 — supreme classical Raja-Yoga.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_9_10.prose: Dharma-Karmadhipati 9-10 — BPHS Ch.34 v.13 — 9th-lord in 10th and 10th-lord in 9th. The canonical Dharma-Karmadhipati Yoga (mirror of 5-10): bhagya/dharma-significator and karma-sign-exchanger.

MAHENDRA_ABSENCE.name: Mahendra absence — extended-Milan koot deficit per Muhurta Chintamani 8.
MAHENDRA_ABSENCE.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi Ch.8, Mahendra Koot satisfied when bride's nakshatra is 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, or 25 nakshatras forward from groom's. ABSENCE confers reduced progeny-and-family expansion. Like Strī-Dīrgha, this is one of the extended-Milan beyond-Aṣṭa-Kūṭa checks. Significant for childless-marriage risk assessment.

MALAVYA.name: Malavya Yoga — Venus in kendra and dignity. Confers wealth, refined elegance, artistic genius, and conjugal bliss.
MALAVYA.prose: Malavya Yoga is the fourth of the Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas (BPHS Ch. 76, v. 4), embodying the peak of Venusian luxury, refinement, and artistic genius. It is constructed when Venus occupies a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) from the Ascendant or the Moon while positioned in its own sign (Taurus/Libra) or its exaltation sign (Pisces). Venus governs beauty, physical comfort, relationships, and the fine arts; hence, this yoga elevates the native's aesthetic sensibilities to the highest level. The native is typically characterized by a highly attractive physical appearance, deep magnetic charm, and a refined appreciation for music, drama, and luxury. Historically associated with beautiful homes, fine vehicles ("vehicles and ornaments," per Phaladeepika), and pleasant partners, in modern times, it produces celebrated artists, high-profile diplomats, luxury brand tycoons, and icons of the fashion and entertainment industries.
MALAVYA.body: Exceptional physical symmetry, radiant skin, highly photogenic features, and a graceful posture
MALAVYA.career: Top-tier careers in the performing arts, couture fashion, high diplomacy, cosmetic medicine, and luxury retail
MALAVYA.mind: Artistic, creative imagination, refined taste in all things, and a harmonious, diplomat-like temperament
MALAVYA.relationships: Deeply fulfilling and harmonious marriage, an elegant and supportive spouse, and high social desirability
MALAVYA.wealth: Abundant prosperity, ownership of premium real estate, high-end vehicles, and luxury collections

MALAVYA_BHANGA.name: Malavya Bhanga — Venus combust or retrograde in kendra. Malavya-yoga effects are rendered unstable or delayed.
MALAVYA_BHANGA.prose: Malavya Bhanga is created when the foundational placements of Malavya Yoga are active, but Venus is simultaneously combust (asta) by the Sun or retrograde (vakri). In Vedic astrology, Venus rules over physical comfort, financial security, and relationships. When combust, Venus's capacity to deliver smooth conjugal bliss is hampered, causing periods of emotional friction or misunderstandings between partners. The retrograde status turns the aesthetic and sensual energy inward, sometimes leading to deep-seated self-image insecurities despite physical attractiveness, or an insatiable urge for luxury that leads to reckless spending cycles. The promised Malavya benefits do manifest, but in volatile waves rather than a steady stream. Propitiating Goddess Lakshmi and observing Friday fasts (vrata) are highly effective remedies.
MALAVYA_BHANGA.body: A highly attractive appearance accompanied by body dysmorphia or self-image insecurities
MALAVYA_BHANGA.relationships: Strong relational bonds coexisting with periodic intense arguments and emotional distance
MALAVYA_BHANGA.wealth: Vast prosperity is achieved but punctuated by impulsive spending habits or sudden financial drains

MALAVYA_EXALTED.name: Supreme Malavya — Venus exalted (Pisces) in kendra. Apex aesthete-yoga conferring wealth and conjugal bliss.
MALAVYA_EXALTED.prose: Supreme Malavya represents the absolute peak of Venusian luxury, artistic design, and emotional refinement. When Venus—the significator of beauty, pleasure, and conjugal happiness—occupies its sign of deep exaltation, Pisces (at 27 degrees), within a kendra, it unleashes its most sublime qualities. Pisces, a compassionate water sign ruled by Jupiter, spiritualizes Venusian energy, channeling it into profound artistic creativity, deep empathy, and peerless elegance. The native is blessed with stunning physical beauty, an magnetic charm, and an innate talent for the arts. Unlike base Malavya, the exalted placement guarantees high social prominence and royal-tier prosperity. It produces celebrated creative artists, renowned diplomats, luxury retail magnates, and trendsetters in the fashion and entertainment fields.
MALAVYA_EXALTED.body: Stunning physical symmetry, luminous, photogenic skin, and a highly graceful posture
MALAVYA_EXALTED.mind: Pinnacle creative imagination, refined aesthetic judgment, and an exceptionally sweet, diplomatic nature
MALAVYA_EXALTED.relationships: Pinnacle conjugal bliss, marriage to an exceptionally loving and refined partner, and absolute social desirability
MALAVYA_EXALTED.wealth: Royal-tier affluence, ownership of magnificent residences, exotic vehicles, and finest lifestyle collections

MALAVYA_FROM_MOON.name: Malavya from Moon — Venus angular from the Moon in dignity. Confers a refined, highly artistic temperament.
MALAVYA_FROM_MOON.prose: Chandra Malavya Yoga is established when Venus occupies a kendra from the natal Moon while positioned in its sign of exaltation or own sign. While a Lagna-based Malavya shapes the external environments and comforts, Chandra Malavya fundamentally refines the internal aesthetic consciousness. The alignment of the Moon (governing emotions and receptivity) with Venus (governing harmony, beauty, and the arts) creates a deeply artistic, poetic, and romantic inner nature. The native possesses an innate appreciation for music, drama, fine arts, and luxurious environments. When Venus is angular from both the Lagna and the Moon simultaneously, it represents the pinnacle Malavya configuration, producing world-renowned artists, celebrated designers, and highly successful luxury entrepreneurs.
MALAVYA_FROM_MOON.mind: Exquisite artistic imagination, deep emotional intelligence, aesthetic refinement, and a highly charming disposition

MALEFIC_IN_3_6.name: Malefics in 3rd and 6th — upachaya-pāpa yoga per BPHS 7. Valour conquers enemies.
MALEFIC_IN_3_6.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, malefics in 3rd + 6th = upachaya-pāpa yoga. Malefics in upachaya bhāvas convert their natural sharpness into beneficial growth — valour-driven enemy-conquest, bold action, military/legal-profession aptitude, and debt control. Classical "pāpa in pāpa-sthāna = śubha" inversion.
MALEFIC_IN_3_6.general: Valour over enemies, bold action, military/legal aptitude, debt control, sibling support.

MALEFIC_IN_3_6_11.name: Malefics in 3rd, 6th, and 11th — sarva-upachaya-pāpa yoga per BPHS 7. Comprehensive prosperity.
MALEFIC_IN_3_6_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, malefics in all three upachayas (3, 6, 11) = sarva-upachaya-pāpa yoga. Combines valour-conquest (3rd-6th) with adversarial-gain (6th-11th) into comprehensive prosperity: total parākrama-śatrujaya-dhana fusion. The supreme upachaya-yoga, where each malefic in its right house becomes a force-multiplier rather than an affliction.
MALEFIC_IN_3_6_11.general: Sarva-upachaya-pāpa yoga, comprehensive prosperity, full valour-conquest-wealth fusion, all-direction growth.

MALEFIC_IN_6_11.name: Malefics in 6th and 11th — Śatru-Lābha Yoga per BPHS 7. Adversarial work yields gains.
MALEFIC_IN_6_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, malefics in 6th + 11th = Śatru-Lābha Yoga. Adversarial-arena work (medicine, law, security, litigation) yields sustained financial gains, debt control, and elder-sibling support. Like upachaya-pāpa: malefics in growth-houses become productive engines of struggle-driven prosperity.
MALEFIC_IN_6_11.general: Śatru-Lābha Yoga, adversarial-work gains, sustained financial flow, service-profession aptitude.

MANGAL_DOSHA.name: Maṅgala Dosha — Mars in 1/2/4/7/8/12 from Lagna/Moon/Venus per BPHS 80. Marital strain.
MANGAL_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.80, Maṅgala Dosha (Mangalik) = Mars in houses 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, or 12 — checked from THREE reference points (Lagna, Moon, Venus). Confers risk of marital strain, separation, partner-health concerns, and marriage delay. Phaladeepika Ch.16 enumerates ten classical cancellations (Mars own/exalted in those houses, beneficial aspect from Jupiter, partner with same dosha, etc.). Severity is house-weighted: 7th=100, 8th=90, 1st=70, 2nd=60, 4th/12th=50.
MANGAL_DOSHA.general: Marital strain, separation risk, partner-health concerns, marriage delay, multiple cancellations available.

MARKESHA_2_7_DUSTHANA.name: Markesha — 2nd/7th-lords in dusthana. Death-inflicting markesha activated.
MARKESHA_2_7_DUSTHANA.prose: Markesha 2-7-Dusthana — Saravali Ch.41 — 2nd-lord or 7th-lord (the two classical maraka-positions) occupies a dusthana (6, 8, 12). The doctrine names these lords as "markeshas" — death-inflicting agents whose dasha/antardasha periods carry heightened mortality-pressure. Remedy: markesha-lord pacification, Mahamrityunjaya-japa, guru-kripa. Strong Jupiter or benefic aspect progressively softens the indication.

MARS_IN_10.name: Mars in 10th: dig-balī Karma Raja Yoga. Military leadership, intense effort, royal honour per Phaladeepika 8.
MARS_IN_10.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mars in the 10th forms a special Karma Raja Yoga — Mars in the karma-bhava is dig-balī (directionally strong), conferring military/leadership capability, intense work-ethic, royal recognition, and heroic fame. BPHS Ch.24 — dig-balī Mars augments career fame. Common in generals, surgeons, athletes, and high-action executives.
MARS_IN_10.general: Dig-balī Karma Raja Yoga, military leadership, intense effort, royal recognition, heroic fame.

MARS_IN_11.name: Mars in 11th: Lābha-Śaurya Yoga. Courage-driven gains, elder-sibling growth per Phaladeepika 8.
MARS_IN_11.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mars in the 11th forms a Lābha-Śaurya Yoga — courage-driven gains, elder-sibling growth, and entrepreneurial desire-fulfilment. BPHS Ch.24 — Mars in the gain-bhava augments all life-domains. Common in self-made entrepreneurs and competitive-industry leaders.
MARS_IN_11.general: Lābha-Śaurya Yoga, courage-driven gains, elder-sibling growth, entrepreneurial drive, desire-fulfilment.

MARS_IN_3.name: Mars in 3rd: Parākrama Yoga (kāraka-kāraka). Heroic valour, sibling power, self-effort per Phaladeepika 8.
MARS_IN_3.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mars in the 3rd forms a Parākrama Yoga — kāraka-kāraka where Mars (kāraka of valour + siblings) sits in parākrama-bhava itself. The native enjoys heroic valour, powerful siblings, self-effort prosperity, and entrepreneurial drive. BPHS Ch.24 — Mars yields supreme effects only in upachaya bhavas (3/6/10/11). Common in soldiers, athletes, and self-made entrepreneurs.
MARS_IN_3.general: Parākrama Yoga, heroic valour, sibling power, self-effort prosperity, entrepreneurial drive.

MARS_IN_6.name: Mars in 6th: enemy-victory yoga. Disease-conquest, debt-cancellation, physical strength per Phaladeepika 8.
MARS_IN_6.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mars in the 6th forms a Vipareeta-style enemy-victory yoga — Mars's aggressive energy in the enemy-bhava conquers enemies, defeats disease, and cancels debt. BPHS Ch.24 — Mars in the 6th (an upachaya) is exceptionally strength-conferring. Common in athletes, military personnel, and litigators.
MARS_IN_6.general: Enemy-victory, disease-conquest, debt-cancellation, physical strength, courage.

MARS_IN_9.name: Mars in 9th — Pitṛ-Śaurya yoga (named-classical) per Phaladeepika 8.
MARS_IN_9.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8 (named-classical variant), Mars in 9th = Pitṛ-Śaurya yoga. Confers paternal-lineage radiant valour, religious-travel-and-action karma, military/warrior-class lineage fame, and dharma-karma capability. The yoga's name signals heroic conduct rooted in ancestral heritage.
MARS_IN_9.general: Pitṛ-Śaurya yoga, paternal-lineage radiance, religious valour, warrior-lineage fame, dharma-karma capability.

MARS_KETU_CONJ.name: Mars-Ketu conjunction — afflictive yoga per BPHS 7. Sudden-accident risk, fire-danger.
MARS_KETU_CONJ.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, Mars-Ketu conjunction is an afflictive yoga — twin-malefic union confers sudden-accident proneness, fire/burn danger, hidden-enemy trouble, and bold but directionless action. Classical commentaries recommend mantra-pacification (Hanuman/Ganesha) and donation-based remedial measures.
MARS_KETU_CONJ.general: Sudden-accident risk, fire-danger, hidden-enemy trouble, directionless bold action.

MARS_MER_CONJ.name: Mars-Mercury conjunction — skill-sharpness union per Saravali 15. Craft-skilled, sharp-tongued.
MARS_MER_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Mars-Mercury conjunction = skill-sharpness union. Warrior-significator with speech-significator confers craft-skill, sharp/cutting speech, strategic capability, and weapon-knowledge mastery. Sharp-intellect aptitude. Common in engineers, surgeons, attorneys, and tactical-minded professionals.
MARS_MER_CONJ.general: Craft-skill, sharp speech, strategic capability, weapon/technical knowledge.

MARS_RAHU_CONJ.name: Mars-Rahu conjunction — Aṅgāraka Yoga per BPHS 7. Explosive anger, reckless action.
MARS_RAHU_CONJ.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, Mars-Rahu conjunction = Aṅgāraka Yoga (lit. "blazing-coal" yoga). Twin malefic union confers explosive anger, reckless/criminal-tendency action, sudden-violence proneness, and fire/weapon-related danger. One of the most challenging conjunctions in the corpus — requires significant remedial measures (mantras, fasts, charity).
MARS_RAHU_CONJ.general: Aṅgāraka Yoga, explosive anger, reckless action, sudden violence, fire/weapon danger.

MARS_SAT_RAHU_CONJ.name: Mars-Saturn-Rahu triple — Mahā-Duryoga per BPHS 7. Long hardship, many enemies, sudden danger.
MARS_SAT_RAHU_CONJ.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, Mars-Saturn-Rahu triple conjunction = Mahā-Duryoga (great-malefic-yoga). Three malefics in same-sign confluence confer long-term hardship, multiple enemies, sudden-disaster proneness, and dharma-abandonment risk. The most challenging triple-conjunction in the corpus — extensive remedial measures (homa, fasting, charity, mantra-pacification of all three planets) classically prescribed.
MARS_SAT_RAHU_CONJ.general: Mahā-Duryoga, sustained hardship, multiple enemies, sudden danger, dharma-risk.

MARS_VEN_CONJ.name: Mars-Venus conjunction — passion-warrior union per Saravali 15. Strong libido, multiple relationships.
MARS_VEN_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Mars-Venus conjunction = passion-warrior union. Warrior-significator with pleasure-significator confers strong libido, multiple relationships, attraction to dramatic/intense arts, and bold creative work. Marital strain occasionally results from the dynamic-passion blend. Common in performers, athletes, and intensely-romantic personalities.
MARS_VEN_CONJ.general: Strong libido, multiple relationships, intense-art inclination, marital strain risk.

MARUT.name: Marut Yoga — air-element-centred auspicious yoga. Travel/speech/trade fame per Phaladeepika 6.
MARUT.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Marut Yoga arises when benefic planets occupy kendras/trikoṇas in air-element signs (Gemini, Libra, Aquarius). The native attains fame in travel, speech, trade, communication-related professions, and diplomatic/messenger roles. The yoga's "vāyu" (Marut) flavour ties success to mobility and information-flow rather than rooted accumulation.
MARUT.general: Travel fame, speech/trade skill, communication-industry fame, diplomatic/messenger aptitude.

MATRI_DOSHA.name: Mātṛ Dosha — 4th lord/Moon weak or afflicted per BPHS 22. Maternal challenges.
MATRI_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.22, Mātṛ (mother) Dosha = 4th lord OR Moon (twin maternal-significators) afflicted by dusthana placement or malefic conjunction. Confers maternal-health concerns, mother-separation risk, domestic-peace reduction. Both significators must be checked: even if 4th lord is strong, an afflicted Moon can still trigger the dosha. Mitigated by Moon-strength remediation, Chandra-mantra, gau-mata service.
MATRI_DOSHA.general: Maternal-health concerns, mother-separation risk, domestic-peace reduction.

MATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_4.name: Matr-Sukha — benefic in 4th. Mother, home, and education flourish.
MATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_4.prose:
Matr-Sukha-Benefic-4 forms when a natural benefic (Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, or unwounded Moon) occupies the 4th house. The benefic irrigates the 4th-bhava across all four karaka-domains: mother (matr), home (sukha), education (vidya), and vehicles (yana).

The native enjoys maternal affection, settled residence, accessible education, and overall emotional security. The yoga delivers full results only when no malefic shares the 4th — malefic co-occupation cancels the configuration, since cruel grahas wound the comfort-house even when benefics are present.

MATSYA.name: Matsya Yoga — benefics in movable signs, malefics with Moon per Saravali 34.
MATSYA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Matsya (fish) Yoga = benefics in movable signs while malefics share Moon's sign. The "fish" name signals a fluid life-stream — foreign travel, ocean/sea-related work, mobile residence, exceptional adaptability. Native flows around obstacles like a fish through currents.
MATSYA.general: Foreign travel, ocean-related work, mobile residence, adaptability, journey-fame.

MER_IN_1.name: Mercury in Lagna: eloquence, intellect, wit, youthful presence per Phaladeepika 8 / BPHS 23.
MER_IN_1.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mercury in Lagna confers eloquence, intellect, wit, a youthful presence, and skill in mathematics/sciences. BPHS Ch.23 — Mercury in the body-bhava grants quick intelligence and communication skill. Common in writers, journalists, mathematicians, and analytic professionals.
MER_IN_1.general: Eloquence, intellect, wit, youthful presence, mathematical/scientific skill.

MER_IN_10.name: Mercury in 10th: Karma-Vāk Raja Yoga. Career fame via intellect/communication per Phaladeepika 8.
MER_IN_10.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mercury in the 10th forms a Karma-Vāk Raja Yoga — kāraka-kendra union. Career fame through intellect and communication, royal recognition, and high office. BPHS Ch.23 — career-significator joining career-bhava. Common in journalists, consultants, executives, and analytic-profession leaders.
MER_IN_10.general: Karma-Vāk Raja Yoga, intellect-communication fame, royal recognition, high office, business reputation.

MER_IN_11.name: Mercury in 11th: Lābha-Vāk Yoga. Continuous business gains, network-driven income per Phaladeepika 8.
MER_IN_11.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mercury in the 11th forms a Lābha-Vāk Yoga — continuous business gains, friend-network communication skill, speculation profits, and steady desire-fulfilment. BPHS Ch.23 — Mercury in the gain-bhava augments all life-domains. Common in network-dependent businesses (sales, brokerage, journalism).
MER_IN_11.general: Lābha-Vāk Yoga, continuous business gains, network communication, speculation profits, desire-fulfilment.

MER_IN_2.name: Mercury in 2nd: Vāk-Dhana Yoga. Sweet speech, business acumen, family support per Phaladeepika 8.
MER_IN_2.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mercury in the 2nd forms a Vāk-Dhana Yoga — sweet speech, family support, wealth via business acumen, and a charming presentation. BPHS Ch.23 — speech-kāraka in the wealth-bhava produces income through articulation. Common in salesmen, traders, brokers, and those whose speech is their livelihood.
MER_IN_2.general: Vāk-Dhana Yoga, sweet speech, business acumen, family support, charming manner.

MER_IN_4.name: Mercury in 4th: Vidyā-Gṛha Yoga. Maternal happiness, scholarly householder per Phaladeepika 8.
MER_IN_4.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mercury in the 4th forms a Vidyā-Gṛha Yoga — maternal happiness, scholarly householder disposition, ample home/vehicles, and ethical manners. BPHS Ch.23 — Mercury in the comfort-bhava augments learning and domestic harmony. Common in academics whose home is their library.
MER_IN_4.general: Vidyā-Gṛha Yoga, maternal happiness, home/vehicles, ethical manner, heart-peace.

MER_IN_5.name: Mercury in 5th: Prajñā Raja Yoga (kāraka-trikoṇa). Intellect, speculation skill per Phaladeepika 8.
MER_IN_5.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mercury in the 5th forms a Prajñā Raja Yoga — kāraka-trikoṇa where the learning-significator joins past-merit. The native enjoys keen intellect, mantra-siddhi, speculation/share-market skill, mathematical fame, and progeny happiness. BPHS Ch.23 — vidyā-kāraka fructifying through poorva-punya. Common in mathematicians, financial analysts, and skilled speculators.
MER_IN_5.general: Prajñā Raja Yoga, mantra-siddhi, speculation skill, mathematical fame, progeny happiness.

MER_IN_7.name: Mercury in 7th: Vyāpāra-Kalatra Yoga. Intelligent partner, partnership business per Phaladeepika 8.
MER_IN_7.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Mercury in the 7th forms a Vyāpāra-Kalatra Yoga — intelligent partner, business acumen, partnership-driven growth, and gainful travel. BPHS Ch.23 — Mercury in kalatra-bhava augments business speech and contract-making. Common in joint-venture entrepreneurs and partnership-business heirs.
MER_IN_7.general: Vyāpāra-Kalatra Yoga, intelligent partner, partnership skill, gainful travel, ethical business.

MER_JUP_CONJ.name: Mercury-Jupiter conjunction — Mahā-Prajñā Yoga per Saravali 15. Scholar, guru-radiance.
MER_JUP_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Mercury-Jupiter conjunction = Mahā-Prajñā Yoga. Twin intellect-significators in same-colour (sattva) fusion produce supreme scholarship, teacher-radiance, mastery of all scriptures, and fame in logic/mathematics. Among the most exalted conjunctions in the corpus. Signature of academics, philosophers, and intellectual luminaries.
MER_JUP_CONJ.general: Mahā-Prajñā Yoga, supreme scholarship, teacher-radiance, scriptural mastery, logic/math fame.

MER_SAT_CONJ.name: Mercury-Saturn conjunction — deep-intellect union per Saravali 15. Logician, deep researcher.
MER_SAT_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Mercury-Saturn conjunction = deep-intellect union. Intellect-significator with karma-significator confers logician/analyst capability, deep-research aptitude, labour-endurance, and organisational mastery. Long-haul work capability. Common in scientists, scholars of structure, and disciplined long-term thinkers.
MER_SAT_CONJ.general: Deep intellect, logical capability, deep research, organisational mastery, labour endurance.

MER_VEN_CONJ.name: Mercury-Venus conjunction — poetry-art union per Saravali 15. Poet-skilled, sweet-voiced singer.
MER_VEN_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Mercury-Venus conjunction = poetry-art union. Intellect-significator with art-significator confers poetic skill, melodious voice, painting/visual-art inclination, and female-favoured manner. Common in lyricists, musicians, fine-artists, and the chronically charming.
MER_VEN_CONJ.general: Poetic skill, melodious voice, painting/art inclination, female-favoured manner.

MOOL_DOSHA.name: Mool Dosha — Mool/Jyeshtha/Ashlesha/Magha/Revati nakshatra birth per Narada Samhita.
MOOL_DOSHA.prose: Per Nārada Saṃhitā, Mool Dosha = birth in one of the gaṇḍānta-flanking or nāga-class nakshatras (Mūla, Jyeṣṭhā, Aśleṣā, Maghā, Revatī). Confers paternal-lineage challenges (especially when born in 1st-pāda of certain nakshatras), childhood-health concerns, and pāda-specific severity gradation. Classical remedy: 27-day Mūla-śānti vrata observance, often performed by the parents on behalf of the child.
MOOL_DOSHA.general: Paternal-lineage challenges, childhood-health concerns, pāda-graded severity.

MOON_5_PUTRA.name: Moon-Putra — Moon well-placed in 5th. Strong emotional bond with children.
MOON_5_PUTRA.prose:
Moon-Putra forms when the Moon — natural significator of mind (manas) and mother (matr) — occupies the 5th in own, exalted, mooltrikona, friendly, or neutral dignity. The Moon's feeling-function fuses with the progeny-house, granting an unusually deep emotional bond between parent and child.

Natives intuitively read their children's emotional states; nurturing tends toward maternal warmth regardless of the parent's gender. Offspring grow up emotionally-intellectually balanced, often with strong artistic or empathic gifts. Debilitated Moon in 5 weakens the yoga — emotional turbulence may transfer to the parent-child bond.

MOON_EXALTED_KENDRA.name: Moon exalted in Kendra: Mahā-Raja Yoga. Mental power, mass appeal, profound mother-bond per Saravali 38.
MOON_EXALTED_KENDRA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.38, Moon exalted in a kendra forms a Mahā-Raja Yoga — Taurus-exalted Moon in 1/4/7/10 acquires a double-strength (exaltation + kendra) that delivers exceptional mental power, mass-emotional appeal, profound mother-bond, and "heart-emperor" persona. Phaladeepika Ch.8 — comparable to Gaja-Kesari Yoga in scale. Common in mass-cultural icons and emotionally-resonant leaders.
MOON_EXALTED_KENDRA.general: Mahā-Raja Yoga, mental power, mass appeal, profound mother-bond, heart-emperor persona.

MOON_IN_1.name: Moon in Lagna: emotionally rich, fair-complexioned, mother-bonded, sensorially abundant per Phaladeepika 8.
MOON_IN_1.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Moon in Lagna confers emotional richness, fair complexion, strong mother-bond, sensory abundance, and sensitivity. BPHS Ch.22 — many Bhāva-kāraka yogas form from Chandra-Lagna (the Moon as auxiliary ascendant for relationship-/emotion-domain readings). Common in caregivers, hospitality professionals, and emotionally-attuned creatives.
MOON_IN_1.general: Emotional richness, fair complexion, mother-bond, sensory abundance, sensitivity.

MOON_IN_10.name: Moon in 10th: Karma-Kāraka Raja Yoga. Public-favoured career, entertainment industry per Phaladeepika 8.
MOON_IN_10.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Moon in the 10th forms a Karma-Kāraka Raja Yoga — public-favoured career, entertainment-industry success, mother-career synergy, and intense work-output. BPHS Ch.22 — Moon in karma-bhava augments public-recognition fame. Common in entertainers, hospitality professionals, and politicians whose appeal is mass-emotional.
MOON_IN_10.general: Karma-Kāraka Raja Yoga, public-favoured career, entertainment industry, mother-career synergy, intense effort.

MOON_IN_11.name: Moon in 11th: Lābha-Mano Yoga. Continuous wealth, friend/heart-fame per Phaladeepika 8.
MOON_IN_11.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Moon in the 11th forms a Lābha-Mano Yoga — continuous wealth gains, friend/family-driven emotional fulfilment, elder-sibling support, and steady desire-fulfilment. BPHS Ch.22 — Moon in the gain-bhava augments all life-domains. Common in those whose income flows from public goodwill or social network.
MOON_IN_11.general: Lābha-Mano Yoga, continuous wealth, friend/heart-fame, elder-sibling support, desire-fulfilment.

MOON_IN_2.name: Moon in 2nd — Mano-Dhana yoga (named-classical) per Phaladeepika 8.
MOON_IN_2.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8 (named-classical variant), Moon in 2nd = Mano-Dhana yoga. Confers melodious voice, abundant wealth-flow, mother-fond family expansion, and emotionally-attuned manner. The mind's gentle radiance permeates the wealth/family bhāva.
MOON_IN_2.general: Melodious voice, abundant wealth, mother-fond family, emotional manner, family support.

MOON_IN_4.name: Moon in 4th: dig-balī Mātṛ-Gṛha Raja Yoga. Profound maternal happiness, heart-peace per Phaladeepika 8.
MOON_IN_4.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Moon in the 4th forms a dig-balī Mātṛ-Gṛha Raja Yoga — the Moon (kāraka of mother + heart) is directionally exalted in the comfort-bhava itself. The native enjoys profound maternal happiness, domestic peace, heart-contentment, and dharmic householder life. BPHS Ch.22 — the Moon's 4th-house placement is its supreme directional strength. Signature of those rooted in family and home.
MOON_IN_4.general: Dig-balī Mātṛ-Gṛha Raja Yoga, profound maternal happiness, heart-peace, domestic prosperity, dharmic householder.

MOON_IN_5.name: Moon in 5th: Mano-Prajñā Raja Yoga (kāraka-trikoṇa). Intellect, progeny, mantra skill per Phaladeepika 8.
MOON_IN_5.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Moon in the 5th forms a Mano-Prajñā Raja Yoga — the mind-significator in the bhava of past-merit and progeny. The native enjoys intuitive intellect, progeny happiness, mantra-skill, and fame for emotional intelligence. BPHS Ch.22 — kāraka-trikoṇa Raja-yoga. Common in poets, devotional musicians, and spiritually-attuned counselors.
MOON_IN_5.general: Mano-Prajñā Raja Yoga, intuitive intellect, progeny, mantra skill, emotional-intelligence fame.

MOON_IN_7.name: Moon in 7th: emotionally-rich spousal yoga. Gentle spouse, gainful travel, empathetic disposition per Phaladeepika 8.
MOON_IN_7.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Moon in the 7th forms an emotionally-rich spousal yoga — gentle spouse, gainful travel, cooperative business, and natural counsellor-quality. BPHS Ch.22 — Moon in kalatra-bhava produces empathetic interpersonal style. Common in therapists, mediators, and partnership-oriented professionals.
MOON_IN_7.general: Emotional spousal yoga, gentle spouse, gainful travel, cooperative business, counsellor temperament.

MOON_IN_9.name: Moon in 9th — Mātṛ-Bhāgya yoga (named-classical) per Phaladeepika 8.
MOON_IN_9.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8 (named-classical variant), Moon in 9th = Mātṛ-Bhāgya yoga. Confers mother-mediated fortune-rise, religious travel, emotionally-engaged dharmic disposition, and guru-grace synergy. The mother's blessing actively shapes destiny in this placement.
MOON_IN_9.general: Mother-mediated fortune, religious travel, emotional dharma, guru-grace synergy.

MOON_JUP_CONJ.name: Moon-Jupiter conjunction — Gaja-Kesari-like per Brihat Jataka 13. Wisdom, fame, dharma, guru-grace.
MOON_JUP_CONJ.prose: Per Brihat Jataka Ch.13, Moon-Jupiter conjunction confers a Gaja-Kesari-like prajñā-yaśa-dharma synergy. The mind-significator and wisdom-significator unite, producing supremely religious, intellectually distinguished, famous, and guru-favoured natives. Among the most foundational positive yogas in the entire corpus.
MOON_JUP_CONJ.general: Gaja-Kesari-like fruit, wisdom, fame, dharma, guru-grace, all-round auspiciousness.

MOON_MARS_CONJ.name: Moon-Mars conjunction — Chandra-Maṅgala Raja Yoga. Self-earned wealth, warrior radiance per Saravali 15.
MOON_MARS_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Moon-Mars conjunction forms the Chandra-Maṅgala Raja Yoga — mind-significator joining warrior-significator. Confers self-earned wealth, warrior-class radiance, abundant accumulation, and adventurous business. Phaladeepika ranks it among the foremost wealth yogas. Common in self-made entrepreneurs whose drive is emotionally-fuelled.
MOON_MARS_CONJ.general: Chandra-Maṅgala Raja Yoga, self-earned wealth, warrior radiance, adventurous business.

MOON_MER_CONJ.name: Moon-Mercury conjunction — Mind-Intellect union. Sweet speech, multilingual skill per Saravali 15.
MOON_MER_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Moon-Mercury conjunction forms a Mind-Intellect union — sweet speech, multilingual ability, literary fame, fine-arts capability, and pleasant manner. The same-colour (sattva) union of two intellectual benefics yields auspicious fruit. Common in writers, poets, translators, and beloved-presenter type personalities.
MOON_MER_CONJ.general: Sweet speech, multilingual skill, literary fame, fine-arts capability, pleasant manner.

MOON_VEN_CONJ.name: Moon-Venus conjunction — beauty-pleasure union per Saravali 15. Artistic, charming, sensorially abundant.
MOON_VEN_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Moon-Venus conjunction = beauty-pleasure union. The mind-significator joining art-significator confers artistic temperament, attractive personality, female favour, musical inclination, and sensory abundance. Among the most charm-conferring of all conjunctions. Common in performers, designers, and emotionally-charismatic figures.
MOON_VEN_CONJ.general: Artistic temperament, attractive personality, female favour, musical inclination, sensory abundance.

MRIDANGA.name: Mridaṅga Yoga — 10th lord in mūla-trikoṇa aspected by benefic per Phaladeepika 6.
MRIDANGA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Mridaṅga Yoga = the 10th lord in its own mūla-trikoṇa house aspected by benefic. The "mridaṅga drum" name signals royal-ceremonial fame and recognition-amplifying career: a drummer at the king's court whose fame echoes through the realm. Common in performers, ceremonial-role professionals, and recognition-driven careerists.
MRIDANGA.general: Royal-ceremonial fame, recognition-amplifying career, music/art reputation, career auspiciousness.

MRITYUBHAGA_8_LORD_DEBIL_IN_8.name: Mrityubhaga — 8th-lord debilitated in 8th. Vish-kala (death-trigger) marker.
MRITYUBHAGA_8_LORD_DEBIL_IN_8.prose: Mrityubhaga 8-Lord-Debil-in-8 — BPHS Ch.43 — 8th-lord simultaneously debilitated AND in the 8th house. Although own-house occupation usually rescues a dusthana-lord, debility cancels the rescue; the mortality-significator becomes a "vish-kala" (death-trigger) marker. The dasha/antardasha timing of this lord becomes prognostically significant. Remedy: Mahamrityunjaya-japa, 8th-lord pacification, guru-kripa upasana.

MRITYU_BHAGA_DOSHA.name: Mrityu Bhaga Dosha — a graha at its fatal death-degree in its sign per Jataka Parijata.
MRITYU_BHAGA_DOSHA.prose: Per Jataka Parijata, every graha has a fixed "death-portion" (mrityu-bhaga) degree in each sign. A graha within ~1° of its tabulated degree for the sign it occupies turns its significations toward affliction — the house it sits in, the house it rules, and its natural karaka-ships all suffer. The Lagna, Moon, or Sun at Mrityu Bhaga is the classical arishta (early-danger) trigger. Remedy: Mahamrityunjaya japa and propitiation of the afflicted planet.
MRITYU_BHAGA_DOSHA.general: Affliction of the planet at its death-degree and the houses it touches; arishta risk for luminary/Lagna.

MUSALA.name: Musala Yoga — 7 planets in fixed signs per BPHS 36. Steady, determined temperament.
MUSALA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Musala Yoga = 7 grahas in fixed signs (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius). Native is firm-natured, steady at work, hard-working, wealth-preserving, and possesses the "musala" (pestle) like solid character. The most stability-conferring of the three Ashraya yogas — favours accumulators and long-game players.
MUSALA.general: Steady nature, fixed work-output, perseverance, wealth preservation, solid character.

NADI_DOSHA.name: Nadi Dosha — same nāḍī between bride/groom per Muhurta Chintamani 6. Progeny-health risk.
NADI_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi Ch.6, Nāḍī Koot is the most heavily-weighted (8/8 points) of the eight Aṣṭa-Kūṭa criteria. When the bride and groom share the same nāḍī (Ādi/Madhya/Antya — derived from nakshatra), the koot scores zero, signalling progeny-health risk, conception difficulty, and reduced marital harmony. Classical exceptions: same Rāśi but different nakshatra, same nakshatra-pāda groupings — both classically nullify the dosha. Highest-priority Milan check.
NADI_DOSHA.general: Progeny-health risk, conception difficulty, reduced marital harmony.

NAGA_DOSHA.name: Nāga Dosha — afflicted Rahu in 5th house per Mansagari 5. Progeny challenges.
NAGA_DOSHA.prose: Per Mansagari Ch.5, Nāga Dosha = Rahu in 5th (progeny-bhāva) afflicted by malefic aspect or weak placement. Confers progeny-related karmic challenges, miscarriage proneness, and child-health concerns. Classical interpretation: past-life serpent-kāraka offence (nāga-śāpa). Remedies: Nāga-pūjā, Nāga-Pañcamī vrata observance.
NAGA_DOSHA.general: Progeny challenges, miscarriage tendency, child-health concerns, serpent-karma resolution needed.

NALA.name: Nala Yoga — 7 planets in dual signs per BPHS 36. Adaptable, middle-path temperament.
NALA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Nala Yoga = 7 grahas in dual/mutable signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces). Native is adaptable, walks the middle path, engages in dual karmas (e.g., two professions), and capable in both directions. The "nala" (reed) name signals flexibility — bends without breaking.
NALA.general: Adaptability, middle-path orientation, dual karmas, dual-domain capability, flexibility.

NAUKHA.name: Naukha Yoga — 7 grahas in 1st through 7th sequentially per BPHS 36. Boat-like traveller-trader.
NAUKHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Naukha Yoga = 7 grahas in 1-7 sequentially. The "boat" pattern confers travel-trading temperament, sea-related/ocean-route work, foreign residence or travel-based career. Common in maritime, trade, expatriate, and tourism-industry professionals.
NAUKHA.general: Travel-trading work, ocean/sea-related career, foreign residence, journey-based fame.

NEECHA_BHANGA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.name: Neecha-Bhanga — benefic aspects the debilitated planet. Aspect-cancellation.
NEECHA_BHANGA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.prose:
Neecha-Bhanga Variant 4 — BPHS Ch.38.12 condition 4. Fires when any natural benefic (Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, unwounded Moon) aspects the debilitated graha. All benefics' standard 7th-aspect counts; Jupiter's special 5th and 9th aspects also count.

The benefic aspect purifies the debilitated karaka by superimposing benefic karaka-function. This is the simplest and most common neecha-bhanga, appearing across many charts.

Clinical signature: the karaka-domain of the debilitated graha receives grace-flow at moments of crisis; benefic figures intervene periodically to rescue the situation.

NEECHA_BHANGA_D9_EXALT.name: Neecha-Bhanga — debilitated planet exalted in D9. Divisional cancellation.
NEECHA_BHANGA_D9_EXALT.prose:
Neecha-Bhanga Variant 3 — BPHS Ch.38.12 condition 3. Fires when a debilitated graha (in the rashi-chakra D1) occupies its exaltation-sign in the navamsha (D9). The Navamsha represents dharmic potency and inner essence; D9 exaltation reverses the outer weakness with inner strength.

Classical commentary rates this among the strongest neecha-bhanga variants since the Navamsha is doctrinally weighted as several times more potent than the rashi-chart for inner-life and dharmic outcomes.

Clinical signature: apparent outer weakness in the karaka-domain coexisting with extraordinary inner power; dharmic/spiritual currents provide unusual support; the final outcome dramatically exceeds initial appearance.
NEECHA_BHANGA_D9_EXALT.career: Final outcome dramatically exceeds early showing

NEECHA_BHANGA_DEBIL_LORD_KENDRA.name: Neecha-Bhanga — lord of debilitation sign in kendra. Defect-source neutralized.
NEECHA_BHANGA_DEBIL_LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Neecha-Bhanga Variant 1 — BPHS Ch.38.12 condition 1. Fires when the lord of the debilitation-sign of the debilitated planet sits in a kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from the Lagna OR from the Moon.

Example: a debilitated Sun (in Libra); Libra's lord is Venus; if Venus occupies a kendra from Lagna or Moon, this Bhanga activates. The structural relationship between the defect-source and its controlling lord, anchored in a foundation-pillar of the chart, neutralizes the debility doctrinally.

Clinical signature: early struggle in the karaka-domain of the debilitated graha followed by firm authority; the karaka eventually delivers benefic results despite the natal weakness.
NEECHA_BHANGA_DEBIL_LORD_KENDRA.career: Early struggle followed by firm authority

NEECHA_BHANGA_EXALT_LORD_KENDRA.name: Neecha-Bhanga — lord of exaltation sign in kendra. Lift-protection.
