NEECHA_BHANGA_EXALT_LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Neecha-Bhanga Variant 6 — BPHS Ch.38.12 condition 6. Fires when the lord of the exaltation-sign of the debilitated graha occupies a kendra from Lagna or Moon.

Example: a debilitated Sun (in Libra); the Sun's exaltation-sign is Aries; Aries' lord is Mars; if Mars is in a kendra from Lagna or Moon, this Bhanga activates. The lord of the lift-direction stationed in a foundation-pillar steers the debilitated graha toward its exaltation-state when timing permits.

Clinical signature: an invisible "lift-readiness" structure in the karaka-domain of the debilitated graha; powerful uplift in the appropriate dasha/antardasha period.
NEECHA_BHANGA_EXALT_LORD_KENDRA.mind: Significant rise during appropriate dasha period

NEECHA_BHANGA_EXALT_PLANET_KENDRA.name: Neecha-Bhanga — planet exalted in debil-sign sits in kendra.
NEECHA_BHANGA_EXALT_PLANET_KENDRA.prose:
Neecha-Bhanga Variant 2 — BPHS Ch.38.12 condition 2. Fires when the planet that would be exalted in the debilitated graha's debilitation-sign occupies a kendra from Lagna or Moon.

Example: a debilitated Sun (in Libra); the planet exalted in Libra is Saturn; if Saturn is in a kendra from Lagna or Moon, this Bhanga activates. The exalted-counterpart in a foundation-pillar lends "inverse-strength" support to the debilitated graha within its own debilitation-seat.

Clinical signature: support arrives in the debilitated graha's karaka-domain from unexpected sources; powerful figures aid the native's rise.

NEECHA_BHANGA_OWN_NAVAMSA.name: Neecha-Bhanga — debilitated planet in own Navamsha. Own-house rescue.
NEECHA_BHANGA_OWN_NAVAMSA.prose:
Neecha-Bhanga Variant 5 — Mantreswara extension preserved in Phaladeepika 6. Fires when a debilitated graha occupies its own sign in the Navamsha (D9), even though debilitated in the rashi-chart.

This variant grants vargottama-equivalent strength: own-sign occupation in the Navamsha provides "own-house rescue" at the inner-essence level. The graha may be wounded in the outer chart but is structurally stable in its dharmic foundation.

Clinical signature: hidden native talent in the karaka-domain that surfaces with maturity; inner skill emerging gradually; a balance between D1-weakness and D9-stability that resolves through the lifespan.
NEECHA_BHANGA_OWN_NAVAMSA.career: Gradual inner unfolding rather than sudden break
NEECHA_BHANGA_OWN_NAVAMSA.mind: Hidden native talent emerging with maturity

NEECHA_BHANGA_RAJA.name: Neecha-Bhanga Raja-Yoga — aggregate. Debility cancelled, raja-yoga effect.
NEECHA_BHANGA_RAJA.prose:
Neecha-Bhanga Raja-Yoga — BPHS Ch.38 v.12 + Phaladeepika Ch.6 — the aggregate yoga that fires when ANY of the seven classical neecha-bhanga conditions is satisfied for any debilitated planet in the chart. Each individual variant rule (DEBIL_LORD_KENDRA through RETROGRADE) ALSO fires alongside, so the report shows both the umbrella result and the specific cancellation source.

Doctrinally rated equivalent in strength to a Vipareeta-Raja-Yoga: the wounded position of the debilitated graha is structurally inverted into the seat of an unexpected raja-yoga. Classical signature: difficult start in life followed by extraordinary later achievement; rise from low-station to commanding authority.
NEECHA_BHANGA_RAJA.career: Unexpected raja-yoga effect, rise from low station

NEECHA_BHANGA_RETROGRADE.name: Neecha-Bhanga — retrograde debilitated planet. Vakri-bala cancellation.
NEECHA_BHANGA_RETROGRADE.prose:
Neecha-Bhanga Variant 7 — Phaladeepika 6 + Mantreswara extension. Fires when a debilitated graha is retrograde. (The lunar nodes Rahu/Ketu are excluded since they are always retrograde.)

Classical doctrine grants retrograde motion vakri-bala — "retrograde-strength" rated equivalent to exaltation. As this cancellation source differs from the six BPHS conditions, it is counted as the seventh independent neecha-bhanga path.

Clinical signature: strength in the karaka-domain arriving via "reverse-direction" — success through unconventional paths rather than the standard route; tendency toward inner revision and second-passes; results that contradict apparent direction.

NETRA_ARISHTA.name: Netra-Arishta — malefics in 2nd/12th from Sun. Compromised vision-axis, eye ailments, or corrective surgeries.
NETRA_ARISHTA.prose: Netra-Arishta — Saravali Ch.41 — malefic in the 2nd or 12th house from the Sun. Sun governs vision; the 2nd and 12th from Sun signify the right and left eye in classical commentary; malefic occupation produces vision-impairment or eye-disease indication. Remedy: Surya-shanti, Sunetra-stotra, Surya-namaskara, Gayatri-japa.

NIPUNA.name: Nipuna — Sun-Mercury conjunct in kendra. Sharpened Budhaditya variant.
NIPUNA.prose:
Nipuna — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — Sun and Mercury conjunct in any kendra (1, 4, 7, 10). A strengthened Budhaditya variant: the kendra anchors structural stability, while the Sun-Mercury conjunction grants intellectual sharpness and articulate authority.

The native receives extraordinary intelligence, commanding speech, and royal-tier honor. Top-tier indication for teaching, journalism, administrative leadership, and law/advocacy. Cancelled when Mercury is debilitated (Pisces) — a wounded intellect-karaka undermines the very basis of nipunata.

PADMA.name: Padma Yoga — 7 grahas blossomed across kendras per BPHS 36. Lotus-like all-auspicious.
PADMA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Padma Yoga = 7 grahas blossomed across all four kendras like a lotus in full bloom. Confers all-round auspiciousness, dharmic disposition, domesticity-centred royal fame, and supreme reputation. Among the most pure-positive Akriti yogas.
PADMA.general: All-round auspiciousness, dharmic disposition, domesticity-centred royal fame, supreme reputation.

PAPA_KARTARI_10.name: Papa Kartari (10th) — 10th house hemmed by malefics per Phaladeepika 6. Career struggle.
PAPA_KARTARI_10.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Papa Kartari around the 10th = malefics in 9th and 11th flanking the 10th. The "malefic-scissors" presses on the karma-bhāva: authority-disputes, career struggle, friend-becoming-enemy patterns, and high-office controversies. Polar opposite of Subha Kartari (10th).
PAPA_KARTARI_10.general: Career struggle, authority disputes, friend→enemy patterns, high-office controversies.

PAPA_KARTARI_7.name: Papa Kartari (7th) — 7th house hemmed by malefics per Phaladeepika 6. Marital strain.
PAPA_KARTARI_7.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Papa Kartari around the 7th = malefic planets in the 6th and 8th houses flanking the 7th. The "malefic-scissors" presses on the partnership-bhāva from both sides: marital strain, partner-conflict, business-partnership struggle, and 7th-house-significations damage. Polar opposite of Subha Kartari.
PAPA_KARTARI_7.general: Marital strain, partner conflict, partnership struggle, 7th-bhāva damage.

PAPA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.name: Papa-Kartari (Moon) — The Moon hemmed in between natural malefics. Psychological pressure.
PAPA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.prose: Papa-Kartari (Moon) — Inverse of Phaladeepika Chapter 6, Verse 17. This challenging configuration occurs when natural malefics flank the Moon by occupying both the 2nd and 12th houses. The lunar manas-karaka is subjected to constant structural pressure, leading to chronic anxiety, emotional vulnerability, and a feeling of confinement. Auspicious aspects or a strong ascendant lord can mitigate these effects.
PAPA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.mind: Chronic anxiety, emotional vulnerability, mental stress
PAPA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.relationships: Experiencing social isolation or feeling misunderstood

PAPA_KARTARI_LAGNA.name: Papa-Kartari Lagna — Lagna hemmed by malefics. Body-self pressured.
PAPA_KARTARI_LAGNA.prose:
Papa-Kartari Lagna — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — natural malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu, wounded Moon) simultaneously occupy the 2nd and 12th from Lagna, creating a "malefic scissors" around the body-self.

The atma-axis pressed by malefic-flanking signals physical weakness, psychological pressure, peer-environment hostility, and gradual health-decline tendency. Benefic aspects or strong Lagna-lord can soften. Classical remedy: Lagna-lord pacification, malefic-graha-shanti, Hanuman-upasana.

PAPA_KARTARI_SUN.name: Papa-Kartari (Sun) — Sun hemmed by malefics. Soul-karaka squeezed.
PAPA_KARTARI_SUN.prose:
Papa-Kartari (Sun) — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — natural malefics simultaneously occupy the 2nd and 12th from the Sun. The atma-karaka is squeezed by hostile flanking on both sides.

The Sun is the soul-significator and pitru-karaka; malefic-flanking signals reputation-risk, conflict with authority figures, and paternal health-stress. Recurring shocks to political or public image; periodic challenges to self-confidence. Classical remedy: Surya-Gayatri, Aditya-Hridaya-stotra, copper-dana. Strong Jupiter aspect or powerful trikona benefics can soften the indication.

PARAKRAMA_MARS_3.name: Parakrama — Mars in 3rd. Supreme courage; natural 3-house ruler in own house.
PARAKRAMA_MARS_3.prose:
Parakrama is described in Phaladeepika Ch.13. It forms when Mars — natural significator of courage and martial energy — occupies the 3rd house, which is also Mars's natural domain. The doctrinal compound (karaka in karaka-house) creates the supreme parakrama indication.

Classical commentary places these natives in martial roles: military command, surgery, athletics, martial arts, emergency response, leadership-under-pressure. The yoga is cancelled when Mars is debilitated (Cancer).
PARAKRAMA_MARS_3.career: Military command, surgery, athletics, martial arts, emergency response

PARIJATA.name: Pārijāta Yoga — Lagna-lord → dispositor → directional-strength chain. Mahā-Raja per Jataka Parijata 5.
PARIJATA.prose: Per Jataka Parijata Ch.5, Pārijāta Yoga forms via a dispositor chain: the Lagna-lord's dispositor is well-placed, AND that dispositor's directional-strength lord is also well-placed — a four-tier dignity chain. Confers a Mahā-Raja-Yoga: the native's prosperity flows like the celestial Pārijāta tree (kalpa-vrikṣa) which fulfills every wish. One of the rarest classical yogas to fully form.
PARIJATA.general: Mahā-Raja Yoga, infinite wealth, all-desire fulfilment, heaven-like home prosperity.

PARVATA.name: Parvata — Jupiter+Venus kendra, no malefic in any kendra.
PARVATA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Parvata Yoga is formed when Jupiter and Venus are both situated in kendras, while all kendras are entirely free from the presence of any natural malefics (Mars, Saturn, Sun, Nodes). The "mountain" yoga represents unshakeable stability. The native receives mountain-like enduring wealth, supreme scholarship, and high virtue. With two supreme benefics anchoring the chart's pillars without malefic interference, the entire foundation is highly fortified.

PARVATA_CHANDRA.name: Parvata-Chandra Yoga — Moon and natural benefics positioned in angular houses. Mountain-like stability and renown.
PARVATA_CHANDRA.prose: Parvata-Chandra Yoga — Phaladeepika Chapter 6, Verse 13. When the Moon occupies a quadrant (kendra) alongside natural benefics, this variant of Parvata Yoga is formed. The structural anchor of the Moon grants the native a mountain-like stability, profound wisdom, and an unyielding character. The native stands tall in their field and becomes a source of shelter for others.
PARVATA_CHANDRA.material: Deep scholarly pursuits, durable legacy, and lasting influence

PASHA.name: Pasha Yoga — 7 planets in 5 signs per BPHS 36. Bound nature, family-tied.
PASHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Pasha Yoga = 7 grahas in 5 signs. Native is bound-natured (pasha = noose), family-attached, karma-tied, perpetually busy with relational/duty obligations. Phaladeepika 7 — life is one of woven entanglements that the native cannot easily escape.
PASHA.general: Bound nature, family attachment, karma-ties, perpetual busy-ness.

PATNI_DOSHA.name: Patnī Dosha — 7th lord/Venus weak or afflicted per BPHS 22. Spousal challenges.
PATNI_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.22, Patnī (spouse) Dosha = 7th lord OR Venus (twin spouse-significators) afflicted by dusthana placement or malefic conjunction. Confers marital strain, partner-health concerns, marriage obstacles. Distinct from MANGAL_DOSHA in that it focuses on lord-Venus weakness rather than Mars-placement; both can co-fire. Mitigated by Venus-strength remediation, Patnī-prati upāya, harmonious-marriage rituals.
PATNI_DOSHA.general: Marital strain, partner-health concerns, marriage obstacles.

PITRA_BHAGYA_SUN_9.name: Pitra-Bhagya — Sun in 9th well-placed. Paternal fortune and dharmic authority.
PITRA_BHAGYA_SUN_9.prose:
Pitra-Bhagya is the Sun-led variant of Bhagya yogas (Phaladeepika 6.31-32). It forms when the Sun — natural significator of the father, soul, and authority — occupies the 9th house in own (Leo), exalted (Aries), mooltrikona (early Leo), friend, or great-friend dignity.

The Sun in the 9th creates a doctrinal compound: the natural pitra-karaka in the bhava that signifies the father. Classical commentary describes these natives as receiving paternal fortune (long-lived father, paternal estate, family-business inheritance), governmental favor, and authority-tradition vocations. Particularly auspicious for natives in royal families, civil-service lineages, or family enterprises.

**Cancellation.** The yoga is cancelled when the Sun is debilitated (Libra) — the dignity-defect undoes the karaka-house compounding.
PITRA_BHAGYA_SUN_9.career: Royal/governmental service, family enterprise succession, authority-tradition vocations
PITRA_BHAGYA_SUN_9.relationships: Long-lived, supportive father; harmonious paternal lineage
PITRA_BHAGYA_SUN_9.wealth: Paternal estate, family-business inheritance, intergenerational wealth

PITRA_DOSHA.name: Pitṛ Dosha — Sun afflicted by Rahu/Ketu/Saturn per BPHS 81. Ancestral karma.
PITRA_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.81, Pitṛ Dosha = Sun (significator of father/lineage) afflicted by conjunction or aspect from Rahu, Ketu, or Saturn. Confers ancestral-karma significations, paternal-lineage difficulties, and past-life pitṛ-debt. Often manifests as progeny challenges. Classical remedies: Śrāddha-tarpaṇa rituals, Gayā-yatra (pilgrimage to Gaya for ancestor liberation).
PITRA_DOSHA.general: Ancestral karma, paternal-lineage difficulties, past-life pitṛ-debt, progeny challenges.

PRAVRAJYA_JUPITER_VYRTAKA.name: Vyrtaka Pravrajya — Jupiter-led 4+ cluster. Vedic-tradition ascetic; Brahma-vadin path.
PRAVRAJYA_JUPITER_VYRTAKA.prose:
Vyrtaka Pravrajya is the Jupiter-led variant — the most doctrinally auspicious of the seven Pravrajya yogas. It forms when four or more grahas cluster with Jupiter as the dominant member. The path is the Brahma-vadin / Vedic-tradition sannyasi — the orthodox Hindu monastic lineage emphasising scriptural study (svadhyaya), austerity (tapas), and dharmic teaching.

Classical commentary places Vyrtaka natives in the great Hindu monastic orders — Dashanami sannyasa (Adi Shankaracharya lineage), Ramanandi, Gaudiya Vaishnava, Smarta brahminical orders. The Jupiter-character of the path emphasises wisdom-transmission and dharma-preservation rather than personal liberation alone — these are the teaching-lineages of Hinduism. The yoga is regarded as the supreme of the seven sect-yogas because Jupiter is the natural dharma-karaka.
PRAVRAJYA_JUPITER_VYRTAKA.career: Monastic head, Vedic teacher, dharma-guru, lineage-keeper
PRAVRAJYA_JUPITER_VYRTAKA.mind: Deep dharmic conviction, scriptural mastery, teaching-orientation
PRAVRAJYA_JUPITER_VYRTAKA.spirituality: Dashanami sannyasa, Vedanta lineage, guru-shishya transmission

PRAVRAJYA_MARS_SHAKYA.name: Shakya Pravrajya — Mars-led 4+ cluster. Red-robed Buddhist Shakya order; warrior-discipline lineage.
PRAVRAJYA_MARS_SHAKYA.prose:
Shakya Pravrajya is the Mars-led variant of the seven Pravrajya yogas. It forms when four or more grahas cluster with Mars as the dominant member. The path is named after the Shakya clan to which the Buddha belonged — the red-robed Buddhist monastic lineage emphasising martial-disciplined renunciation.

The Mars-character of the path translates into rigorous monastic discipline, physical austerity, and warrior-monk traditions (Tibetan martial-monasticism, certain Mahayana lineages, and Shaolin-style integration of physical training with meditation). The native is suited to disciplined community life with strict rule-observance — the path is austere through structure rather than the Tapasvi austerity through deprivation.
PRAVRAJYA_MARS_SHAKYA.career: Warrior-monk lineages, martial-arts teaching, monastic administration
PRAVRAJYA_MARS_SHAKYA.mind: Disciplined austerity through structure, physical training as practice
PRAVRAJYA_MARS_SHAKYA.spirituality: Tibetan Vajrayana, warrior-monk traditions, Shaolin-style integration

PRAVRAJYA_MERCURY_BHIKSHU.name: Bhikshu Pravrajya — Mercury-led 4+ cluster. Wandering mendicant; intellectual-debate path.
PRAVRAJYA_MERCURY_BHIKSHU.prose:
Bhikshu Pravrajya is the Mercury-led variant. It forms when four or more grahas cluster with Mercury as the dominant member. The path is the wandering mendicant (bhikshu) path emphasising philosophical debate, scriptural commentary, and disputational mastery — the path of the dialectician-renunciate.

Mercurial wandering ascetics historically populated the great philosophical schools — Madhyamaka, Yogacara, Advaita Vedanta, Nyaya — moving from monastery to monastery participating in formal debate (vada). The native is suited to text-study, multi-tradition fluency, and the kind of monastic life that values intellectual rigor over solitary tapas. Modern equivalents include academic philosophers in monastic orders, Tibetan geshe-lineage scholars, and traveling teachers.
PRAVRAJYA_MERCURY_BHIKSHU.career: Philosophical mendicancy, traveling scholar, monastic-school teaching
PRAVRAJYA_MERCURY_BHIKSHU.mind: Dialectical mastery, multi-tradition fluency, text-commentary skill

PRAVRAJYA_MOON_VRIDHHA.name: Vridhha-Shravaka Pravrajya — Moon-led 4+ cluster. Buddhist mendicant lineage; ethical-discipline path.
PRAVRAJYA_MOON_VRIDHHA.prose:
Vridhha-Shravaka Pravrajya is the Moon-led variant of the seven Pravrajya yogas. It forms when four or more grahas cluster with the Moon as the dominant member. The native is drawn to the Buddhist sravaka (lay-disciple) lineage — Theravada-style monasticism emphasising ethical discipline (sila), the eightfold path, and meditation (vipassana).

The lunar character of the path emphasises emotional refinement, communal practice, and a slow inward turn through sustained meditation. Unlike the solar Tapasvi path of solitary retreat, the Vridhha-Shravaka path involves community (sangha), text-study, and disciple-relationship with a teacher. Modern equivalents include Theravada vihara residence, Tibetan-Mahayana lay-vows, and meditation-center engagement.
PRAVRAJYA_MOON_VRIDHHA.career: Monastery administration, meditation teaching, Buddhist scholarship
PRAVRAJYA_MOON_VRIDHHA.mind: Pancha-sila ethics, communal discipline, gradual inward refinement
PRAVRAJYA_MOON_VRIDHHA.spirituality: Theravada Buddhism, vipassana meditation, eightfold path

PRAVRAJYA_SATURN_NIRGRANTHA.name: Nirgrantha Pravrajya — Saturn-led 4+ cluster. Jain digambara (sky-clad); supreme austerity.
PRAVRAJYA_SATURN_NIRGRANTHA.prose:
Nirgrantha Pravrajya is the Saturn-led variant — the supreme austerity tier of the seven Pravrajya yogas. It forms when four or more grahas cluster with Saturn as the dominant member. The path is the Jain digambara muni — the "sky-clad" ascetic who has renounced all possessions including clothes, taken the five great vows (mahavratas), and undertaken the most rigorous monastic discipline in any Indian tradition.

The Saturn-character of the path emphasises sustained, multi-decade austerity (tapas), absolute non-possession (aparigraha), and the slow purification of karma through deprivation. Classical commentary places Nirgrantha natives in the Digambara Jain order or related rigorous-renunciate traditions. The yoga is doctrinally distinguished from the others by its absolute character — the ascetic life is total, lifelong, and irreversible in classical terms.
PRAVRAJYA_SATURN_NIRGRANTHA.career: Digambara muni, lifelong renunciate, dharmacharya in Jain lineage
PRAVRAJYA_SATURN_NIRGRANTHA.spirituality: Digambara Jain order, five great vows (mahavratas), karmic purification through tapas

PRAVRAJYA_SUN_TAPASVI.name: Tapasvi Pravrajya — Sun-led 4+ cluster. Forest-dweller ascetic; agnihotra fire-worship path.
PRAVRAJYA_SUN_TAPASVI.prose:
Tapasvi Pravrajya is the Sun-led variant of the seven Pravrajya yogas (BPHS Ch.79; Phaladeepika 6.41). It forms when four or more classical grahas cluster in a single sign with the Sun as the dominant member. The native is drawn toward the tapasvi (forest-dweller) path of asceticism — solitary retreat, sustained austerity (tapas), and ritual fire-worship (agnihotra).

The solar character of the path emphasises self-discipline through deprivation: long fasts, solitary meditation, and devotion to the Sun-deities. Classical commentary places these natives in lineages emphasising ritual purity (yajnopavita-bearing brahmacharis, vana-prasthas) rather than communal monasticism. The path is austere but not destitute — Tapasvis maintain ritual fires and scriptural study even in isolation.
PRAVRAJYA_SUN_TAPASVI.career: Vedic priesthood, retreat-leader, forest hermitage, lineage-keeper

PRAVRAJYA_TRIDANDI.name: Tridandi Sannyas — Moon in kendra + Saturn in 10th. Vaishnava three-staffed renunciate order.
PRAVRAJYA_TRIDANDI.prose:
Tridandi Sannyas Yoga is described in Phaladeepika 6.43. It forms when the Moon occupies a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) AND Saturn occupies the 10th house. The native is drawn to the Tridandi (three-staffed) Vaishnava sannyas order — a specific monastic lineage within the Sri-Vaishnava and Madhva traditions.

The name "Tridandi" literally means "three-staffed" — the renunciate carries a single staff bound from three reeds, symbolizing simultaneous control over thought (manas), word (vak), and deed (kaya). The triple-binding stands in deliberate contrast to the single-staff (eka-danda) Smarta sannyasi — the Vaishnava tradition emphasises integrated control across all three faculties rather than the consciousness-only focus of Advaita.

Classical commentary places these natives in the Ramanuja-Madhva-Vallabha lineages, particularly as Sri-Vaishnava monastery heads, Gaudiya-Vaishnava acharyas, and lineage-keepers in the bhakti tradition. The configuration is rare and doctrinally distinctive among the Pravrajya yogas because it specifies a particular sannyas-tradition rather than a general renunciation tendency.
PRAVRAJYA_TRIDANDI.career: Vaishnava monastery head, Sri-Vaishnava acharya, Gaudiya-Vaishnava lineage-keeper
PRAVRAJYA_TRIDANDI.mind: Triple discipline — control of thought, word, and deed integrated
PRAVRAJYA_TRIDANDI.spirituality: Vaishnava Tridandi sannyas, Sri-Vaishnava / Madhva / Vallabha lineage

PRAVRAJYA_VENUS_CHARAKA.name: Charaka Pravrajya — Venus-led 4+ cluster. Wandering ascetic with healing arts.
PRAVRAJYA_VENUS_CHARAKA.prose:
Charaka Pravrajya is the Venus-led variant. It forms when four or more grahas cluster with Venus as the dominant member. The path is the wandering ayurvedic physician-ascetic — named after the Charaka-Samhita tradition. These ascetics combine renunciation with healing practice, gathering medicinal herbs, treating disease, and moving from village to village in the lineage of the great Charaka.

The Venus-character of the path emphasises rasayana (medicinal alchemy), refined sensory observation, and practical compassion. Unlike the philosophical Bhikshu or the dharmic Vyrtaka, the Charaka path is hands-on and embodied — the ascetic's renunciation is in service of others' bodily wellbeing. Modern equivalents include traveling Ayurvedic vaidyas, lineage-physicians of remote regions, and certain Tibetan medical-monastic traditions.
PRAVRAJYA_VENUS_CHARAKA.career: Traveling Ayurvedic physician, medicinal herbalist, lineage-vaidya
PRAVRAJYA_VENUS_CHARAKA.mind: Itinerant disposition, embodied compassion, sensory refinement

PURNAYU_8_LORD_IN_8.name: Purnayu — 8th-lord in own house (8th). Healthy long-life.
PURNAYU_8_LORD_IN_8.prose: Purnayu 8-Lord-in-8 — Phaladeepika Ch.11 — 8th-lord in its own house (the 8th). Classical doctrine: a dusthana-lord in its own dusthana applies "own-house rescue" — its malefic-karaka function is structurally neutralized by self-occupation. The mortality-significator in its own seat does not project death-force outward; instead it stabilizes longevity. No remedy required.

PURNAYU_BENEFICS_KENDRA_TRIKONA.name: Purnayu — all benefics in kendra/trikona. Supreme long-life indicator.
PURNAYU_BENEFICS_KENDRA_TRIKONA.prose: Purnayu Benefics-Kendra-Trikona — BPHS Ch.43 — all natural benefics (Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, unwounded Moon) occupy kendras and trikonas. The benefic ensemble dominates the foundation-pillars; body, mind, dharma, and fortune are jointly protected. This is the supreme classical Purnayu indicator (90-120 years). No remedy required.

PURNAYU_LAGNA_JUPITER_KENDRA.name: Purnayu — Jupiter in Lagna or kendra. Long-life indicator.
PURNAYU_LAGNA_JUPITER_KENDRA.prose: Purnayu Lagna-Jupiter-Kendra — BPHS Ch.43 + Phaladeepika Ch.11 — Jupiter strong in Lagna or another kendra (4, 7, 10). Jupiter is the longevity-karaka and supreme protector of long life; well-placed in a foundation-pillar, it grants enduring protection of body, mind, and dharma — classical Purnayu indicator (72-120 years). No remedy required; the configuration itself is the protection.

PURNA_MANGAL.name: Purna (full) Mangal — strong unmitigated Mars in dosha-houses per Mansagari 5.
PURNA_MANGAL.prose: Per Mansagari Ch.5, Pūrṇa Mangal = Mars STRONGLY placed in 1/2/4/7/8/12 (own-sign or exalted, dignity unblemished, no benefic aspect) — the most virulent grade of Mangal Dosha. Confers separation risk, intense marital strife, deep partner-health affliction. Requires full remediation: Kuja-śānti, Kumbha-vivāha (clay-pot marriage), or marriage to a same-dosha partner per classical practice.
PURNA_MANGAL.general: Separation risk, intense marital strife, deep partner-health affliction, full remediation required.

PUSHKALA.name: Pushkala — Moon and Lagna-lord in kendra. Comprehensive prosperity.
PUSHKALA.prose:
Pushkala — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — Moon in a kendra AND Lagna-lord in a kendra. Both manas-karaka and the lord of atma-bhava simultaneously anchored in foundation-pillars unify the personality's primary significators.

"Pushkala" means "abundant, prosperous". The native enjoys comprehensive prosperity, social standing, and physical well-being. Pushkala extends Amrit by adding Lagna-lord support — beyond just the Moon, the chart's identity-axis is also fortified. The two-source convergence yields broader prosperity than Amrit alone: wealth, respect, and bodily welfare arrive together.

PUSHPA_MALA.name: Puṣpa-Mālā Yoga — benefics in unbroken sequence across bhavas. Garland-like fame per Saravali 34.
PUSHPA_MALA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Puṣpa-Mālā Yoga arises when benefics occupy a sequential chain of houses (e.g., 1-2-3-4 or another contiguous run), forming a "flower-garland" pattern. Confers all-bhava auspiciousness, unbroken fame across life-stages, and an exceptionally pleasing personality. The "garland" name signals each blossom (bhava) connected to the next without gap.
PUSHPA_MALA.general: All-bhava auspiciousness, unbroken fame, exceptional personality, garland-like reputation.

PUSHYA.name: Pushya Yoga — Jupiter in mūla-trikoṇa aspected by Moon per Phaladeepika 6. Nourished family.
PUSHYA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Pushya Yoga = Jupiter in its own mūla-trikoṇa, aspected by Moon. The "nourished" name signals well-fed family, wealth-accumulation, dharmic householder life, and all-auspicious-events alignment. Common in patriarchs of stable, religious, well-provided families.
PUSHYA.general: Well-nourished family, wealth accumulation, dharmic householder, auspicious events.

PUTRA_BHANGA_JUPITER_NODE_5.name: Putra-Bhanga — Jupiter conjunct Rahu/Ketu in 5. Putra-karaka afflicted.
PUTRA_BHANGA_JUPITER_NODE_5.prose:
Putra-Bhanga — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when Jupiter (the natural putra-karaka) is conjunct Rahu or Ketu in the 5th house. This is a karaka-eclipse: the progeny-significator itself, located in its own karaka-house, falls under the shadow of a node. The afflicted karaka cannot deliver its karaka-function from the very domain it should empower most.

Clinical signatures include conception difficulty, child-health concerns, and parent-child estrangement. The yoga is karaka-centered rather than house-centered (unlike Santana-Bandhan), making it strictly more severe in karaka-driven readings. Classical remedies center on Jupiter-pacification: Guru-Gayatri, Santana-Gopala upasana, and Brihaspati shanti rituals. Mitigation can come from benefic aspects to the conjunction or co-existing Putra-Sukha yogas.

PUTRA_DOSHA.name: Putra Dosha — 5th lord weak or 5th house afflicted per BPHS 21. Progeny challenges.
PUTRA_DOSHA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.21, Putra (progeny) Dosha = 5th lord weakly placed OR 5th house aspected/conjoined by malefics. Confers progeny challenges, miscarriage tendency, child-health concerns. Distinct from NAGA_DOSHA (Rahu in 5th specifically) — the broader 5th-affliction reading. Mitigated by Jupiter strength, Putra-Prapti mantra, and progeny-related upayas.
PUTRA_DOSHA.general: Progeny challenges, miscarriage tendency, child-health concerns.

PUTRA_SUKHA_BENEFIC_5.name: Putra-Sukha — benefic in 5th. Children-welfare and creative joy flourish.
PUTRA_SUKHA_BENEFIC_5.prose:
Putra-Sukha-Benefic-5 forms when a natural benefic (Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, or unwounded Moon) occupies the 5th house. The benefic irrigates the 5th-bhava across all three karaka-domains: progeny (putra), intellect (buddhi), and creative-merit (purva-punya).

The native enjoys joy-bringing children, a happy domestic atmosphere, and creative pursuits. Full results require no malefic in the 5th — malefic co-occupation cancels, since cruel grahas wound the joy-house even when benefics are also present.

RAHU_IN_10.name: Rahu in 10th: unconventional Karma Raja Yoga. Foreign-business fame, sudden authority per BPHS 28.
RAHU_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.28, Rahu in the 10th forms an unconventional Karma Raja Yoga — fame through foreign business, sudden authority, abrupt rise to high office, and unconventional career fame. Phaladeepika Ch.8 — Rahu's 10th-house placement is exceptionally auspicious. Common in tech entrepreneurs, foreign-investment professionals, and those whose career path is non-traditional.
RAHU_IN_10.general: Unconventional Karma Raja Yoga, foreign-business fame, sudden authority, abrupt rise, non-traditional career.

RAHU_IN_11.name: Rahu in 11th: unconventional Lābha Yoga. Wealth via foreign sources, sudden desire-fulfilment per BPHS 28.
RAHU_IN_11.prose: Per BPHS Ch.28, Rahu in the 11th forms an unconventional Lābha Yoga — wealth via foreign sources, sudden/unexpected desire-fulfilment, and friend-family expansion. Phaladeepika Ch.8 — Rahu's 11th-house placement is exceptionally auspicious. Common in cross-border traders, NRI-business operators, and those whose income pathway is non-traditional.
RAHU_IN_11.general: Unconventional Lābha Yoga, foreign wealth, sudden desire-fulfilment, friend-family expansion, non-traditional gains.

RAHU_IN_3.name: Rahu in 3rd: extraordinary-courage yoga. Foreign travel, sudden fame, sibling power per BPHS 28.
RAHU_IN_3.prose: Per BPHS Ch.28, Rahu in the 3rd forms an extraordinary-courage yoga — outsized boldness, elder-sibling power, foreign travel, and sudden/unconventional fame. Phaladeepika Ch.8 — Rahu in upachaya bhavas (3/6/10/11) yields its best fruit, mirroring Saturn. Common in expatriates, adventurers, and breakthrough entrepreneurs.
RAHU_IN_3.general: Extraordinary-courage yoga, sudden fame, foreign travel, sibling power, unconventional drive.

RAHU_IN_6.name: Rahu in 6th: enemy-destruction Vipareeta-Raja Yoga. Defeats powerful foes, debt-cancellation per BPHS 28.
RAHU_IN_6.prose: Per BPHS Ch.28, Rahu in the 6th forms an enemy-destruction Vipareeta-Raja Yoga — Rahu in dusthana cancels debt, defeats powerful enemies (legal/political adversaries), and confers unconventional power and authority-fame. Phaladeepika Ch.8 — Rahu's 6th-house placement is among the most auspicious for the shadow planet. Common in litigators, adversarial-arena professionals.
RAHU_IN_6.general: Enemy-destruction Vipareeta-Raja Yoga, victory over powerful foes, debt-cancellation, unconventional power, authority-fame.

RAJA_10_5.name: Raja-Yoga 10-5 — Dharma-Karmadhipati exchange variant. Apex.
RAJA_10_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, when the 10th lord of career/authority and the 5th lord of intellect/past-life merit exchange signs, a supreme kendra-trikona relationship (a variant of Dharma-Karmadhipati) is established. This is one of the highest classical Raja Yogas. Current effort (Karma) and past merit (Purvapunya) merge to grant high executive power, ministerial positions, or top-tier leadership in creative or educational fields.

RAJA_10_9.name: Raja-Yoga 10-9 — canonical Dharma-Karmadhipati exchange.
RAJA_10_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, when the 10th lord (Karma) and 9th lord (Dharma) undergo mutual exchange, they form the peak of all classical combinations: the Dharma-Karmadhipati Raja Yoga. This is the apex-tier of authority and fame. Divine grace lifts the career to national or international heights, while the native's actions build a legacy of righteousness. Classical signature for statesmen, supreme judges, spiritual leaders, or universally-respected authority figures.

RAJA_10_IN_9.name: Raja-Yoga — 10th-lord in 9th. Career serves dharma.
RAJA_10_IN_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36 v.14, the placement of the 10th lord of actions in the 9th house of dharma/fortune is the mirror configuration of the 9th-in-10th. The native's career becomes a vehicle for higher purpose or ethical mission. Professional pursuits carry profound spiritual or social responsibility. Classical signature for leaders of charitable foundations, ethical entrepreneurs, and individuals whose livelihood directly benefits society.

RAJA_1_5.name: Raja-Yoga 1-5 — Lagna-lord and 5th-lord exchange.
RAJA_1_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36 (Raja-Yoga-Adhyaya), when the Lagna-lord occupies the 5th house and the 5th-lord occupies the Ascendant, a supreme mutual exchange (Parivartana) forms. This kendra-trikona relationship fuses the self (Atmakaraka) with past-life merit (Purvapunya). The native receives academic eminence, creative renown, filial joy, and paternal support. Intellectual power and personal identity mutually amplify, making this ideal for scholars, creative visionaries, and intellectual leaders.

RAJA_1_9.name: Raja-Yoga 1-9 — Lagna-lord and 9th-lord exchange. Self-fortune fused.
RAJA_1_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, when the Lagna-lord and 9th-lord swap signs, the self (Ascendant) and highest fortune (9th trine) merge in a supreme Parivartana. The native enjoys widespread fame, religious honors, paternal prosperity, and continuous divine grace. Good opportunities manifest naturally at crucial junctures. The personality itself becomes a channel of fortune, representing a classical signature of supreme public prominence or state honors.

RAJA_4_5.name: Raja-Yoga 4-5 — 4th-lord and 5th-lord exchange. Home and intellect united.
RAJA_4_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, the mutual exchange between the 4th lord (domestic happiness/vehicles) and the 5th lord (intelligence/past-life merit) forms a highly auspicious kendra-trikona relationship. The native is blessed with an intellectually stimulating home environment, outstanding academic success, and strong maternal support. This is a classical signature for prominent positions in academic fields, writers, and individuals who thrive in scholarly environments.

RAJA_4_9.name: Raja-Yoga 4-9 — 4th-lord and 9th-lord exchange. Home and dharma united.
RAJA_4_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, the mutual exchange between the 4th lord of comfort/property and the 9th lord of dharma/fortune creates a highly elevated kendra-trikona relationship. The native is blessed with a spiritually fortified home environment, extensive real-estate holdings, and substantial ancestral wealth. Classical signature for paths focused on family-religious traditions, building of temples, and inheriting significant parental assets.

RAJA_5_IN_1.name: Raja-Yoga — 5th-lord in 1st. Past-life merit blesses self directly.
RAJA_5_IN_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, when the 5th lord of intelligence and past-life merit occupies the Ascendant (Lagna), a prominent placement-based Raja Yoga forms. The trine lord in the house of self directly channels accumulated merit into the personality. The native possesses razor-sharp intellect, deep wisdom, and progeny happiness. A natural configuration for advisers, ministers, creative minds, and highly-respected individuals.

RAJA_7_5.name: Raja-Yoga 7-5 — 7th-lord and 5th-lord exchange. Partner and intellect.
RAJA_7_5.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, when the 7th lord of partnership and the 5th lord of intellect/past-life merit exchange signs, a harmonious kendra-trikona relationship is established. The native is blessed with an exceptionally intelligent, creative, and supportive spouse. The children are highly capable and bring pride. It is a classical configuration for a successful marriage of love or highly profitable partnerships in creative, artistic, or educational fields.

RAJA_7_9.name: Raja-Yoga 7-9 — 7th-lord and 9th-lord exchange. Partnership and fortune.
RAJA_7_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, the mutual exchange between the 7th lord of partnership and the 9th lord of highest fortune creates a supreme kendra-trikona connection. The native's fortune is unlocked primarily through marriage or strategic partnership. The spouse is deeply spiritual, righteous, and brings immense prosperity. A highly fortunate configuration for international ventures, joint businesses, and an ethical, harmonious conjugal life.

RAJA_9_IN_1.name: Raja-Yoga — 9th-lord in 1st. Fortune anchors self.
RAJA_9_IN_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.24, the placement of the 9th lord of highest fortune and dharma in the Ascendant constitutes one of the most auspicious classical configurations. The native is naturally fortunate, virtuous, and receives consistent divine protection. The personality exudes dignity, drawing opportunities and noble-minded associates effortlessly. Classical signature for leaders, philanthropists, and highly respected public figures.

RAJA_9_IN_10.name: Raja-Yoga — 9th-lord in 10th. Dharma-Karmadhipati placement-form.
RAJA_9_IN_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36 v.14, when the 9th lord of fortune and dharma is stationed in the 10th house of career/actions, it produces a highly celebrated placement-based Raja Yoga. Career growth is driven by luck and ethical choices. The native is widely respected for professional integrity and often occupies judicial, governmental, or major ethical leadership roles. Every career phase contributes to spiritual and social standing.

RAJA_JUPITER_AND_L1.name: Raja Yoga — strong Jupiter (kendra) + 1th-lord in kendra/trikoṇa per Phaladeepika 6.
RAJA_JUPITER_AND_L1.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, when Jupiter is strongly placed in a kendra AND the 1th-lord also occupies a kendra/trikoṇa, Jupiter's aspect protects and amplifies the 1th-bhava's significations eight-fold (Jupiter-strong + Lagna-lord-strong). Composite Raja Yoga — neither pure Jupiter-strength nor pure lord-strength alone produces this; both must coincide to invoke the dharma-protected amplification.
RAJA_JUPITER_AND_L1.general: Jupiter-aspect-amplified 1th-bhava fruit, royal recognition, dharma-karma synergy, eight-fold augmentation.

RAJA_KARMA_10_LORD_LAGNA.name: Raja-Karma — 10th-lord in Lagna. Career identical with self-identity.
RAJA_KARMA_10_LORD_LAGNA.prose:
Raja-Karma forms when the 10th-lord occupies the Lagna (BPHS Ch.18). The career-significator landing in the self-significator-house creates an identity-and-vocation lock: the native's name and profession are inseparable.

Classical commentary places these natives among public figures whose identity is their work — entrepreneurs whose name is their company, political leaders identified with their cause, artists whose persona and craft are one. The yoga is doctrinally regarded as a strong Tier-2 royal indicator (Raja = royal in this context, named so because the configuration produces public-facing leaders).
RAJA_KARMA_10_LORD_LAGNA.career: Public figures whose identity is their work; entrepreneurs, political leaders, artists

RAJA_KT_10_1.name: 10th lord in Lagna: kendra-kendra Raja Yoga. Career-significator joins body — fame via personal effort per BPHS 41.
RAJA_KT_10_1.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 10th lord in Lagna forms a kendra-kendra Raja Yoga — career-significator residing in the body-bhava makes the personality itself the engine of professional fame. Phaladeepika Ch.6 ranks it among the top kendra-kendra placements. Common in self-made entrepreneurs and athletes whose identity is inseparable from their work.
RAJA_KT_10_1.general: Kendra-kendra Raja Yoga, career fame, royal recognition, fame via personal effort, high office.

RAJA_KT_4_9.name: 4th lord in 9th: Sukha-Trikoṇa Mahā-Raja Yoga. Mother+dharma synergy, ancestral home per BPHS 41.
RAJA_KT_4_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 4th lord in the 9th forms a Sukha-Trikoṇa Mahā-Raja Yoga — comfort-significator (4th) fructifying in the dharma-bhava (9th) blends maternal happiness with destiny-and-faith, conferring ancestral-home growth, dharmic householder disposition, and guru's grace. Phaladeepika Ch.6 ranks it among the supreme Raja-yogas. Mirror of RAJA_KT_9_4 with stronger dharma-emphasis.
RAJA_KT_4_9.general: Sukha-Trikoṇa Mahā-Raja Yoga, mother-dharma synergy, ancestral-home growth, guru's grace, dharmic householder.

RAJA_KT_5_10.name: 5th lord in 10th: trikoṇa-kendra Raja Yoga. Past-merit drives career fame, intellect-skill per BPHS 41.
RAJA_KT_5_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 5th lord in the 10th forms a trikoṇa-kendra Raja Yoga — past-merit fructifies in the karma-bhava: intellect-and-skill drives career fame, royal recognition, and high office through learning or business.
RAJA_KT_5_10.general: Trikoṇa-kendra Raja Yoga, past-merit → career fame, intellect-skill, royal recognition, high office.

RAJA_KT_5_4.name: 5th lord in 4th: trikoṇa-kendra Raja Yoga. Past-merit fuels home/family per BPHS 41.
RAJA_KT_5_4.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 5th lord in the 4th forms a trikoṇa-kendra Raja Yoga — past-merit significator (5th) fructifies in the comfort-bhava (4th), translating poorva-punya into maternal happiness, progeny welfare, domestic peace, and dharmic family disposition.
RAJA_KT_5_4.general: Trikoṇa-kendra Raja Yoga, past-merit → home/family, maternal happiness, dharmic householder, heart-peace.

RAJA_KT_5_7.name: 5th lord in 7th: trikoṇa-kendra Raja Yoga. Progeny-spouse synergy, fame via partner per BPHS 41.
RAJA_KT_5_7.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 5th lord in the 7th forms a trikoṇa-kendra Raja Yoga — past-merit fructifies in the partnership-bhava: progeny-spouse synergy, fame mediated through partner, ethical business, gainful travel.
RAJA_KT_5_7.general: Trikoṇa-kendra Raja Yoga, progeny-spouse synergy, fame via partner, ethical business, gainful travel.

RAJA_KT_7_9.name: 7th lord in 9th: Kalatra-Trikoṇa Raja Yoga. Spouse-driven fortune, dharmic partner, pilgrimage per BPHS 41.
RAJA_KT_7_9.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 7th lord in the 9th forms a Kalatra-Trikoṇa Raja Yoga — partner-significator (7th) fructifies in the dharma-bhava (9th), so the marriage opens destiny: dharmic partner, foreign religious travel, guru-grace mediated through partnership.
RAJA_KT_7_9.general: Kalatra-Trikoṇa Raja Yoga, spouse-driven fortune, dharmic partner, foreign pilgrimage, guru-grace.

RAJA_KT_9_4.name: 9th lord in 4th: trikoṇa-kendra Mahā-Raja Yoga. Fortune fuels home, dharma protects family per BPHS 41.
RAJA_KT_9_4.prose: Per BPHS Ch.41, the 9th lord in the 4th forms a trikoṇa-kendra Mahā-Raja Yoga — fortune-significator (9th) fructifies in the comfort-bhava (4th), so destiny augments mother/home/property, dharma protects the family, and guru-grace flows into domestic life.
RAJA_KT_9_4.general: Trikoṇa-kendra Mahā-Raja Yoga, fortune → home/mother, dharma-protected family, guru's grace, ancestral home.

RAJA_KT_9_7.name: 9th lord in 7th: trikoṇa-kendra Mahā-Raja Yoga. Fortune-fuelled marriage, dharmic partner per BPHS 41.

RAJA_LAKSHANA.name: Rāja-Lakṣaṇa Yoga — all royal significators strong per Saravali 34. King-like persona.
RAJA_LAKSHANA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Rāja-Lakṣaṇa Yoga = Sun + Jupiter + Venus all strong in kendras/trikoṇas. Confers king-like persona, the eight royal-marks (rāja-lakṣaṇa), lion-like majesty, and royal-lineage fame. Among the supreme Raja-yogas in the corpus. Common in dynastic founders, presidents, and supremely-recognised authority-figures.
RAJA_LAKSHANA.general: King-like persona, eight royal-marks, lion-like majesty, royal-lineage fame.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_1_10.name: Raja Yoga via lord conjunction (1-10): Lagna-lord conjunct 10th-lord (Karma-Lagnadhipati) per BPHS 36.
RAJA_LORD_CONJ_1_10.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36 (Raja-Yoga-Adhyaya), when the 1th and 10th lords occupy the same sign, a Raja Yoga forms — the lord-conjunction (Lagna-lord conjunct 10th-lord (Karma-Lagnadhipati)) channels both bhavas' significations into a single fortified stream. The native attains royal recognition, expanded authority, and karmic fruit specifically tied to the conjoined houses' domain. Distinct from same-house mutual exchange (raja-advanced) and from one-way placement (house-lord); here both lords share a common dispositor and act in unison.
RAJA_LORD_CONJ_1_10.general: 1-10 bhava-fused fruit, royal recognition, expanded authority, karma-success in the conjoined-bhavas' domain.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_9_10.general: 9-10 bhava-fused fruit, royal recognition, expanded authority, karma-success in the conjoined-bhavas' domain.

RAJJU.name: Rajju Yoga — 7 planets in movable signs per BPHS 36. Travel-loving, restless temperament.
RAJJU.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36 (Ashraya group), Rajju Yoga = all 7 grahas in the four movable signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn). Native is travel-loving, restless of mind, foreign-trip-prone, and change-oriented. Phaladeepika 7 — never settled in one place; the rajju (rope) name signals continuous mobility.
RAJJU.general: Travel-loving nature, restless mind, foreign trips, change-orientation, dynamic temperament.

RAJJU_DOSHA.name: Rajju Dosha — same rajju between bride/groom per Muhurta Chintamani 6.
RAJJU_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi Ch.6, Rajju Dosha = bride/groom nakshatras fall in the same rajju group (Śīrṣa/Kaṇṭha/Nābhi/Kaṭi/Pāda — head/throat/navel/waist/foot). Severity is classical-position-specific: Śīrṣa-Rajju → husband-loss risk, Kaṇṭha → progeny-loss, Nābhi → wealth-loss, Kaṭi → fortune-loss, Pāda → travel-loss. The most position-specific of the marriage doshas; remediation requires position-targeted śānti.
RAJJU_DOSHA.general: Marital-separation risk, progeny risk, position-specific karmic affliction.

RAVI_BHASHKARA_SUN_MERCURY_10.name: Ravi-Bhashkara — Sun-Mercury conj. in 10th own/exalt — political-admin supremacy.
RAVI_BHASHKARA_SUN_MERCURY_10.prose:
Ravi-Bhashkara is the 10th-house specialised form of Budhaditya yoga (Phaladeepika 6 commentary). It forms when Sun and Mercury are conjunct in the 10th house with at least one of them in own or exalted dignity. The compound combines authority (Sun) with intellect/communication (Mercury) anchored in the karma-bhava with dignity-strength.

Classical commentary places these natives in political-administrative supremacy — heads of state, senior bureaucrats, civil-service leaders, organizational chiefs whose authority rests on both governance-capacity and analytical mastery.
RAVI_BHASHKARA_SUN_MERCURY_10.career: Heads of state, senior bureaucrats, civil-service leaders, organizational chiefs
RAVI_BHASHKARA_SUN_MERCURY_10.wealth: Supreme administrative reputation; resources via governance

RIN_DOSHA_PITRI.name: Pitṛ-Ṛṇa Dosha — Lal Kitab paternal-debt karma. Ancestral-curse pattern.
RIN_DOSHA_PITRI.prose: Per Lal Kitab, Pitṛ-Ṛṇa Dosha = Sun-Jupiter weakness combined with malefic conjunction in 5th/9th houses. Confers paternal-debt karma (unpaid ancestral obligations), ancestral-curse patterns, and progeny-related karmic challenges. Distinct from PITRA_DOSHA (legacy) which is purely Sun+nodal-affliction; this Lal Kitab variant integrates the broader paternal-lineage karmic accounting. Remedies: river-water-charity, Peepal-pūjana, Pitṛ-tarpaṇa.
RIN_DOSHA_PITRI.general: Paternal-debt karma, ancestral-curse pattern, progeny-related karmic challenges.

RIN_DOSHA_STRI.name: Strī-Ṛṇa Dosha — Lal Kitab feminine-line debt karma per traditional Lal Kitab.
RIN_DOSHA_STRI.prose: Per Lal Kitab, Strī-Ṛṇa Dosha = Moon-Venus weakness with malefic conjunction in 2nd/4th/7th houses. Confers past-life karma toward mother/daughter/wife figures, feminine-curse patterns, and reduced quality of relationships with women. Remedies: kanyā-dāna (offering to young girls), strī-dhana donation, Gaurī-vrata observance.
RIN_DOSHA_STRI.general: Feminine-line karmic debt, woman-curse pattern, reduced relationships with women.

RIN_DOSHA_SWAJAN.name: Svajana-Ṛṇa Dosha — Lal Kitab kinship-debt karma per traditional Lal Kitab.
RIN_DOSHA_SWAJAN.prose: Per Lal Kitab, Svajana-Ṛṇa Dosha = Mars-Rahu weakness with malefic conjunction in 3rd/11th houses. Confers past-life karma toward kinsmen/siblings/extended family, sibling-curse patterns, and friend/family-separation risk. Remedies: kuṭumba-sevā (family service), gau-sevā (cow service), anna-dāna (food charity). The third leg of the Lal Kitab Rina trio (Pitṛ + Strī + Svajana = ancestral karmic accounting).
RIN_DOSHA_SWAJAN.general: Kinship karmic debt, sibling-curse pattern, friend/family-separation risk.

RUCHAKA.name: Ruchaka Yoga — Mars in kendra and dignity. Confers martial valor, commanding leadership, and physical prowess.
RUCHAKA.prose: Ruchaka Yoga is the premier warrior-archetype configuration among the five Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas (BPHS Ch. 76, v. 1). It is formed when Mars occupies an angular house (kendra: 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Ascendant (Lagna) or the Moon (Chandra) while in its sign of exaltation (Capricorn), own sign (Aries or Scorpio), or moolatrikona (Aries). This configuration directs Mars's primal, dynamic energy through the structural and public pillars of the chart. The native is endowed with exceptional physical fortitude, a commanding presence, and a decisive, fearless intellect. Historically associated with commanders, generals, and conquerors, this yoga in modern contexts signifies elite surgeons, top-tier athletes, and executive leaders who thrive in high-stakes, competitive environments.
RUCHAKA.body: Athletic, robust skeletal structure, magnetic physical presence, and high vitality
RUCHAKA.career: Military command, surgical professions, elite athletics, and executive leadership in high-risk sectors
RUCHAKA.mind: Unflinching courage, decisive analytical capacity under high stress, and natural authority
RUCHAKA.wealth: Substantial wealth generated through personal enterprise, strategic risk-taking, and competitive victory

RUCHAKA_BHANGA.name: Ruchaka Bhanga — Mars combust or retrograde in dignity and kendra. Ruchaka-yoga effects are rendered unstable.
RUCHAKA_BHANGA.prose: Ruchaka Bhanga is a classical diagnostic state detailed in Phaladeepika (Ch. 6, v. 7). It occurs when the core planetary placements for Ruchaka Yoga are met (Mars in kendra in Aries, Scorpio, or Capricorn), but Mars is simultaneously combust (asta) by the Sun or retrograde (vakri). In Vedic astrology, combustion eclipses the external projection of the planet's significance, while retrogression internalizes its energy or causes unpredictable reversals. The native still possesses the structural potential for courage and leadership, but its manifestation is punctuated by self-doubt, fits of anger, or sudden setbacks. Career progression in martial, surgical, or administrative fields remains prominent but undergoes volatile ups and downs. Strategic pacification through Mars mantras or Hanuman worship is classically prescribed to unlock the yoga's pure potential.
RUCHAKA_BHANGA.career: Professional achievements marked by sudden administrative reversals, political friction, or surgical error-rates
RUCHAKA_BHANGA.mind: Mixed courage — alternating phases of intense confidence and sudden, disabling self-doubt
RUCHAKA_BHANGA.spirituality: Remedies like Mars-mantra recitation and devotion to Lord Hanuman are recommended to stabilize Mars's energy

RUCHAKA_EXALTED.name: Supreme Ruchaka — Mars exalted (Capricorn) in kendra. Apex martial-yoga conferring commanding leadership.
RUCHAKA_EXALTED.prose: Supreme Ruchaka represents the ultimate manifestation of the Ruchaka Mahapurusha Yoga. According to the classical mandate in Phaladeepika (Ch. 6), an exalted planet in a kendra yields one hundred percent of its promised results ("uchhastho purna-phaladah"). When Mars is positioned in Capricorn—its sign of maximum strength and deep exaltation (at 28 degrees)—within an angular house from the Lagna or Moon, it creates an unmatched surge of disciplined physical energy. The structural rigidity of Capricorn channels Mars's raw heat into highly efficient, strategic action. This yoga produces individuals of monumental courage, legendary physical endurance, and absolute focus. Historically the signature of great generals and conquerors, in contemporary times it characterizes chief surgeons, defensive forces commanders, and legendary athletes.
RUCHAKA_EXALTED.body: Exceptional physical resilience, rapid recovery from illness or injury, and high athletic stamina
RUCHAKA_EXALTED.career: Top-tier defense commanders, chief surgical authorities, and world-class athletes
RUCHAKA_EXALTED.mind: Apex courage, unflinching resolve in the face of danger, and absolute strategic focus

RUCHAKA_FROM_MOON.name: Ruchaka from Moon — Mars angular from the Moon in dignity. Confers a courageous and commanding temperament.
RUCHAKA_FROM_MOON.prose: Chandra Ruchaka Yoga is formed when Mars is situated in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) from the natal Moon (Chandra) while in its sign of own sign or exaltation (Saravali, Ch. 38). In Vedic astrology, the Ascendant (Lagna) represents physical manifestation, whereas the Moon (Chandra) represents the mind (manas) and emotional temperament. Therefore, while Lagna-based Ruchaka affects physical career and bodily strength, Chandra Ruchaka fundamentally shapes the psyche. The native is endowed with supreme emotional resilience, a highly competitive drive, and an unflinching capacity to withstand immense mental stress. When Mars is angular from both the Lagna and the Moon simultaneously, the yoga becomes exceptionally powerful, granting imperial status ("samrat-tulya") and global eminence.
RUCHAKA_FROM_MOON.mind: Unparalleled emotional grit, a natural commanding temperament, and a fearlessly proactive approach to crises

RUCHAKA_TRIKONA.name: Ruchaka Yoga (trikoṇa variant) — exalted/own-sign Mars in 1/5/9 per Saravali 38. Mahā-puruṣa-like valour.
RUCHAKA_TRIKONA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.38, Ruchaka-trikoṇa = Mars in own-sign or exalted in a trikoṇa (1, 5, 9). Saravali extends the BPHS Mahā-puruṣa doctrine to trikoṇa placements: Mahā-puruṣa-like valour, courage, warrior-class radiance, and military leadership. Slightly weaker than canonical kendra-Ruchaka but trikoṇa's auspicious foundation augments the placement.
RUCHAKA_TRIKONA.general: Valour, courage, warrior radiance, military leadership, self-effort capability.

SAHAJA_3_LORD_KENDRA.name: Sahaja — 3rd-lord in kendra. Courage and sibling welfare well-anchored.
SAHAJA_3_LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Sahaja 3-Lord-Kendra forms when the 3rd-lord — significator of courage (parakrama), siblings, communication, and short journeys — occupies a kendra from the Lagna. The placement anchors initiative-capacity in the structural pillars of the chart: body (1st), home (4th), partnerships (7th), or career (10th).

Classical commentary places these natives in entrepreneurial roles, athletics, journalism, communication arts, and contexts requiring sustained initiative. Younger siblings tend to thrive and provide supportive companionship.
SAHAJA_3_LORD_KENDRA.career: Entrepreneurship, athletics, journalism, communication arts, travel

SAHAJA_3_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Sahaja — 3rd-lord in own/exalted/mooltrikona dignity.
SAHAJA_3_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose: Sahaja 3-Lord-Own/Exalt forms when the 3rd-lord occupies its own sign, exaltation, or mooltrikona. Dignity-strength alone suffices regardless of house. The native's courage and initiative-capacity are self-generated — independent enterprise, durable communication skill, sustained physical capacity.

SAHAJA_3_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Sahaja — 3rd-lord in trikona. Initiative aligned with dharma.
SAHAJA_3_LORD_TRIKONA.prose: Sahaja 3-Lord-Trikona forms when the 3rd-lord occupies a trikona (1/5/9). The initiative-capacity is dharmically aligned — courage flows from inner conviction (purva-punya). Classical commentary places these natives in philosophical writing, religious publishing, dharmic communication, and contexts where initiative serves ethical purpose.
SAHAJA_3_LORD_TRIKONA.career: Philosophical writing, religious publishing, dharmic communication

SAHAJA_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_3_11.name: Sahaja-Labha Parivartana — 3-11 mutual exchange. Initiative converts to gain.
SAHAJA_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_3_11.prose:
Sahaja-Labha Parivartana forms when the 3rd-lord occupies the sign of the 11th-lord AND the 11th-lord occupies the sign of the 3rd-lord. The structural mutual exchange links initiative (3rd) with gain (11th) — every effort the native makes converts directly to material benefit.

Classical commentary places these natives in entrepreneurship, commission-based work, sales leadership, and performance-driven income roles where action and reward align tightly.
SAHAJA_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_3_11.career: Entrepreneurship, sales leadership, commission-based work, performance-driven income

SAKATA.name: Sakata Yoga — 7 grahas in 1st and 7th per BPHS 36. Cart-wheel rise-and-fall life.
SAKATA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Sakata Yoga = 7 grahas confined to the 1st-7th kendra axis. The "cart-wheel" name signals the life's up-down rotation: long cycles of rise-and-fall, financial uncertainty, endurance-testing labour. Distinct from chandra-advanced's SHAKATA (Moon-Jupiter cycle) — this is the broader 7-graha Akriti pattern.
SAKATA.general: Long rise-fall cycles, financial uncertainty, endurance-testing work, transport-related karma.

SAKTI.name: Sakti Yoga — 7 grahas in 7th through 10th sequentially per BPHS 36. Weapon-like potency.
SAKTI.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Sakti Yoga = 7 grahas in 7-8-9-10 sequentially. The "weapon" pattern confers heroic potency, dharma-karma synergy, occult-power orientation, and capability in martial/weapon-handling karma. Bridges partnership (7) through career (10) via the dharma-bhāgya bridge.
SAKTI.general: Heroic potency, dharma-karma synergy, occult-power orientation, weapon-skill aptitude.

SAMUDRA.name: Samudra Yoga — 7 grahas in even houses (2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12) per BPHS 36. Ocean-like depth + infinite wealth.
SAMUDRA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Samudra Yoga = 7 grahas in the six even houses. The "ocean" pattern confers ocean-deep gravitas, infinite wealth-accumulation, mastery of all gemstones/treasures, and profound personality. Counterpart to Chakra (odd-houses Cakravarti dynamism); Samudra is the still-deep complement.
SAMUDRA.general: Ocean-like gravitas, infinite wealth, gemstone mastery, profound personality.

SANKRANTI_DOSHA.name: Sankranti Dosha — birth on Sun sign-ingress day per Muhurta Ganapati.
SANKRANTI_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Gaṇapati, Sankranti Dosha = birth within the Sun's sign-ingress window (typically ±6 hours of the actual ingress moment). The transition-day energy is classically considered unsuitable for new beginnings, including birth. Confers transition-period challenges, requires saṃskāra-śānti karma, and is mitigated by classical donation/charity. The four cardinal sankrantis (Makara, Karka, Tula, Mesha) carry the heaviest classical weight.
SANKRANTI_DOSHA.general: Transition-period challenges, saṃskāra-śānti requirement, religious-donation remedy.

SANTANA_5_LORD_9.name: Santana — 5th-lord in 9th. Progeny dharma-aligned, gurus and dharmic life.
SANTANA_5_LORD_9.prose:
Santana 5-Lord-9 forms when the 5th-lord occupies the 9th house — a trikona-to-trikona connection between the merit-house (5th, purva-punya) and the dharma-house (9th, bhagya). Such yogas are uniformly auspicious in classical doctrine: they fuse the karaka-domains of both houses.

Natives find that their children become dharma-aligned, gurus or guru-figures, and pursue lives of teaching, religious leadership, advisory work, or scholarly inquiry. The connection also reinforces the native's own past-life merit — purva-punya from the 5th radiates outward through the dharmic axis of the 9th.

SANTANA_5_LORD_KENDRA.name: Santana — 5th-lord in kendra. Progeny welfare anchored, intellect sharp.
SANTANA_5_LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Santana 5-Lord-Kendra forms when the 5th-lord — significator of progeny (putra), intellect (buddhi), and merit (purva-punya) — occupies a kendra from the Lagna. The placement anchors all three karaka-domains in the structural pillars of the chart: body (1st), home (4th), partnerships (7th), or career (10th).

Classical commentary (BPHS Ch.18) establishes this as a primary Putra-Sukha-yoga: progeny tend to be long-lived, healthy, and prosperous; intellectual and creative capacities flourish; the native enjoys the fruit of inherited merit. Dusthana placement of the 5th-lord cancels — a wounded progeny-house lord obstructs the very domain it should empower.

SANTANA_5_LORD_LAGNA.name: Santana — 5th-lord in Lagna. Children mirror the self in nature and aim.
SANTANA_5_LORD_LAGNA.prose:
Santana 5-Lord-Lagna forms when the 5th-lord occupies the 1st house. Putra-bhava's ruler enters tanu-bhava (the body-self), fusing the native's identity with the progeny-domain. Children tend to mirror the parent in temperament, values, and life-orientation; the parent's self-presentation is also tinged with creative-pedagogic qualities.

Classical commentary places the native's intellect, creative capacity, and child-bond at the chart's center of gravity — making teaching, mentorship, performance arts, and child-development professions natural channels.

SANTANA_5_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Santana — 5th-lord in own/exalted sign. Full progeny-flower achieved.
SANTANA_5_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose:
Santana 5-Lord-Own/Exalted forms when the 5th-lord occupies its own sign, exaltation, or mooltrikona — the dignified placements where the planet expresses full power. The yoga delivers the complete bouquet of 5th-house results: progeny welfare, intellectual brilliance, creative gifts, and visible fruit of past-life merit.

Classical strength-ordering: Exalted > Own-Sign > Mooltrikona. Natives typically have either many children or one extraordinary child; offspring tend toward high intelligence and creative pursuits; the native's own intellect is also markedly enhanced.
SANTANA_5_LORD_OWN_EXALT.relationships: Many children, or one extraordinary child

SANTANA_5_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Santana — 5th-lord in trikona. Progeny aligned with dharma and merit.
SANTANA_5_LORD_TRIKONA.prose:
Santana 5-Lord-Trikona forms when the 5th-lord occupies a trikona (1st, 5th, 9th) — the dharma-houses. Trikona-houses signify merit accumulated from past births (purva-punya) and the dharmic axis of life. Progeny thus arrive charged with moral-philosophical orientation rather than purely mundane fortune.

Classical commentary places these natives as parents of dharma-rooted, intellectually gifted children who often serve community or scholarly roles. The 9th-house variant is especially pronounced — Santana merges with Bhagya, and the children frequently emerge as teachers, advisors, or transmitters of dharma.

SANTANA_BANDHAN_NODES_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Santana-Bandhan — Rahu/Ketu in 5 + 5-lord in dusthana. Progeny obstruction.
SANTANA_BANDHAN_NODES_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose:
Santana-Bandhan — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when Rahu or Ketu occupies the 5th house AND the 5th-lord simultaneously occupies a dusthana (6th, 8th, or 12th). This is a compounded affliction: nodes wound the progeny-house directly, and the 5th-lord — having abandoned its own karaka-domain for a dusthana — cannot deliver the karaka-results. The combination is among the strongest classical indicators of progeny-difficulty.

Clinical signatures include delayed conception, miscarriage tendency, infertility, or estrangement from offspring. Classical remedies prescribe Jupiter-upasana, Santana-Gopala-stotra, and merit-amplifying charity. The yoga can be mitigated by a strong Jupiter, benefic aspects on the 5th, or a co-existing Bahu-Putra configuration.
SANTANA_BANDHAN_NODES_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.spirituality: Past-life merit deficit in this domain

SANTANA_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_5_9.name: Santana-Bhagya Parivartana — 5-9 mutual exchange. Purva-punya into progeny.
SANTANA_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_5_9.prose:
Santana-Bhagya Parivartana — Saravali Ch.40 — forms when the 5th-lord occupies the 9th and the 9th-lord occupies the 5th: a mutual exchange (parivartana) between the two auspicious trikonas. Parivartana-yogas are uniformly the most powerful class of yoga in classical doctrine; this particular variant fuses purva-punya (5th) with present-life dharma (9th) into a single compounded effect.

Natives receive extraordinary progeny-fortune: children are dharma-aligned, intellectually brilliant, and themselves blessed by fortune. The configuration is rated supreme among parivartana-yogas in the Putra-Bhava context — comparable in strength to a direct Raja-Yoga.

SAPTA_AYUR_SATURN_KENDRA.name: Sapta-Ayur — Saturn in kendra strong. Full Saturn-cycle longevity.
SAPTA_AYUR_SATURN_KENDRA.prose: Sapta-Ayur Saturn-Kendra — Phaladeepika Ch.11 — Saturn in kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) in own/exalted/mooltrikona dignity. Saturn is the chronic-karaka and longevity-stabilizer; well-placed in a foundation-pillar, it grants seven-decade longevity (one full Saturn-cycle ≈ 70 years). Marks the upper boundary of Madhyayu and the threshold of Purnayu. No remedy required.

SARALA.name: Sarala — 8th-lord in 6/8/12. Confers longevity and triumph over hidden adversaries.
SARALA.prose:
Sarala is the second canonical Vipareeta-Raja Yoga (Phaladeepika 6.37). It forms when the 8th-lord — significator of longevity-defects, hidden affairs, and sudden ruptures — falls into one of the three dusthana houses (6th, 8th, or 12th). The double-negative inversion grants paradoxical longevity, protection from hidden dangers, and triumph over concealed adversaries.

Classical commentary describes Sarala natives as researchers, investigators, occultists, forensic specialists, and psychotherapists — those whose work involves uncovering hidden patterns and surviving where others would not. The yoga also confers an unusual capacity for transformation through difficulty: where ordinary 8th-lord placements indicate sudden ruptures, Sarala converts them into thresholds of regeneration.

**Purity caveat.** As with Harsha, the yoga loses effect when the 8th-lord is associated with non-dusthana lords. The cancellation rules encode this — six lord-conjunction predicates fire when the 8th-lord meets any non-dusthana lord.
SARALA.career: Research, investigation, intelligence, forensics, psychotherapy, occult studies, depth-medicine
SARALA.longevity: Long life with capacity for survival under unusual stress
SARALA.mind: Deep psychological insight, transformation through crisis
SARALA.wealth: Gain through inheritance, hidden sources, or transformative ventures

SARASWATI.name: Saraswati — Jupiter+Venus+Mercury in kendra/trikona. Apex learning yoga.
SARASWATI.prose:
Saraswati — Phaladeepika Ch.6 (strict variant) — Jupiter, Venus, AND Mercury — all three intellectual/artistic karakas — simultaneously occupy kendra/trikona houses (1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10) with at least one in own/exalted dignity. Stricter than the broader Saraswati in `chandra.yogas`.

The native receives extraordinary education, multi-skill mastery (arts, philosophy, music), and direct grace of Goddess Saraswati. Classical signature for scholars, writers, teachers, musicians, polymath artists. Doctrinally rated apex among learning-yogas.

SARASWATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA.name: Saraswati Yoga — Mercury, Jupiter, Venus in angular or trinal houses. Supreme intellectual and artistic excellence.
SARASWATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA.prose: Saraswati Yoga (lunar-associated variant) — According to Phaladeepika Chapter 6 and Saravali Chapter 18. This supreme educational yoga is formed when all three natural benefics (Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus) occupy quadrants (kendras) or trines (trikonas). This configuration invokes the direct grace of Goddess Saraswati, conferring exceptional academic achievements, poetic skill, musical talent, and deep mastery of the shastras.
SARASWATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA.mind: Extraordinary intellect, scholarly genius, creative multi-talent
SARASWATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA.spirituality: Devotional surrender to learning, divine grace of Saraswati

SARPA.name: Sarpa Yoga — malefics only in houses 4/7/10 per BPHS 36. Cruel temperament, hardship-prone.
SARPA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Sarpa Yoga = malefic planets exclusively occupy the lower three kendras (4th, 7th, 10th). The "serpent" pattern confers cruel/hostile temperament, hardship-laden life, domestic conflict, career struggle, and unfavourable reputation. The polar opposite of Maala — the same kendras occupied entirely by the wrong class of planet.
SARPA.general: Cruel temperament, hardship, domestic conflict, career struggle, unfavourable reputation.

SARPA_ARISHTA.name: Sarpa-Arishta — Rahu in 8th house. Heightened risk of chemical toxicity, toxic bites, or sudden-accident trauma.
SARPA_ARISHTA.prose: Sarpa-Arishta — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — Rahu in the 8th house. Rahu is the naga-karaka and 8th is the mortality/transformation house; their union signals snake-bite, poisoning, or sudden-accident risk. Remedy: Rahu-shanti, Naga-puja, sarpa-dana especially in Shravan, Gayatri-japa.

SAT_IN_10.name: Saturn in 10th: dig-balī Karma Raja Yoga (Śaśa-flavour). Long-haul fame, royal honour per Phaladeepika 8.
SAT_IN_10.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Saturn in the 10th forms a special Karma Raja Yoga — Saturn in the career-bhava is dig-balī (directionally strong), conferring long-haul career fame, royal recognition, service-leadership, and stable high office. BPHS Ch.25 — dig-balī Saturn augments career fame. Mirror of (but distinct from) Śaśa Mahāpurusha; native's work outlasts contemporaries.
SAT_IN_10.general: Dig-balī Karma Raja Yoga, long-haul fame, royal recognition, service-leadership, stable high office.

SAT_IN_11.name: Saturn in 11th: Lābha-Sthairya Yoga. Long-term wealth accumulation, service-class fame per Phaladeepika 8.
SAT_IN_11.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Saturn in the 11th forms a Lābha-Sthairya Yoga — long-term wealth accumulation, fame within the service/working class, and stable desire-fulfilment. BPHS Ch.25 — the 11th is Saturn's most exalted house, conferring sustained gains. The signature placement for those who build slowly but become reliably wealthy in old age.
SAT_IN_11.general: Lābha-Sthairya Yoga, long-term wealth, service-class fame, stable desire-fulfilment, retirement prosperity.

SAT_IN_3.name: Saturn in 3rd: Dhairya-Parākrama Yoga. Fame via long effort, sibling longevity per Phaladeepika 8.
SAT_IN_3.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Saturn in the 3rd forms a Dhairya-Parākrama Yoga — fame through long-haul effort, elder-sibling longevity, and stable enterprise. BPHS Ch.25 — Saturn in upachaya bhavas (3/6/10/11) is auspicious; it builds slowly but unshakably. Common in marathon-career professionals and patient entrepreneurs.
SAT_IN_3.general: Dhairya-Parākrama Yoga, fame via long effort, elder-sibling longevity, stable enterprise.

SAT_IN_6.name: Saturn in 6th: enemy-disease-victory yoga. Long-struggle triumph, service-fame per Phaladeepika 8.
SAT_IN_6.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Saturn in the 6th forms an enemy-disease-victory Vipareeta-style yoga — long-struggle triumph over enemies, recovery from chronic disease, debt-cancellation, and fame for service. BPHS Ch.25 — Saturn in upachaya yields its best fruit. Common in those whose careers are built on overcoming sustained adversity.
SAT_IN_6.general: Enemy-disease-victory yoga, long-struggle triumph, debt-cancellation, service-fame, perseverance.

SAT_KETU_CONJ.name: Saturn-Ketu conjunction — Mokṣa-Vairāgya per BPHS 7. Spiritual detachment, deep contemplation.
SAT_KETU_CONJ.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, Saturn-Ketu conjunction is mixed-effect — twin renunciation-significators confer spiritual detachment, deep contemplation, esoteric scripture inclination, and mokṣa-aptitude. Outer karmic struggle accompanied by inner growth. Common in monastics, mystics, and those whose worldly pursuits dissolve in favour of inner work.
SAT_KETU_CONJ.general: Mokṣa-Vairāgya, spiritual detachment, deep contemplation, esoteric study, mokṣa-aptitude.

SAT_RAHU_CONJ.name: Saturn-Rahu conjunction — Śāpa Yoga per BPHS 7. Long-term hardship, hidden enemies.
SAT_RAHU_CONJ.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, Saturn-Rahu conjunction = Śāpa Yoga (curse-yoga). Twin-malefic union confers long-duration hardship, hidden-enemy proliferation, abandonment of dharma, and a life of sustained struggle. Often interpreted classically as past-life karmic consequence (śāpa = curse). One of the most challenging conjunctions; requires extensive remedial measures.
SAT_RAHU_CONJ.general: Śāpa Yoga, long-term hardship, hidden enemies, dharma-abandonment risk, sustained struggle.

SAUBHAGYA_VENUS_KENDRA_9LORD_KENDRA.name: Saubhagya — Venus + 9-lord both in kendras. Beauty, refinement, fortune.
SAUBHAGYA_VENUS_KENDRA_9LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Saubhagya is described in Saravali Ch.34. It forms when Venus AND the 9th-lord both occupy kendras (1/4/7/10). The compound combines aesthetic refinement (Venus) with bhagya-flow (9-lord) anchored in structural-pillar houses.

The Sanskrit name "Saubhagya" literally means "auspicious good fortune" — and classical commentary places these natives in roles where refined enjoyment and durable success integrate: cultivated families, harmonious marriages, artistic and diplomatic success, and the kind of aesthetic life that is also socially honored.
SAUBHAGYA_VENUS_KENDRA_9LORD_KENDRA.career: Arts, design, diplomacy, hospitality, fashion, performing arts
SAUBHAGYA_VENUS_KENDRA_9LORD_KENDRA.mind: Aesthetic sensibility; capacity for cultural cultivation
SAUBHAGYA_VENUS_KENDRA_9LORD_KENDRA.wealth: Refined affluence; aesthetic enjoyment integrated with material success

SHAKATA.name: Shakata — Moon in 6/8/12 from Jupiter. Cart-wheel yoga, fortune cycles.
SHAKATA.prose:
Shakata — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — Moon in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house from Jupiter. Two natural benefics in mutual-dusthana relationship produces the "cart-wheel" yoga: fortunes rise and fall like a wheel.

The native's life-fortune cycles rather than steadily building — periods of high status followed by reversals, then renewed rise. More common in small-traders, travel-linked vocations, and businesses subject to unexpected events. Cancelled when the Moon is in a kendra from the Lagna (Saravali variant): the Lagna-lord stabilizing the manas-karaka stops the cart-wheel from rotating.
SHAKATA.mind: Fortune cycles rather than steady build

SHANI_DOSHA.name: Shani Dosha — Saturn weak or papa-aspected per Saravali 15. Long-haul struggle.
SHANI_DOSHA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Shani Dosha = Saturn weakly placed in Lagna/kendra OR aspected by malefics. Confers long-duration karmic struggle, sade-sati-like sustained adversity, endurance-testing work. Distinct from full sade-sati (which is transit-based). Classical remedies: Saturday vrata, blue-sapphire dhāraṇa (after astrologer review), Shani-mantra recitation.
SHANI_DOSHA.general: Long-duration struggle, sustained adversity, endurance-testing work, service-class karma.

SHANI_MANGAL.name: Shani-Mangal — Saturn+Mars conjunct. Cold meets heat in conflict.
SHANI_MANGAL.prose:
Shani-Mangal — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — Saturn and Mars conjunct. Two natural-enemy grahas forced together: Saturn (cold-karaka) and Mars (hot-karaka) produce structural antagonism — Mars' acute intensity collides with Saturn's chronic restriction, generating acute-chronic dual stress.

Clinical signature: accident-tendency, surgical interventions, conflicts with authority, chronic frustration, bone/muscle issues. Classical remedy: Mars-Saturn pacification, Hanuman-upasana, vigilance-rituals. Benefic aspect can soften.

SHANKHA.name: Shankha — 5th and 6th lords in kendra. Conch-shell yoga of fame.
SHANKHA.prose:
Shankha — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — 5th-lord (purva-punya/intellect) AND 6th-lord (enemy/service) both in kendras. The "conch shell" yoga — named for the classical auspicious symbol; two karaka-domains (merit and service) anchored in foundation-pillars.

The native receives fame, longevity, and honor through service to dharma. Phaladeepika lists this among the high Raja Yogas — the service-significator combined with purva-punya-significator produces auspicious eminence. Classical signature for social workers, physicians, religious leaders, dharma-centered public figures.

SHASHA.name: Shasha Yoga — Saturn in kendra and dignity. Confers long life, strategic discipline, and administrative authority.
SHASHA.prose: Shasha Yoga is the fifth and final Pancha Mahapurusha Yoga (BPHS Ch. 76, v. 5), representing the absolute pinnacle of Saturnian gravity, durability, and leadership. It is established when Saturn is placed in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) from the Ascendant or the Moon while occupying its own sign (Capricorn/Aquarius) or exaltation sign (Libra). Saturn rules over the space of labor, time, justice, and endurance; hence, this yoga instills unparalleled patience, strategic vision, and structural discipline. The native rise in life is characterized by a slow but unstoppable upward trajectory, culminating in lasting authority. Historically characterized as being "served by many" (Phaladeepika), in modern times this yoga distinguishes elite chief executives of heavy industries (mining, steel, real estate), apex civil servants, legal pioneers, and mass-movement political leaders who command the loyalty of millions.
SHASHA.body: Resilient bone structure, strong physical endurance, and a mature, commanding countenance
SHASHA.career: Pinnacle positions in public administration, judiciary, corporate governance, mining, and heavy manufacturing
SHASHA.mind: Unshakable patience, profound mental gravity, high work ethic, and a systems-oriented mindset
SHASHA.wealth: Enduring financial security built on real estate, mineral assets, and long-term capital investments

SHASHA_BHANGA.name: Shasha Bhanga — Saturn retrograde in kendra. Shasha-yoga effects are rendered unstable or subject to delays.
SHASHA_BHANGA.prose: Shasha Bhanga is formed when the core conditions of Shasha Yoga are present, but Saturn is simultaneously retrograde (vakri). Because Saturn is an outer planet and orbits far from the Sun, it rarely combusts; hence, retrogression is the primary defect considered under Phaladeepika 6.7. Retrogression internalizes Saturn's heavy, structural energy.
