While the native still possesses a deep reservoir of patience and work ethic, their life path is subjected to recurring resets and structural delays. Executive authority or administrative prominence is achieved, but only after weathering severe obstacles and years of additional waiting. The promised longevity is realized, but often accompanied by chronic health challenges, requiring recurrent medical attention in later years. Reciting Shani Gayatri and worshipping Lord Hanuman are standard classical remedies.
SHASHA_BHANGA.career: Enduring success and authority are guaranteed but delayed significantly, requiring double the effort
SHASHA_BHANGA.longevity: A long life but accompanied by chronic health issues, particularly affecting the bones or nervous system
SHASHA_BHANGA.mind: Inherent discipline coupled with periodic phases of directionlessness, mental exhaustion, or existential doubt

SHASHA_EXALTED.name: Supreme Shasha — Saturn exalted (Libra) in kendra. Apex authority-yoga conferring discipline and long life.
SHASHA_EXALTED.prose: Supreme Shasha represents the absolute pinnacle of Saturnian durability, executive power, and mass leadership. When Saturn—the significator of time, labor, justice, and longevity—occupies its sign of deep exaltation, Libra (at 20 degrees), within a kendra, it manifests its most strategic and harmonious attributes. Libra, a sign of balance, justice, and public relationships ruled by Venus, refines Saturn's harshness into calculated strategic patience, extreme sense of justice, and unparalleled governance capabilities. The native is endowed with a long life, massive public support, and an exceptional capacity for sustained labor. Historically celebrated as the marker of empire-builders and commanders, in the modern world this yoga produces elite political statesmen, apex judicial figures, and industrial magnates who control natural resources and heavy infrastructures.
SHASHA_EXALTED.career: Top-tier state administrators, prime ministers, supreme court chief justices, and founders of massive industrial empires
SHASHA_EXALTED.longevity: Enduring physical and cognitive vitality, surviving to a ripe old age with full control of faculties
SHASHA_EXALTED.mind: Apex self-discipline, profound mental gravity, unshakable patience, and long-range strategic wisdom

SHASHA_FROM_MOON.name: Shasha from Moon — Saturn angular from the Moon in dignity. Confers profound patience and self-discipline.
SHASHA_FROM_MOON.prose: Chandra Shasha Yoga is established when Saturn occupies a kendra from the natal Moon while positioned in its own or exaltation sign. In Vedic chart analysis, while a Lagna-based Shasha manifests as physical and administrative prominence, Chandra Shasha fundamentally structures the emotional landscape. The alignment of the emotional Moon with the disciplined, patient, and mature energy of Saturn constructs a highly resilient, stoical psyche. The native is endowed with immense patience, absolute self-discipline, and a long-range strategic wisdom that allows them to remain undisturbed under high pressure. When Saturn is angular from both the Lagna and the Moon simultaneously, it represents the supreme Shasha configuration, elevating the native to an apex political statesman or massive industrial leader.
SHASHA_FROM_MOON.mind: Unshakable emotional resilience, profound mental endurance, and strategic long-term foresight

SHASTRA_ARISHTA.name: Shastra-Arishta — Mars and Saturn in 4th house. Risk of weapon-related injury, vehicle accidents, or domestic trauma.
SHASTRA_ARISHTA.prose: Shastra-Arishta — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — Mars and Saturn jointly in the 4th house. Mars (weapon/wound karaka) fused with Saturn (chronic-cruelty karaka) in the foundation-house (home/vehicle/comfort) signals weapon-injury, vehicle-accident, or home-trauma risk. Remedy: Mars-Saturn pacification, Subrahmanya-upasana, vehicle-vigilance.

SHATAYU_JUPITER_LAGNA.name: Shatayu — Jupiter in Lagna in own/exalted. Hundred-year life indicator.
SHATAYU_JUPITER_LAGNA.prose: Shatayu Jupiter-Lagna — Phaladeepika Ch.11 — Jupiter in Lagna in own (Sagittarius/Pisces) or exalted (Cancer) sign. The longevity-karaka in its highest dignity in the body-house produces the classical "100-year life" indicator — a special tier above ordinary Purnayu. The configuration is rare; where it forms, classical commentary places the native in the lineage of long-lived sages and dharma-keepers. No remedy required.

SHOOLA.name: Shoola Yoga — 7 planets in 3 signs per BPHS 36. Fierce, military-leader temperament.
SHOOLA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Shoola Yoga = 7 grahas in 3 signs. Native is fierce-natured, military-leader-like, drawn to bold/dangerous action, sharp-mannered. The "shoola" (spear) name signals piercing intensity. Common in soldiers, surgeons, hunters, athletes — those whose path requires sharp edges.
SHOOLA.general: Fierce nature, military leadership, bold action, sharp manner, piercing intensity.

SHRINGATAKA.name: Shringataka Yoga — 7 grahas in trikoṇas (1, 5, 9) per BPHS 36. Hero-like trikoṇa Raja-yoga.
SHRINGATAKA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Shringataka Yoga = 7 grahas in the three trikoṇas (1, 5, 9). The "trident-peak" pattern produces a hero-figure trikoṇa Raja-yoga: past-merit fused with present fame and future destiny, military leadership, and dharmic-royal capability. Among the most exalted Akriti yogas.
SHRINGATAKA.general: Trikoṇa Raja Yoga, hero-figure status, past-merit + destiny union, dharmic-royal capability.

SHUBHA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.name: Shubha-Kartari (Moon) — The Moon hemmed in between natural benefics. Complete emotional protection.
SHUBHA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.prose: Shubha-Kartari (Moon) — Under Phaladeepika Chapter 6, Verse 17. This highly protective yoga is formed when natural benefics occupy both the 2nd and 12th houses from the Moon. Flanked by benefic energies, the Moon (representing the mind and emotions) is shielded from external afflictions. The native enjoys exceptional mental resilience, peace of mind, and continuous support from their immediate environment.
SHUBHA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.mind: Deep emotional resilience, immunity to depression, peaceful mindset
SHUBHA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.relationships: Continuous emotional and social support, popularity

SREENATHA.name: Sreenātha Yoga — 10th + 9th + 7th lords linked. Lakshmi-Lord-like prosperity per Jataka Parijata 5.
SREENATHA.prose: Per Jataka Parijata Ch.5, Sreenātha Yoga forms when the 10th, 9th, and 7th lords are linked auspiciously. The native attains prosperity comparable to "Sreenātha" (Lord of Lakshmi = Vishnu) — wealth that flows from dharma, partnership, and karma in concert. Distinct from chandra.yogas' SREENATHA (which is moon-axis-flavoured); this one is the Jataka-Parijata classical reading.
SREENATHA.general: Lakshmi-Lord-like wealth, dharmic royal fame, ideal-householder reputation, karma-dharma joy.

SRIKANTHA.name: Śrīkaṇṭha Yoga — Sun-Moon-Lagna navāṃśa-lords in same signs per Saravali 34. Śiva-like persona.
SRIKANTHA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Śrīkaṇṭha Yoga = the lords of Sun's, Moon's, and Lagna's navāṃśa signs all in same-signs / auspicious mutual placements. Confers Śiva-like persona ("Śrīkaṇṭha" = Śiva), yogi-disposition, mantra-siddhi, and intense tapas-power. Yogi-king radiance. Common in spiritual masters with public visibility.
SRIKANTHA.general: Śiva-like persona, yogi disposition, mantra-siddhi, tapas-power, dharmic fame.

SRINATH.name: Sreenātha Yoga (named-classical variant) — 7L in 10th aspected by Mercury per Jataka Parijata 5.
SRINATH.prose: Per Jataka Parijata Ch.5, this Sreenātha-named-classical variant = 7th lord placed in 10th, aspected by Mercury. Distinct from raja.yogas' SREENATHA (10L+9L+7L linked). The named-classical version confers Lakshmi-Lord (Vishnu)-like prosperity, dharmic royal recognition, and ideal-householder reputation — same flavour, different trigger.
SRINATH.general: Lakshmi-Lord-like prosperity, dharmic royal recognition, ideal-householder fame, dharma-karma capability.

STHIRA_AYUR_FIXED_LAGNA.name: Sthira-Ayur — fixed Lagna with strong Saturn. Steady, durable longevity.
STHIRA_AYUR_FIXED_LAGNA.prose: Sthira-Ayur Fixed-Lagna — Saravali Ch.41 — fixed Lagna (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius) with Saturn well-placed (kendra, trikona, own, exalted, or mooltrikona). Fixed signs grant structural durability; Saturn is the chronic-stability karaka — their union signals steady, long-lived endurance. Not as supreme as Purnayu, but quality-rich and dependably long. No remedy required.

STREE_DEERGH_ABSENCE.name: Strī-Dīrgha absence — extended-Milan koot deficit per Muhurta Chintamani 8.
STREE_DEERGH_ABSENCE.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi Ch.8, Strī-Dīrgha Koot is satisfied when the groom's nakshatra is at least 9 nakshatras forward from the bride's. Its ABSENCE is the dosha — confers reduced marital stability and risk to the wife's longevity. One of the extended-Milan checks beyond the standard 8 Aṣṭa-Kūṭa.

SUBHA_KARTARI_10.name: Subha Kartari (10th) — 10th house hemmed by benefics per Phaladeepika 6. Stable career.
SUBHA_KARTARI_10.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Subha Kartari around the 10th = benefics in 9th and 11th houses (flanking the 10th). Confers stable career fame, dharma-karma synergy, and friend/business gains. The "benefic-scissors" pattern around the karma-bhāva is among the most reliable career-protection yogas.
SUBHA_KARTARI_10.general: Career-protection yoga, stable fame, dharma-karma synergy, friend/business gains.

SUBHA_KARTARI_7.name: Subha Kartari (7th) — 7th house hemmed by benefics per Phaladeepika 6. Auspicious marriage.
SUBHA_KARTARI_7.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Subha Kartari around the 7th = benefic planets in the 6th and 8th houses (flanking the 7th). The "benefic-scissors" pattern protects and elevates the partnership-bhāva: auspicious marriage, stable partner, healthy business partnerships, and 7th-house-significations protection.
SUBHA_KARTARI_7.general: Auspicious marriage, stable partner, healthy partnerships, 7th-bhāva protection.

SUBHA_KARTARI_LAGNA.name: Subha-Kartari Lagna — Lagna hemmed by benefics. Body-self protected.
SUBHA_KARTARI_LAGNA.prose:
Subha-Kartari Lagna — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — natural benefics (Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, unwounded Moon) simultaneously occupy the 2nd and 12th from Lagna, creating a "benefic scissors" around the body-self.

The Lagna is atma-karaka and shareera-karaka; benefic-flanking on both sides confers physical wellness, protection from external malefic influences, and long-term health stability. The structural opposite of Papa-Kartari Lagna. Astrologers read this as foundation-level protection of personality and constitution.

SUBHA_KARTARI_SUN.name: Subha-Kartari (Sun) — Sun hemmed by benefics. Soul-karaka protected.
SUBHA_KARTARI_SUN.prose:
Subha-Kartari (Sun) — Phaladeepika Ch.6 — natural benefics (Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, unwounded Moon) simultaneously occupy the 2nd and 12th from the Sun. The atma-karaka is flanked by benefic protection on both sides.

The Sun is the soul-significator and pitru-karaka; benefic-flanking confers personality-stability, steady authority, and paternal welfare. Classical signature: gradual but durable rise in politics, administration, or public leadership; high self-confidence held in disciplined check; respect from elders and authority figures.

SUKARMA_BENEFIC_10.name: Sukarma — benefic in 10th. Dharmic profession, skilled action.
SUKARMA_BENEFIC_10.prose:
Sukarma is described in Phaladeepika 6.39. It forms when a benefic graha (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, or unafflicted Moon) occupies the 10th house. The Sanskrit name "sukarma" literally means "good action" — and classical commentary describes these natives as engaged in dharmically-aligned professions where skill (kushala) and right-action (sukarma) integrate.

The yoga is cancelled when a malefic also occupies the 10th — the mixing dilutes the pure benefic quality of the karma-house.
SUKARMA_BENEFIC_10.career: Dharmically-aligned profession; teaching, counseling, arts, ethical commerce
SUKARMA_BENEFIC_10.wealth: Honorable reputation; resources through respected work

SUMUKHA.name: Sumukha Yoga — 2nd + 11th lords united. Sweet speech, sustained wealth per Saravali 34.
SUMUKHA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Sumukha Yoga forms when the 2nd lord (wealth/speech) and the 11th lord (gains/desires) unite — the native enjoys sweet, persuasive speech, sustained wealth-gains, expanded friend/family circles, and a generally beloved disposition. A "happy-face" yoga in the literal sense (su-mukha = good-faced).
SUMUKHA.general: Sweet speech, sustained wealth gains, friend-family expansion, beloved disposition.

SUNAPHA.name: Sunapha Yoga — Any planet (except Sun, Rahu, and Ketu) in the 2nd house from the Moon. Self-earned wealth.
SUNAPHA.prose: Sunapha Yoga — As defined in Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 4. This yoga is formed when any planet other than the Sun, Rahu, and Ketu occupies the 2nd house from the Moon. It represents a powerful configuration for self-acquired wealth, eloquence, and personal enterprise. The specific material results are determined by the particular planet occupying the 2nd house, as shown in the SUNAPHA_<planet> sub-variants.

SUNAPHA_JUPITER.name: Sunapha-Jupiter — Jupiter in the 2nd house from the Moon. Dharmic wealth and wisdom.
SUNAPHA_JUPITER.prose: Sunapha-Jupiter — According to Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 4. When Jupiter occupies the 2nd house from the Moon, it sanctifies the native's speech, family status, and earnings. This planetary union confers wealth through ethical and scholarly endeavors such as teaching, spiritual guidance, judicial service, or state advisor roles. The native's voice carries philosophical authority.
SUNAPHA_JUPITER.career: Academician, judge, spiritual guide, or advisor

SUNAPHA_MARS.name: Sunapha-Mars — Mars in the 2nd house from the Moon. Wealth through courage and technical skill.
SUNAPHA_MARS.prose: Sunapha-Mars — Per Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 4. When Mars occupies the 2nd house from the Moon, it channels the courageous and technical energy of Mars into the native's house of wealth and speech. The native earns through dynamic, courageous, or highly specialized activities such as military service, surgery, competitive athletics, engineering, or executive leadership.
SUNAPHA_MARS.career: Military, surgical, athletic, or engineering pursuits
SUNAPHA_MARS.material: Wealth generated via valor, physical drive, and technical action

SUNAPHA_MERCURY.name: Sunapha-Mercury — Mercury in the 2nd house from the Moon. Prosperity through intellect and communication.
SUNAPHA_MERCURY.prose: Sunapha-Mercury — Under Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 4. When Mercury resides in the 2nd house from the Moon, it brings intellectual refinement to the native's financial capabilities and speech. The native achieves prosperity through writing, accounting, trade, commerce, advisory positions, or diplomatic representation.
SUNAPHA_MERCURY.career: Merchant, diplomat, financial advisor, writer, or editor
SUNAPHA_MERCURY.mind: Articulate intellect, linguistic fluency, mathematical ability

SUNAPHA_SATURN.name: Sunapha-Saturn — Saturn in the 2nd house from the Moon. Wealth through discipline and long-cycle efforts.
SUNAPHA_SATURN.prose: Sunapha-Saturn — Under Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 4. When Saturn is in the 2nd house from the Moon, it brings rigorous discipline, patience, and realistic financial structures. Although initial progress may be slow or marked by perseverance, the native accumulates enduring wealth through mining, real estate, agriculture, public administration, or industrial enterprises.
SUNAPHA_SATURN.material: Generational wealth built systematically through perseverance

SUNAPHA_STRICT.name: Sunapha (strict) — benefic in 2nd from Moon, 12th vacant. Pure earned wealth.
SUNAPHA_STRICT.prose:
Sunapha (strict-form) — Brihat Jataka 13.4 strict reading — benefic in the 2nd from Moon AND nothing (except Sun/nodes) in the 12th. The broader `SUNAPHA` in `chandra.yogas` fires on any planet in the 2nd; the strict form requires both specifically-benefic occupation AND 12th vacancy.

The distinction matters doctrinally: broad form indicates mixed earned-and-inherited wealth; strict form indicates pure earned/self-built wealth. Astrologers comparing Kala / PL / JHora reports expect this granularity surfaced as a separate yoga.

SUNAPHA_VENUS.name: Sunapha-Venus — Venus in the 2nd house from the Moon. Affluence through arts and refinement.
SUNAPHA_VENUS.prose: Sunapha-Venus — Phaladeepika Chapter 13, Verse 4. When Venus is placed in the 2nd house from the Moon, it infuses the native's financial sphere and speech with charm, artistry, and diplomacy. The native achieves abundance through artistic expressions, high-end commerce, diplomatic service, design, or the entertainment industry.
SUNAPHA_VENUS.career: Artist, designer, diplomat, high-end luxury merchant
SUNAPHA_VENUS.material: Affluence, collection of fine vehicles and properties
SUNAPHA_VENUS.mind: Aesthetic sensitivity, appreciation of beauty and relationships

SUN_EXALTED_KENDRA.name: Sun exalted in Kendra: Mahā-Raja Yoga. Highest office, global fame, universal honour per Saravali 38.
SUN_EXALTED_KENDRA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.38, Sun exalted in a kendra forms a Mahā-Raja Yoga — Aries-exalted Sun in 1/4/7/10 acquires a double-strength (exaltation + kendra) that delivers the highest office, globe-spanning fame, universal honour, and unshakeable reputation. Phaladeepika Ch.8 — comparable to a Mahā-Puruṣa Yoga in elevation. Signature placement of supreme statesmen and globally-recognised authorities.
SUN_EXALTED_KENDRA.general: Mahā-Raja Yoga, highest office, global fame, universal honour, unshakeable reputation.

SUN_IN_1.name: Sun in Lagna: lustrous, self-respecting, pitta-natured, royal honour per Phaladeepika 8 / BPHS 21.
SUN_IN_1.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Sun in Lagna confers lustrous appearance, self-respect, pitta-natured constitution, fierce temperament, and royal recognition. BPHS Ch.21 — the soul-significator in the body-bhava augments self-radiance but slightly diminishes paternal happiness (since Sun aspects 7th, leaving 9th un-aspected). Common in leaders, executives, and those whose personality itself is the engine of authority.
SUN_IN_1.general: Lustrous appearance, self-respect, royal recognition, fierce temperament, pitta-natured constitution.

SUN_IN_10.name: Sun in 10th: dig-balī Karma Raja Yoga. High office, authority, royal honour, stable fame per Phaladeepika 8.
SUN_IN_10.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Sun in the 10th forms a dig-balī Karma Raja Yoga — Sun in karma-bhava is directionally exalted. The native attains high office, exercises real authority, receives royal recognition, and earns stable fame. BPHS Ch.21 — the 10th is the Sun's most exalted house. Co-forms Amala Yoga (benefic in 10th from Lagna or Moon). Signature placement of statesmen and CEOs.
SUN_IN_10.general: Dig-balī Karma Raja Yoga, high office, authority, royal recognition, stable fame, Amala-quality reputation.

SUN_IN_11.name: Sun in 11th: Rāja-Lābha Yoga. Wealth via royal recognition, elder-sibling power per Phaladeepika 8.
SUN_IN_11.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Sun in the 11th forms a Rāja-Lābha Yoga — wealth via royal recognition, powerful elder siblings, authority-driven fame, and steady desire-fulfilment. BPHS Ch.21 — Sun in the upachaya-gain bhava augments all life-domains. Common in those whose income flows from holding office or executive recognition.
SUN_IN_11.general: Rāja-Lābha Yoga, royal-recognition wealth, elder-sibling power, authority fame, desire-fulfilment.

SUN_IN_5.name: Sun in 5th — Ātma-Prajñā Raja Yoga (named-classical) per Phaladeepika 8.
SUN_IN_5.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8 (named-classical variant), Sun in 5th = Ātma-Prajñā Raja Yoga. Soul-significator in past-merit bhāva confers radiant/exceptional progeny, royal fame, mantra-siddhi, and authority-station. The 5th's native-fame potency is amplified by Sun's luminosity.
SUN_IN_5.general: Ātma-Prajñā Raja Yoga, radiant progeny, royal fame, mantra-siddhi, authority station.

SUN_IN_9.name: Sun in 9th: Pitṛ-Bhāgya Yoga. Paternal happiness, dharma, royal fame, guru-grace per Phaladeepika 8.
SUN_IN_9.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Sun in the 9th forms a Pitṛ-Bhāgya Yoga — paternal happiness, dharmic disposition, royal fame, and guru-grace. BPHS Ch.21 — the Sun (kāraka of father) in the bhāgya-bhava forms a kāraka-trikoṇa Raja-yoga structure. Common in those whose father is a positive force in their life and whose dharmic standing is recognized.
SUN_IN_9.general: Pitṛ-Bhāgya Yoga, paternal happiness, dharmic disposition, royal fame, guru's grace.

SUN_JUP_CONJ.name: Sun-Jupiter conjunction — Royal-Dharma Raja Yoga. Higher education, dharmic fame per Saravali 15.
SUN_JUP_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Sun-Jupiter conjunction forms a Royal-Dharma Raja Yoga — soul-significator joining wisdom-significator. Confers higher education, dharmic royal fame, karma-dharma capability, and aptitude for teaching/judging professions. Phaladeepika Ch.6 ranks it among the named Raja-yogas. Common in scholars, judges, and dharmic leaders.
SUN_JUP_CONJ.general: Royal-Dharma Raja Yoga, higher education, dharmic royal fame, karma-dharma capability.

SUN_KETU_CONJ.name: Sun-Ketu conjunction — mokṣa-flavoured per BPHS 7. Inward radiance, ego-dissolution.
SUN_KETU_CONJ.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, Sun-Ketu conjunction is mixed-effect — outer royal power is reduced (Ketu eclipses Sun) but inner mokṣa-tendency, subtle vision, spiritual royal aptitude, and ego-dissolution lessons strengthen. Ketu's grahaṇa-dosha (eclipse-affliction) often manifests as paternal difficulty. Common in spiritual aspirants whose worldly authority is muted but inner authority is profound.
SUN_KETU_CONJ.general: Mokṣa-tendency, subtle vision, spiritual royal aptitude, paternal difficulty, ego-dissolution.

SUN_MARS_CONJ.name: Sun-Mars conjunction — fierce radiance, courage, anger-prone temperament per Saravali 15.
SUN_MARS_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Sun-Mars conjunction confers fierce radiance, bold courage, anger-prone temperament, military leadership, and weapon/skill mastery. Two pitta-fire energies fuse into an exceptionally sharp character. Common in soldiers, surgeons, athletes, and those whose temperament is incandescent.
SUN_MARS_CONJ.general: Fierce radiance, courage, anger-prone temperament, military leadership, weapon-skill.

SUN_MER_VEN_CONJ.name: Sun-Mercury-Venus triple conjunction — art-intellect-royal triveṇī per Saravali 15.
SUN_MER_VEN_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Sun-Mercury-Venus triple conjunction = art-intellect-royal triveṇī (three-river confluence). Soul + intellect + art significators in a single sign yield all-round skill, royal artistic fame, intelligent-spouse aptitude, and upper-class respect. The three energies amplify each other into a renaissance-personality archetype.
SUN_MER_VEN_CONJ.general: Art-intellect-royal triveṇī, all-round skill, royal-artistic fame, intelligent-spouse aptitude, upper-class respect.

SUN_MOON_CONJ.name: Sun-Moon conjunction — Amāvasya birth per Saravali 15. Self-mind tension, maternal anxiety.
SUN_MOON_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Sun-Moon conjunction = Amāvasya (new-moon) birth. The Moon, eclipsed by Sun's rays, loses its outward radiance. Confers internal tension between soul (Sun) and mind (Moon), maternal-health concerns, and reduced lunar luminosity (emotional reserve). Phaladeepika notes the placement tests maternal welfare. Common in introverts whose inner life dominates.
SUN_MOON_CONJ.general: Amāvasya-birth yoga, soul-mind tension, maternal anxiety, lunar-luminosity reduction.

SUN_SAT_CONJ.name: Sun-Saturn conjunction — paternal-karmic strain per Saravali 15. Father-hardship, career struggle.
SUN_SAT_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Sun-Saturn conjunction is a difficult yoga — soul-significator and karma-significator are natural enemies. Confers paternal hardship/separation, career struggle, authority disputes, and reduced personal radiance. Sun and Saturn are mutual enemies; their conjunction tests father-bond and life-direction. Common in those whose father-relationship is fraught and whose career path requires extra effort.
SUN_SAT_CONJ.general: Paternal hardship, career struggle, authority disputes, diminished personal radiance.

SUN_VEN_CONJ.name: Sun-Venus conjunction — Royal-Refinement union. Royal grace, artistic fame per Saravali 15.
SUN_VEN_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Sun-Venus conjunction forms a Royal-Refinement union — soul-significator with pleasure-significator. Confers royal grace, artistic fame, respect from women, and upper-class connections. Caveat: Venus combust by Sun (within ~10°) can produce some marital strain — Venus loses its refining capacity when too close to the king-planet.
SUN_VEN_CONJ.general: Royal-refinement union, royal grace, artistic fame, respect from women, upper-class connections.

SURYA_UCHCHA_10.name: Sun exalted in 10th — Aries Sun in karma-bhava. Apex authority-yoga.
SURYA_UCHCHA_10.prose:
Sun-Uchcha-10 — Saravali Ch.20 — Sun in its exaltation sign (Aries) placed in the 10th house. The Sun receives natural digbala in the 10th; the exaltation adds compounding dignity. Their union in the karma-bhava is doctrinally the apex authority-yoga.

The native attains top-tier political or administrative position, government favor, and exceptional fame. Classical signature for leaders, top executives, statesmen, and famous artists. Paternal welfare is exceptional; self-image is singular. This is the rare convergence of full digbala AND exaltation — where it forms, expect peak-tier eminence.

TAJIK_INKILAB_LAGNA_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Inkilab — Lagna-lord in dusthana. Year of reversal.
TAJIK_INKILAB_LAGNA_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose:
Inkilab — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — Lagna-lord in dusthana of the varshaphala chart. "Inkilab" means "reversal/upheaval" in Persian.

The native faces plans yielding inverse results, unexpected changes, and the need for long-term direction-reassessment. Inauspicious year for major decisions or new ventures; suitable for inward review and recalibration.

TAJIK_IQBALA_BENEFIC_LAGNA.name: Iqbala — benefic in Lagna. Year of grace and protection.
TAJIK_IQBALA_BENEFIC_LAGNA.prose: Iqbala Benefic-Lagna — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — natural benefic occupies the varshaphala Lagna. The native receives grace-flow, health-stability, and unexpected support for the year. The flavor varies by which benefic: Jupiter brings dharmic support; Venus brings prosperity; Mercury brings intellectual gains.

TAJIK_IQBALA_JUPITER_KENDRA.name: Iqbala Jupiter-Kendra — supreme rising-fortune year.
TAJIK_IQBALA_JUPITER_KENDRA.prose:
Iqbala Jupiter-Kendra — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — Jupiter in a kendra of the varshaphala chart. The supreme tier among Iqbala configurations: Jupiter functions simultaneously as longevity-, dharma-, and bhagya-karaka, all activated for the year.

The native receives major fortune-growth, dharmic support, and an auspicious window for long-term decisions. Education, guru-grace, progeny-related good news.

TAJIK_IQBALA_LAGNA_LORD_KENDRA.name: Iqbala — Lagna-lord in kendra. Rising-fortune year.
TAJIK_IQBALA_LAGNA_LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Iqbala — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — Lagna-lord (of varshaphala chart) in kendra. "Iqbala" means "rising/fortune-ascent" in Persian. Self-significator's lord in foundation-pillar.

The native receives ascending fortune, career growth, and goal-attainment for the year. Auspicious year for major decisions, ventures, or significant life-transitions.

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MARS_SATURN.name: Itthashala Mars-Saturn — disciplined-action harmony (mixed).
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MARS_SATURN.prose:
Itthashala Mars-Saturn — Tajika Nilakanthi Ch.5 — Mars and Saturn in mutual applying-aspect. Two natural-enemy malefics in mutual aspect; in Tajik doctrine this configuration's mutual-strength-support converts the natural antagonism into disciplined martial action — mixed-positive.

The native receives action-power, patience, and structured leadership in difficult contexts. Year-long growth in surgery, engineering, military, heavy-industry vocations. Caveat: inner tension and anger-management remain operative concerns.

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MERCURY_VENUS.name: Itthashala Mercury-Venus — intellect + arts harmony.
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MERCURY_VENUS.prose:
Itthashala Mercury-Venus — Tajika Nilakanthi Ch.5 — Mercury (intellect-karaka) and Venus (arts/bhoga-karaka) in mutual applying-aspect. Intellectual-artistic capacity and diplomatic charm amplified for the year.

Success in writing, editing, arts, fashion, diplomatic work. Conjugal and beauty-vocation business growth.

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MOON_JUPITER.name: Itthashala Moon-Jupiter — manas + dharma harmony.
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MOON_JUPITER.prose:
Itthashala Moon-Jupiter — Tajika Nilakanthi Ch.5 — Moon and Jupiter in mutual applying-aspect. Manas-karaka and dharma-karaka unified in varshaphala. Doctrinally one of the most auspicious Tajik itthashalas — comparable to Gajakesari in natal-chart astrology.

The native receives mental peace, intellectual growth, and guru-kripa for the year. Success in education, advisory work, and philosophical depth.

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_SUN_JUPITER.name: Itthashala Sun-Jupiter — atma + dharma applying-aspect.
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_SUN_JUPITER.prose:
Itthashala Sun-Jupiter — Tajika Nilakanthi Ch.5 — Sun and Jupiter in mutual applying-aspect within 15° (the foundational Tajik yoga form). Atma-karaka and dharma-karaka mutually supporting in the varshaphala (annual-chart) lifts royal eminence, religious support, and paternal grace for the year.

Note: the engine currently lacks an aspect-by-degree predicate; this rule uses sign-conjunction as a proxy. Charts firing the proxy always satisfy the strict applying-aspect form (some over-detection).

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_VENUS_JUPITER.name: Itthashala Venus-Jupiter — dual-guru harmony, supreme.
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_VENUS_JUPITER.prose:
Itthashala Venus-Jupiter — Tajika Nilakanthi Ch.5 — Venus and Jupiter, the two great benefics, in mutual applying-aspect. Doctrinally the supreme Tajik itthashala.

The native receives wealth, higher education, religious eminence, and prosperity for the year. Classical signature for chief justices, dharma-gurus, large merchants, established educational figures. Conjugal-prosperity boost.

TAJIK_KHALLASARA_BENEFIC_KENDRA_TRIKONA.name: Khallasara — benefic in kendra+trikona. Purified-aspect year.
TAJIK_KHALLASARA_BENEFIC_KENDRA_TRIKONA.prose:
Khallasara — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — "Khallasara" means "purified throat / clear voice"; in Tajik doctrine, refined/pure aspect. A benefic occupies a house that is BOTH a kendra AND trikona (only the 1st qualifies as both).

The native receives unobstructed pure benefic results for the year — direct grace-flow without distortion. Auspicious for education, dharma, travel, long-term construction-vocations.

TAJIK_MANAHA_MALEFIC_LAGNA_NO_BENEFIC.name: Manaha — malefic in Lagna without benefic aspect. Pressure-year.
TAJIK_MANAHA_MALEFIC_LAGNA_NO_BENEFIC.prose:
Manaha — Tajika Nilakanthi Ch.5 — malefic in Lagna of the varshaphala without benefic aspect or co-occupation. Benefic-rescue-less malefic situation.

The native experiences self-pressure, health-stress, lack of grace-flow, and mental fatigue for the year. Benefic aspect or strong Lagna-lord can soften.

TAJIK_MUTHA_MARS_SATURN_KENDRA.name: Mutha — Mars-Saturn in kendra. Year of friction in action.
TAJIK_MUTHA_MARS_SATURN_KENDRA.prose:
Mutha — Tajika Nilakanthi Ch.5 — Mars and Saturn jointly in any kendra of the varshaphala. The 4th-aspect (Mutha) configuration of these two malefics produces structural friction.

The native faces work-friction, authority-conflicts, mechanical-accident vigilance, and recurring obstruction in long-term tasks for the year. Remedy: Mars-Saturn pacification.

TAJIK_PHALADEEPIKA_JUPITER_LAGNA_FROM_MO.name: Phaladeepika rule — Jupiter in Lagna from Moon. Manas-dharma year.
TAJIK_PHALADEEPIKA_JUPITER_LAGNA_FROM_MO.prose:
Phaladeepika Jupiter-Lagna-from-Moon — Phaladeepika Ch.20 — Jupiter in the Lagna of the varshaphala chart counted from Moon (Jupiter conjunct or co-located with Moon). The varshaphala equivalent of natal Gajakesari.

The native receives mental peace, intellectual growth, guru-grace, and a religiously-auspicious year. If Jupiter dasha or antardasha runs in this year, the effect is supreme.

TAJIK_PHALADEEPIKA_LAGNA_BENEFIC_KENDRA.name: Phaladeepika rule — benefic in Lagna with kendra-support.
TAJIK_PHALADEEPIKA_LAGNA_BENEFIC_KENDRA.prose:
Phaladeepika Lagna-Benefic-Kendra — Phaladeepika Ch.20 (Tajik supplement) — benefic in the varshaphala Lagna AND another benefic supporting from a kendra. An expansion of Iqbala: one benefic on atma-karaka plus another in foundation-pillar.

The native receives grace-flow, health-stability, and a benefic family-environment for the year.

TAJIK_RADDA_MALEFIC_KENDRA_NO_BENEFIC.name: Radda — malefic in kendra without benefic. Year of resistance.
TAJIK_RADDA_MALEFIC_KENDRA_NO_BENEFIC.prose:
Radda — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — "Radda" means "rejection/refusal". A malefic in any kendra of the varshaphala without benefic aspect or co-occupation.

The native experiences resistance, lack of cooperation, and work-friction for the year. Benefic aspect or strong Lagna-lord can soften. Inauspicious for new ventures; acceptable for inward work and construction.

TAJIK_RUD_DHAR_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_1_10.name: Rud-Dhar — Lagna-10th lord exchange. Self-career fused for year.
TAJIK_RUD_DHAR_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_1_10.prose:
Rud-Dhar — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — Lagna-lord and 10th-lord exchange in the varshaphala. Self-significator and karma-significator swap; identity and vocation fuse for the year.

The native receives career-eminence, public-stage growth, and goal-attainment for the year. Auspicious for major professional decisions or reputation-building. The annual-chart parallel of natal Maha-Parivartana 1-10.

TAJIK_YAMAYYA_2_BENEFICS_KENDRA.name: Yamayya — two benefics in kendras. Twin-benefic protection year.
TAJIK_YAMAYYA_2_BENEFICS_KENDRA.prose:
Yamayya 2-Benefics-Kendra — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — "Yamayya" means "twin"; two natural benefics in kendras of the varshaphala. Twin-benefic strength in the foundation-pillars.

The native receives dual-benefic support for the year: honor, prosperity, and family-related good news. Auspicious for travel, celebrations, and major ceremonies.

TAJIK_YAMAYYA_DUAL_BENEFIC_LAGNA.name: Yamayya Dual-Benefic-Lagna — two benefics in Lagna together.
TAJIK_YAMAYYA_DUAL_BENEFIC_LAGNA.prose:
Yamayya Dual-Benefic-Lagna — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — two benefics together in the varshaphala Lagna. The supreme tier among Yamayya configurations.

The native receives dual-benefic support of the atma-karaka — personal eminence, health-stability, grace-flow for the year. Highly auspicious for major decisions, ventures, significant transitions.

TAJIK_YAMAYYA_LUMINARIES_TRIKONA.name: Yamayya Luminaries-Trikona — Sun and Moon in trikonas.
TAJIK_YAMAYYA_LUMINARIES_TRIKONA.prose:
Yamayya Luminaries-Trikona — Varshaphala Padhati Ch.4 — Sun AND Moon both in trikonas (1, 5, 9) of the varshaphala. Atma-karaka and manas-karaka both in dharma-trikonas.

The native receives mental stability, dharmic decisiveness, paternal grace, and contemplative action for the year. Auspicious for pilgrimage, religious rituals, traditional family events.

TITHI_DOSHA.name: Tithi Dosha — Riktā tithi birth (4/9/14) per Muhurta Chintamani.
TITHI_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi, Tithi Dosha = birth on a Riktā tithi (4th, 9th, or 14th of either pakṣa). The Riktā group is classically marked as inauspicious for muhurta-based new beginnings. Confers reduced auspicious-work potency, saṃskāra-śānti requirement, and obstacles in mangalya rituals. Among the milder panchanga doshas — affects ritual timing more than life-pattern.
TITHI_DOSHA.general: Reduced auspicious-work potency, saṃskāra-śānti requirement, mangalya obstacles.

TRIPURA_SUNDARI.name: Tripura-Sundari Yoga — exalted Venus in kendra aspected by benefics per Saravali 34.
TRIPURA_SUNDARI.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Tripura-Sundari Yoga = Venus exalted/own-sign in a kendra, aspected by benefics. Confers Tripura-Sundari (the goddess Lalitā) like divine beauty, supreme artistic fame, royal-female connections, and exceptional sensory abundance. The signature beauty-and-charm yoga in the corpus.
TRIPURA_SUNDARI.general: Divine beauty, supreme artistic fame, royal-female connections, sensory abundance, sweetness.

TRI_BHUVANA.name: Tri-Bhuvana Yoga — all benefics in kendras/trikoṇas. Fame in three worlds per Saravali 34.
TRI_BHUVANA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Tri-Bhuvana Yoga arises when all natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, Moon) occupy kendras/trikoṇas. Fame extends through "three worlds" (earthly, atmospheric, celestial — i.e., across all life-domains). One of the supreme Raja-yogas in Saravali's catalogue, reserved for the rarest charts of universally-recognised greatness.
TRI_BHUVANA.general: Fame in three worlds, supreme Raja-yoga, ultimate eminence, all-direction prosperity.

UBHAYACHARI.name: Ubhayachari — benefics on BOTH sides of Sun. Apex Sun-axis yoga.
UBHAYACHARI.prose:
Ubhayachari — Brihat Jataka 13.3 — benefics simultaneously in BOTH the 2nd AND 12th from Sun. The atma-karaka is benefic-protected on both axes — doctrinally the strongest of the Sun-axis yogas.

The native receives all-round prosperity, honor and reputation, protection from enemies, and durable authority. Vesi (outward leadership) and Vosi (inner cultivation) operate together — complete personality protection.

UBHAYACHARI_BROAD.name: Ubhayachari (broad) — planets flanking the Sun in the 2nd and 12th. Complete solar alignment and prominence.
UBHAYACHARI_BROAD.prose: Ubhayachari Yoga (broad form) — Reference Brihat Jataka Chapter 13, Verse 3. This yoga is created when planets (excluding the Moon and nodes) occupy both the 2nd and 12th houses from the Sun. By surrounding the solar atma-karaka with planetary buffers, it grants the native supreme composure, lasting fame, immense personal gravitas, and success in public life.
UBHAYACHARI_BROAD.career: Long-lasting renown, diplomatic success, high-level leadership
UBHAYACHARI_BROAD.mind: Superb balance of expression and reflection, enduring self-worth

UBHAYACHARI_SUN_RAJA.name: Ubhayachari Sun-Raja Yoga — benefics on both sides of Sun + Sun strong. Total royal fame per Brihat Jataka 13.
UBHAYACHARI_SUN_RAJA.prose: Per Brihat Jataka Ch.13, Ubhayachari Sun-Raja Yoga = benefics 2nd AND 12th from Sun AND in kendras AND Sun strong. Combines Vesi + Vasi: outward authority + inward influence simultaneously. The native enjoys complete royal fame, equally visible and behind-the-scenes power, and well-rounded authority. The strongest of the three Sun-axis Raja-yogas.
UBHAYACHARI_SUN_RAJA.general: Total royal fame, balanced outward/inward influence, comprehensive authority, royal lineage.

VAGISH_MERCURY_2_5_9_OWN_EXALT.name: Vagish — Mercury in 2/5/9 in own/exalted. Eloquence united with dharmic learning.
VAGISH_MERCURY_2_5_9_OWN_EXALT.prose:
Vagish Yoga — Phaladeepika Ch.13 — forms when Mercury occupies the 2nd (vak-bhava — speech and wealth-of-words), 5th (buddhi-purvapunya-bhava — intelligence and merit), or 9th (dharma-bhava) house in own, exalted, mooltrikona, or deep-exaltation dignity. Named "Lord of Speech" (Vagish), the yoga conjoins articulate eloquence with dharmic philosophical depth.

Natives excel in philosophy, theological exegesis, law and advocacy, editorial writing, and classical pedagogy. The 2nd-house variant emphasizes vocabulary and expressive power; the 5th emphasizes intellectual brilliance born of inherited merit; the 9th emphasizes dharmic-philosophical authority. All three placements demand dignified Mercury — the yoga does not form on a wounded intellect-karaka.
VAGISH_MERCURY_2_5_9_OWN_EXALT.career: Philosophy, law, editing, classical pedagogy, exegesis

VAIDHRITI_DOSHA.name: Vaidhṛti Dosha — Vaidhṛti panchanga-yoga birth per Muhurta Chintamani.
VAIDHRITI_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi, Vaidhṛti Dosha = birth during the Vaidhṛti panchanga-yoga (the 27th and final of the 27 panchanga yogas — classically inauspicious alongside Vyatīpāta). Confers auspicious-work uncertainty, saṃskāra-śānti requirement, and mangalya-karma obstacles. Often grouped with Vyatīpāta in classical remediation guidance.
VAIDHRITI_DOSHA.general: Auspicious-work uncertainty, saṃskāra-śānti requirement, mangalya-karma obstacles.

VAPI.name: Vapi Yoga — 7 grahas in kendra/panaphara per BPHS 36. Stepwell-like reservoir.
VAPI.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Vapi Yoga = 7 grahas evenly distributed across kendras and panapharas. The "stepwell" (vapi) pattern confers wealth-reservoir behaviour, stable growth, and expense-controlled life. Less grand than Samudra but more reliably accumulating.
VAPI.general: Wealth-reservoir, stable growth, expense control, stepwell-like steady source.

VASI_SUN_RAJA.name: Vasi Sun-Raja Yoga — benefics 12th-from-Sun + Sun strong. Behind-the-scenes royal influence per Brihat Jataka 13.
VASI_SUN_RAJA.prose: Per Brihat Jataka Ch.13, Vasi Sun-Raja Yoga = benefics 12th-from-Sun AND placed in kendras AND Sun strong. The native exerts behind-the-scenes royal influence, possesses indirect power, maintains confidential royal connections, and holds subtle authority. Mirror of Vesi (outward authority) — Vasi is inward/refined power.
VASI_SUN_RAJA.general: Behind-the-scenes royal influence, indirect power, confidential royal connections, subtle authority.

VASUKI.name: Vāsuki Yoga — Rahu in benefic conjunction in kendra/trikoṇa per Jataka Parijata 5.
VASUKI.prose: Per Jataka Parijata Ch.5, Vāsuki Yoga = Rahu in benefic conjunction placed in kendras/trikoṇas in auspicious positions. Confers Vāsuki (king of nāgas)-like hidden power, unexpected wealth, foreign-residence/travel fame, and unconventional-karma capability. The yoga lifts Rahu from its default malefic role to a serpent-power asset.
VASUKI.general: Vāsuki-like hidden power, unexpected wealth, foreign travel/fame, unconventional capability.

VASUMATI.name: Vasumati — benefics in all 4 upachayas from Moon. Sustained wealth.
VASUMATI.prose:
Vasumati — BPHS Ch.34 v.8 — natural benefics (Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, unwounded Moon) simultaneously occupy ALL four upachaya houses (3, 6, 10, 11) reckoned from the Moon. Upachaya-houses are growth-houses where even malefics produce favorable results; benefics in all four signal supreme classical wealth-growth.

"Vasumati" literally means "rich in wealth". The native enjoys multi-source income, growing prosperity through the lifespan, and a unified manas-and-material expansion: Moon-relative upachaya benefics produce positive emotional disposition AND robust material accumulation. The structural opposite of Shakata — steady upward growth rather than rise-and-fall cycles.

VASUMATI_RAJA.name: Vasumati-Raja Yoga — benefics strong in upachaya bhavas. Earth-Vasumati prosperity per Phaladeepika 6.
VASUMATI_RAJA.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Vasumati-Raja Yoga arises when benefics are strongly placed in upachaya bhavas (3/6/10/11). Confers prosperity comparable to "Vasumati" (the earth as wealth-bearer), all-direction wealth growth, and stable royal fame. The Raja-yoga overlay on the broader Vasumati pattern from chandra-advanced.
VASUMATI_RAJA.general: Earth-Vasumati prosperity, all-direction wealth growth, stable royal fame, upachaya-augmentation.

VEDHA_DOSHA.name: Vedha Dosha — bride/groom nakshatra-vedha relation per Muhurta Chintamani 6.
VEDHA_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi Ch.6, Vedha Dosha = bride/groom nakshatras occupy mutually-piercing positions on the classical nakshatra-vedha table. Confers reciprocal health affliction, escalating marital strain, and reduced overall vitality. Each nakshatra has a "vedha-pair" — pairings on this list classically signal the dosha. Mitigation requires nakshatra-specific śānti rituals.
VEDHA_DOSHA.general: Reciprocal health affliction, marital-strain escalation, vitality reduction.

VEENA.name: Veena Yoga — 7 planets in 7 distinct signs per BPHS 36. Artistic, musical temperament.
VEENA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Veena Yoga = each of 7 grahas in a distinct sign. Native is artistic, musical, sweet-voiced, and evenly-radiant (the seven strings of the veena distributed harmoniously). The most balanced of the Sankhya yogas — life unfolds as a coordinated melody.
VEENA.general: Artistic temperament, musical inclination, sweet voice, balanced radiance.

VEERA.name: Veera Yoga — exalted Mars in kendra aspected by Moon-Jupiter per Saravali 34.
VEERA.prose: Per Saravali Ch.34, Veera (hero) Yoga = Mars exalted/own-sign in a kendra, aspected by Moon and Jupiter. Confers Mahā-vīra-like (great-hero) valour, exceptional courage, eight-direction conquering capability, and military-commander fame. The combination of warrior + emotional grace + wisdom produces a balanced hero-archetype.
VEERA.general: Mahā-vīra-like valour, exceptional courage, all-direction-conquest, military-commander fame.

VEN_IN_1.name: Venus in Lagna: beautiful form, art-loving, sensory abundance, charm per Phaladeepika 8 / BPHS 22.
VEN_IN_1.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Venus in Lagna confers physical beauty, art-loving disposition, sensory abundance, contentment, and respect from women. BPHS Ch.22 — Venus in the body-bhava grants an artistic, refined personality. Common in performers, designers, and those whose careers leverage charm and aesthetics.
VEN_IN_1.general: Beauty, artistic temperament, sensory abundance, respect from women, refined manners.

VEN_IN_10.name: Venus in 10th — Kalā-Karma Raja Yoga (named-classical) per Phaladeepika 8.
VEN_IN_10.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8 (named-classical variant), Venus in 10th = Kalā-Karma Raja Yoga. Confers artistic-career fame, beautiful/colorful work, female-collective support, and entertainment-industry-style royal fame. Common in performers, designers, hospitality leaders, and aesthetic-domain authority figures.
VEN_IN_10.general: Artistic-career fame, beautiful work, female-collective support, entertainment-industry fame.

VEN_IN_11.name: Venus in 11th: Lābha-Kalā Yoga. Continuous gains, wealth via women/friends per Phaladeepika 8.
VEN_IN_11.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Venus in the 11th forms a Lābha-Kalā Yoga — continuous wealth gains, women/friend-driven income, fame through artistic ventures, and steady desire-fulfilment. BPHS Ch.22 — Venus in the gain-bhava augments all life-domains. Common in entertainment-industry professionals and those whose income flows from aesthetic enterprises.
VEN_IN_11.general: Lābha-Kalā Yoga, continuous gains, women/friend wealth, artistic ventures, desire-fulfilment.

VEN_IN_2.name: Venus in 2nd — Kalā-Dhana yoga (named-classical) per Phaladeepika 8.
VEN_IN_2.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8 (named-classical variant), Venus in 2nd = Kalā-Dhana yoga. Confers abundant wealth-accumulation, melodious speech, female-mediated wealth growth, and artistic inclination. Mirror of Jupiter-in-2 with art-flavour replacing dharmic-speech flavour.
VEN_IN_2.general: Art-wealth fusion, abundant accumulation, melodious speech, female-mediated wealth, artistic inclination.

VEN_IN_4.name: Venus in 4th: home/vehicle/sensory abundance, maternal happiness per Phaladeepika 8.
VEN_IN_4.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Venus in the 4th confers home/vehicle/sensory abundance, beautiful domestic life, maternal happiness, and wealth augmented through women's cooperation. BPHS Ch.22 — Venus in the comfort-bhava forms a sensory-kendra Raja-yoga. Common in interior designers, hospitality professionals, and those whose home itself is the source of fortune.
VEN_IN_4.general: Home/vehicle/sensory abundance, maternal happiness, beautiful home, women-driven wealth, heart-pleasure.

VEN_IN_5.name: Venus in 5th: poetry-art-progeny Raja Yoga. Intellect, artistry, progeny per Phaladeepika 8.
VEN_IN_5.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Venus in the 5th forms a poetry-art-progeny Raja Yoga — intellect, artistic disposition, progeny happiness, romantic relationships, and royal fame. BPHS Ch.22 — kāraka-trikoṇa Raja-yoga. Signature placement in poets, artists, dancers, and those whose creativity itself is their fortune.
VEN_IN_5.general: Poetry-art-progeny Raja Yoga, intellect, artistry, progeny, romantic relationships, royal fame.

VEN_IN_7.name: Venus in 7th: kāraka-kāraka spousal yoga. Beautiful spouse, marital harmony per Phaladeepika 8.
VEN_IN_7.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Venus in the 7th forms a kāraka-kāraka spousal yoga — Venus (kāraka of relationship) in kalatra-bhava itself. The native enjoys a beautiful spouse, marital harmony, and elevation through women's cooperation. BPHS Ch.22 — the supreme spousal placement. Common in those whose marriage itself is their fortune-generator.
VEN_IN_7.general: Beautiful spouse, marital harmony, women-driven elevation, business profits, gainful travel.

VEN_IN_9.name: Venus in 9th: kāraka-trikoṇa Raja Yoga. Dharmic artist, fortune via women per Phaladeepika 8.
VEN_IN_9.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.8, Venus in the 9th forms a kāraka-trikoṇa Raja Yoga — dharmic artist, fortune-elevation through women, gainful religious travel, and guru-grace mediated through aesthetic/devotional channels. BPHS Ch.22 — fortune-bhava + Venus = devotional artistry. Common in temple musicians, sacred artists, and those whose dharmic life is mediated through beauty.
VEN_IN_9.general: Bhāgya-Kalā Raja Yoga, dharmic artist, women-driven fortune, religious travel, guru's grace.

VEN_RAHU_CONJ.name: Venus-Rahu conjunction — foreign-art yoga per BPHS 7. Multiple relationships, unconventional art.
VEN_RAHU_CONJ.prose: Per BPHS Ch.7, Venus-Rahu conjunction is mixed-effect — foreign-art inclination, unexpected/multiple relationships, intense pleasure-seeking, and unconventional artistic fame. Rahu's shadow can produce marital strain occasionally. Common in international entertainers, NRI-spouse marriages, and avant-garde artists.
VEN_RAHU_CONJ.general: Foreign-art yoga, multiple relationships, intense pleasure-seeking, unconventional artistic fame.

VEN_SAT_CONJ.name: Venus-Saturn conjunction — stable-marriage union per Saravali 15. Long-term relationship, enduring art.
VEN_SAT_CONJ.prose: Per Saravali Ch.15, Venus-Saturn conjunction = stable-marriage union. Friend-planets in conjunction confer enduring relationships, stable artistic fame, late-life wealth-growth, and deep aesthetic dedication. Phaladeepika — dīrgha-dāmpatya yoga (long-marriage). Common in lifelong-married couples and sustained-career artists.
VEN_SAT_CONJ.general: Stable marriage, enduring relationships, lasting artistic fame, late-life wealth growth.

VESI.name: Vesi — benefic in 2nd from Sun, 12th vacant. Atma-karaka supported.
VESI.prose:
Vesi — Brihat Jataka 13.1 — natural benefic (excluding Moon by classical convention) in the 2nd from Sun, with the 12th-from-Sun vacant (Moon excepted). The atma-karaka is supported on its forward-facing axis without rear-disturbance.

The native receives steady leadership, clear authoritative speech, moral reputation, and royal honor. Each benefic colors the result differently (Phaladeepika 6.18-22 enumerates the per-planet sub-variants — surfaced as VESI_<PLANET> rules). The base rule and matching sub-variant fire together.

VESI_BROAD.name: Vesi Yoga (broad form) — Any planet (except Moon and nodes) in the 2nd house from the Sun. Fortified solar expression.
VESI_BROAD.prose: Vesi Yoga (broad form) — As described in Brihat Jataka Chapter 13, Verse 1. This yoga occurs when any planet other than the Moon, Rahu, and Ketu occupies the 2nd house from the Sun. Unlike the strict Vesi yoga which demands specifically a natural benefic, this broader category admits any qualifying planet. It strengthens the solar atma-karaka, conferring executive capability, articulate speech, and a highly active lifestyle.
VESI_BROAD.career: Authoritative expression, vocational activity, and public drive
VESI_BROAD.mind: Enhanced self-will, solar confidence, strong identity

VESI_JUPITER.name: Vesi-Jupiter — Jupiter in 2nd from Sun. Supreme Vesi tier.
VESI_JUPITER.prose: Vesi-Jupiter — Phaladeepika 6.20 — Jupiter in the 2nd from Sun. Two great benefic-karakas (atma and dharma) supporting each other doctrinally produces the supreme Vesi-tier: dharmic authority, royal-counsellor status, and exceptional moral reputation.

VESI_MARS.name: Vesi-Mars — Mars in 2nd from Sun, 12th vacant. Martial command.
VESI_MARS.prose: Vesi-Mars — Phaladeepika 6.18 — Mars occupying the 2nd from Sun while the 12th-from-Sun is vacant (Moon excepted). Mars' parakrama-function reinforces the atma-karaka; the native receives commanding presence, direct authoritative speech, and natural fit for military, surgical, or competitive leadership.

VESI_MERCURY.name: Vesi-Mercury — Mercury in 2nd from Sun. Statesman-like intellect.
VESI_MERCURY.prose: Vesi-Mercury — Phaladeepika 6.19 — Mercury occupying the 2nd from Sun while 12th-from-Sun vacant. The intellect-karaka and atma-karaka mutually support each other, granting clear analytical thinking, persuasive speech, and statesman-like authority. Natural aptitude for journalism, diplomacy, administration.

VESI_SATURN.name: Vesi-Saturn — Saturn in 2nd from Sun. Disciplined durable authority.
VESI_SATURN.prose: Vesi-Saturn — Phaladeepika 6.22 — Saturn in the 2nd from Sun. Atma-karaka with chronic-stability karaka produces disciplined-but-slow rise: authority arrives durably with maturity, service-class leadership, eminence-late-but-lasting.

VESI_SUN_RAJA.name: Vesi Sun-Raja Yoga — benefics 2nd-from-Sun + Sun strong. Royal audience per Brihat Jataka 13.
VESI_SUN_RAJA.prose: Per Brihat Jataka Ch.13, Vesi Sun-Raja Yoga = benefics 2nd-from-Sun AND placed in kendras AND Sun itself strong. The native gains audience with kings/authorities, royal-lineage connections, and high office. Stronger than the plain Vesi (broad-form) — this is the Raja-yoga overlay where Sun's authority-giving capacity is fully activated by surrounding benefics.
VESI_SUN_RAJA.general: Royal audience, royal-lineage connections, high office, expanded authority.

VESI_VENUS.name: Vesi-Venus — Venus in 2nd from Sun. Refined diplomatic charm.
VESI_VENUS.prose: Vesi-Venus — Phaladeepika 6.21 — Venus in the 2nd from Sun. Atma-karaka united with bhoga-karaka integrates authority with charm — refined leadership, diplomatic grace, and cultural eminence. Conjugal happiness amplified.

VIDYA_4_5_LORDS_PARIVARTANA.name: Vidya-Putra Parivartana — 4-5 mutual exchange. Education and merit jointly empowered.
VIDYA_4_5_LORDS_PARIVARTANA.prose:
Vidya-Putra-Parivartana forms when the 4th-lord occupies the 5th and the 5th-lord occupies the 4th — a mutual exchange (parivartana) between the education-house and the merit-house. Parivartana-yogas are uniformly powerful in classical doctrine: they fuse the karaka-domains of both houses into a single compounded effect.

The 4-5 exchange unifies education (vidya), home-comfort (sukha), and mother (matr) with merit (purva-punya), intelligence (buddhi), children (santana), and creative expression. Natives find that learning flows from inherited merit, intelligence is irrigated by maternal affection, and children-welfare and educational-welfare advance together. Excellence emerges in teaching, counseling, child-development, and creative-education professions.
VIDYA_4_5_LORDS_PARIVARTANA.relationships: Children and mother welfare advance jointly

VIDYA_4_LORD_KENDRA.name: Vidya — 4th-lord in kendra. Education and home-comfort well-anchored.
VIDYA_4_LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Vidya 4-Lord-Kendra forms when the 4th-lord — significator of education (vidya), mother (matr), home-comfort (sukha), and immovable assets — occupies a kendra from the Lagna. The placement anchors learning-capacity in the structural pillars of the chart: body (1st), home (4th), partnerships (7th), or career (10th).

Classical commentary places these natives in academic, real-estate, hospitality, and home-rooted professions. Mother tends to be supportive and long-lived, formal education completes well, and the native acquires stable property over the lifetime.

VIDYA_4_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Vidya — 4th-lord in own/exalted sign. Full education-flower achieved.
VIDYA_4_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose:
Vidya 4-Lord-Own/Exalted forms when the 4th-lord occupies its own sign, exaltation sign, or mooltrikona — the dignified placements where the planet expresses full power. The yoga delivers the complete bouquet of 4th-house results: higher education, ancestral home/property, vehicles, mother-welfare, and emotional grounding.

Classical strength-ordering: Exalted > Own-Sign > Mooltrikona. The native typically completes formal higher education, inherits or acquires substantial property, and enjoys vehicles. The mother is long-lived, supportive, and often prosperous in her own right.

VIDYA_4_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Vidya — 4th-lord in trikona. Learning aligned with dharma and merit.
VIDYA_4_LORD_TRIKONA.prose:
Vidya 4-Lord-Trikona forms when the 4th-lord occupies a trikona (1st, 5th, 9th) — the dharma-houses of the chart. Trikona-houses signify merit accumulated from past births (purva-punya) and the dharmic axis of life. Education thus arrives charged with moral-philosophical orientation rather than utilitarian instrumentality.

Classical commentary places these natives in philosophy, theology, dharmic teaching, traditional-knowledge custodianship, and contemplative scholarship. The 9th-house variant is especially pronounced — Vidya merges with Dharma and the native often becomes a teacher, guru-figure, or transmitter of inherited knowledge.
VIDYA_4_LORD_TRIKONA.career: Philosophy, theology, traditional knowledge, dharmic teaching

VIDYUT.name: Vidyut Yoga — 11th lord exalted in kendra aspected by Venus per Phaladeepika 6.
VIDYUT.prose: Per Phaladeepika Ch.6, Vidyut Yoga = 11th lord exalted/own-sign in a kendra, aspected by Venus. The "lightning" name signals sudden wealth-strike: unexpected gains, electric fame, dazzling personality. Common in those whose financial breakthroughs come abruptly and brilliantly.
VIDYUT.general: Sudden wealth-gain, unexpected fame, lightning-like radiance, dazzling personality.

VIHAGA.name: Vihaga Yoga — 7 grahas in 4th + 10th per BPHS 36. Bird-like traveller.
VIHAGA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Vihaga Yoga = 7 grahas in the 4th and 10th kendras. The "bird" name signals a traveller's life — frequent journeys, message-bearing/courier-style work, unsettled residence, and an upward-aspiring temperament. Common in journalists, pilots, diplomats, and message-economy professionals.
VIHAGA.general: Travel-prone, message-bearing work, unsettled residence, upward-aspiring temperament.

VIKRAMA_3_BENEFIC_AND_3LORD_KENDRA.name: Vikrama — benefic in 3rd + 3-lord in kendra. Compound courage.
VIKRAMA_3_BENEFIC_AND_3LORD_KENDRA.prose:
Vikrama (literally "valor") forms when a benefic occupies the 3rd AND the 3rd-lord occupies a kendra (Saravali Ch.40). The compound provides initiative (3-lord in kendra) plus emotional support (benefic in 3rd) simultaneously — courage anchored both internally and structurally.

Classical commentary places these natives in confident enterprising roles where they succeed both through capability and through harmonious team support.
VIKRAMA_3_BENEFIC_AND_3LORD_KENDRA.career: Enterprise leadership combining capability and collaboration
VIKRAMA_3_BENEFIC_AND_3LORD_KENDRA.mind: Confident initiative supported by harmonious team

VIMALA.name: Vimala — 12th-lord in 6/8/12. Confers controlled spending and refined disposition.
VIMALA.prose:
Vimala is the third canonical Vipareeta-Raja Yoga (Phaladeepika 6.38). It forms when the 12th-lord — significator of loss, expenditure, and foreign lands — falls into one of the three dusthana houses. The double-negative inversion grants natural restraint in spending, success in foreign domains, and refinement of disposition.

The Sanskrit name "Vimala" literally means "pure" or "unstained." Classical commentary describes Vimala natives as those who naturally avoid waste, succeed when working away from their birthplace, develop spiritual discipline through retreat, and cultivate refined personal conduct. The yoga is the gentlest of the three canonical Vipareeta yogas — its effects are quieter than Harsha's adversity-victory or Sarala's longevity, manifesting as steady moderation rather than dramatic reversal.

**Purity caveat.** Phaladeepika 6.38 commentary applies the same purity doctrine — the yoga weakens when the 12th-lord associates with non-dusthana lords.
VIMALA.career: Foreign diplomacy, monastic vocation, ritual specialism, secluded research
VIMALA.mind: Refined personal conduct, simplicity, freedom from extravagance
VIMALA.spirituality: Capacity for retreat, meditation, and dharmic discipline
VIMALA.wealth: Natural restraint in spending, savings disposition

VIPAREETA_RAJA_PARIVARTANA.name: Vipareeta-Raja Parivartana — mutual exchange among any two dusthana-lords.
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PARIVARTANA.prose:
Vipareeta-Raja Parivartana (BPHS Ch.34) forms when any two of the three dusthana-lords (6th, 8th, 12th) exchange signs — the 6th-lord lands in 8th OR 12th sign while the corresponding lord lands in the 6th sign, etc. Three permutations are valid (6-8, 6-12, 8-12).

The parivartana doubles the double-negative inversion. Classical commentary describes the yoga as conferring the combined effects of all three sect-yogas simultaneously — victory over adversity, longevity through transformation, and disciplined restraint — anchored by the structural strength of mutual exchange. Where the canonical sect-yogas describe a single dusthana-lord caught in another dusthana, this compound describes two dusthana-lords completing each other's domain in a structural lock.

Classical strength rating: TIER_1. The parivartana configuration is among the supreme classical Raja-yogas, doctrinally placed alongside Maha-Bhagya and Pure-Vipareeta in chart-output prominence.
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PARIVARTANA.career: Combined gains from medicine/research/foreign work integrated
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PARIVARTANA.longevity: Sustained longevity through structural mutual support
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PARIVARTANA.spirituality: Capacity for both crisis-transformation and sustained discipline
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PARIVARTANA.wealth: Inheritance + spending discipline together; durable accumulation

VIPAREETA_RAJA_PURE.name: Pure Vipareeta-Raja — dusthana-lord in own dusthana with own/exalted dignity.
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PURE.prose:
Pure Vipareeta-Raja (Saravali Ch.34) is the supreme-purity tier. It forms when a dusthana-lord (6th, 8th, or 12th) is BOTH placed in its own dusthana house (6th-lord in 6th, etc.) AND simultaneously in own / mooltrikona / exalted dignity. The doctrinal "pure double negative" — no external lord-conjunction dilutes the inversion, and the dignity layer further amplifies the effect.

Classical commentary places this yoga among the supreme Raja-yogas. The dignity requirement makes it rarer than the parivartana or triple variants but doctrinally even purer — the inversion is internal to the lord itself rather than dependent on relational structure.

Classical strength rating: TIER_1, featured.
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PURE.career: Pure-tier configuration — adversity-resolution capacity without external dilution
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PURE.spirituality: Capacity for spiritual transformation through sustained engagement with adversity
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PURE.wealth: Sustained royal-class fortune; stable wealth accumulation

VIPAREETA_RAJA_TRIPLE.name: Triple Vipareeta-Raja — all 3 dusthana-lords in 6/8/12. Supreme tier.
VIPAREETA_RAJA_TRIPLE.prose:
Triple Vipareeta-Raja (BPHS Ch.34) is the supreme-tier configuration in this category. It forms when ALL three dusthana-lords (6th, 8th, 12th) simultaneously occupy ALL three dusthana-houses — a structural lock where every malefic-house lord is caught within another malefic house, completing the system's self-cancellation.

The yoga is rare and doctrinally placed among the supreme classical Raja-yogas. Classical commentary describes the native as one whose entire pattern of adversity inverts — every domain that ordinarily threatens (enemies, hidden ruptures, loss) becomes a vehicle for elevation. The native is often described as "kingly through the very forces that should destroy."

Classical strength rating: TIER_1, featured.
VIPAREETA_RAJA_TRIPLE.career: Supreme adversity-resolution capacity; leadership emerges precisely under crisis
VIPAREETA_RAJA_TRIPLE.longevity: Long life with rescue from seemingly fatal situations
VIPAREETA_RAJA_TRIPLE.spirituality: Highest tier of moksha potential within the Vipareeta family
VIPAREETA_RAJA_TRIPLE.wealth: Recovery from total loss; resources arrive through unexpected channels

VIPARITA_12_IN_8.name: 12th lord in 8th: Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Mutual loss-death destruction = longevity, hidden wealth per BPHS 34.
VIPARITA_12_IN_8.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34, the 12th lord in the 8th forms a Vipareeta Raja Yoga — mutual destruction of loss-and-death yields longevity, hidden wealth (legacy/insurance/research-finds), and freedom from death-anxiety. Distinct from same-house Sarala Yoga (8L_in_8); this is the exchange-flavoured variant.
VIPARITA_12_IN_8.general: Vipareeta Raja Yoga, longevity, hidden wealth, freedom from death-anxiety, expense control.

VIPARITA_6_IN_12.name: 6th lord in 12th: Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Mutual destruction of enemy-loss = expense control per BPHS 34.
VIPARITA_6_IN_12.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34 vv.17-19, Vipareeta Raja Yoga arises when one dusthana-lord (6/8/12) falls into another dusthana — the mutual destruction inverts to confer auspicious results. The 6th lord in the 12th nullifies the 12th's loss-tendency via 6th's aggressive energy, yielding expense control, victory over enemies, and debt cancellation. Distinct from the same-house Vimala Yoga (12L_in_12) — this is an exchange-flavoured variant.
VIPARITA_6_IN_12.general: Vipareeta Raja Yoga, mutual destruction of enemy-loss, expense control, victory over enemies, debt cancellation.

VIPARITA_8_IN_6.name: 8th lord in 6th: Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Mutual death-enemy destruction = longevity, victory per BPHS 34.
VIPARITA_8_IN_6.prose: Per BPHS Ch.34, the 8th lord in the 6th forms a Vipareeta Raja Yoga — mutual destruction of death-and-enemies yields longevity, victory over foes, recovery from disease, and freedom from death-anxiety. Distinct from same-house Harsha Yoga (6L_in_6); this is the exchange-flavoured variant.
VIPARITA_8_IN_6.general: Vipareeta Raja Yoga, longevity, victory over enemies, disease recovery, freedom from death-anxiety.

VIPARITA_RAJA_12_6.name: Viparita Raja (12-6) — 12th-lord in 6th. Also known as Vimala Yoga.
VIPARITA_RAJA_12_6.prose:
Viparita Raja Yoga 12-6 — BPHS Ch.34 — 12th-lord in 6th. Classical name "Vimala."

Result: expense-significator stationed in the controlled-house produces budget-discipline, expense-reduction, and resource-management skill. Among the three Viparita-Raja yogas this is the most subtle — the "invisible wealth" tier, where prosperity arises from controlled outflow rather than dramatic inflow.

VIPARITA_RAJA_6_8.name: Viparita Raja (6-8) — 6th-lord in 8th. Also known as Harsha Yoga.
VIPARITA_RAJA_6_8.prose:
Viparita Raja Yoga 6-8 — BPHS Ch.34 — 6th-lord occupies the 8th house. Mutual destruction of dusthana-lords inverts to confer protection from enemies, debts, and disease.

This rule's classical name is "Harsha." Result: enemy-defeat, debt-resolution, and recovery from chronic illness.

VIPARITA_RAJA_8_12.name: Viparita Raja (8-12) — 8th-lord in 12th. Also known as Sarala Yoga.
VIPARITA_RAJA_8_12.prose:
Viparita Raja Yoga 8-12 — BPHS Ch.34 — 8th-lord in 12th. Classical name "Sarala."

Result: longevity, occult/mantric insight, triumph over hidden adversaries. Mortality-significator unified with loss-significator inverts mortality-pressure into transformation-capacity.

VISH.name: Vish — Moon-Saturn conjunction. Susceptibility to depression, emotional toxicity, and toxic exposures.
VISH.prose: Vish — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — forms on Moon-Saturn conjunction in any house. Moon as mind-karaka fused with Saturn as chronic-restriction-karaka produces a toxicity-signature: psychological toxicity (depression), food/medication poisoning, or chronic infection. Remedy: Moon-Saturn pacification, Monday/Saturday vrata, vish-nivarak mantra, meditation.

VISHA_KANYA_DOSHA.name: Visha Kanya Dosha — Parashara vara+tithi+nakshatra coincidence. Marital-harmony affliction.
VISHA_KANYA_DOSHA.prose: Per Parashara, Visha Kanya ("poison maiden") Dosha = birth on one of three vara-tithi-nakshatra coincidences: Sunday + Dvitiya + Ashlesha, Saturday + Saptami + Krittika, or Tuesday + Dvadashi + Shatabhisha (tithi by number, either paksha). Classically flagged as a structural hurdle to marital peace — relational distress, communication barriers, and concern for a partner's well-being. Cancellation per Parashara: a benefic in the 7th from Lagna, or the 7th-lord in its own/exalted sign. Remedies: Kumbh Vivah, Vishnu puja, Mahamrityunjaya japa.
VISHA_KANYA_DOSHA.general: Marital discord, relational distress, partner well-being concern.

VOSI.name: Vosi — benefic in 12th from Sun, 2nd vacant. Refined cultivation.
VOSI.prose:
Vosi — Brihat Jataka 13.2 — benefic in 12th-from-Sun, 2nd-from-Sun vacant. Distinct from Vesi's direct outward-facing leadership, this rule produces inward refinement and cultivation.

The native receives polished learning, generosity, gentle speech, and a disposition of measured restraint. Phaladeepika 6.23-27 enumerates per-planet sub-variants (VOSI_<PLANET>); base and variant fire together.

VOSI_BROAD.name: Vosi Yoga (broad form) — Any planet (except Moon and nodes) in the 12th house from the Sun. Inner poise and wisdom.
VOSI_BROAD.prose: Vosi Yoga (broad form) — Under Brihat Jataka Chapter 13, Verse 2. This yoga is formed when any qualifying planet other than the Moon, Rahu, and Ketu occupies the 12th house from the Sun. It channels the solar vitality inward, granting the native quiet poise, measured actions, deep scholarly instincts, and a charitable temperament. The native values genuine integrity over ostentation.
VOSI_BROAD.career: Scholarly accomplishments, research efficiency, and strategic execution

VOSI_JUPITER.name: Vosi-Jupiter — Jupiter in 12th from Sun. Supreme Vosi tier.
VOSI_JUPITER.prose: Vosi-Jupiter — Phaladeepika 6.25 — Jupiter in 12th-from-Sun. Where Vesi-Jupiter produces direct dharmic authority, Vosi-Jupiter produces refined depth — inward-facing wisdom, generosity, spiritual contemplation. Among Vosi variants, doctrinally the supreme tier.

VOSI_MARS.name: Vosi-Mars — Mars in 12th from Sun. Refined surgical valor.
VOSI_MARS.prose: Vosi-Mars — Phaladeepika 6.23 — Mars in 12th-from-Sun, 2nd-from-Sun vacant. Unlike Vesi-Mars' direct martial expression, Vosi-Mars produces refined courage — surgical precision, warrior-bearing, sharp judgment under pressure.

VOSI_MERCURY.name: Vosi-Mercury — Mercury in 12th from Sun. Scholarly refinement.
VOSI_MERCURY.prose: Vosi-Mercury — Phaladeepika 6.24 — Mercury in 12th-from-Sun. Distinct from Vesi-Mercury's persuasive declarative speech, Vosi-Mercury produces refined intellect — scholarly research aptitude, measured eloquence, contemplative analysis.

VOSI_SATURN.name: Vosi-Saturn — Saturn in 12th from Sun. Ascetic dignified temperament.
VOSI_SATURN.prose: Vosi-Saturn — Phaladeepika 6.27 — Saturn in 12th-from-Sun. Where Vesi-Saturn produces external service-class authority, Vosi-Saturn produces inward asceticism — refined discipline, vairagya-tendency, dignified gravitas.

VOSI_VENUS.name: Vosi-Venus — Venus in 12th from Sun. Polished aesthetic refinement.
VOSI_VENUS.prose: Vosi-Venus — Phaladeepika 6.26 — Venus in 12th-from-Sun. Distinct from Vesi-Venus' outward-facing diplomatic charm, Vosi-Venus produces inner refinement — subtle aesthetic discernment, conjugal courtesy, contemplative beauty-sensibility.

VYATIPATA_DOSHA.name: Vyatīpāta Dosha — Vyatīpāta panchanga-yoga birth per Muhurta Chintamani.
VYATIPATA_DOSHA.prose: Per Muhurta Chintāmaṇi, Vyatīpāta Dosha = birth during the Vyatīpāta panchanga-yoga (the 17th of the 27 panchanga yogas — classically considered the most inauspicious for muhurta). Confers obstacles in mangalya karmas, inauspicious-action tendency, and saṃskāra-śānti requirement. Classical remediation: Vyatīpāta-śānti karma, sacred bathing, and donation rituals.
VYATIPATA_DOSHA.general: Mangalya-karma obstacles, inauspicious-action tendency, saṃskāra-śānti requirement.

YAMAGHANTA_DOSHA.name: Yamaghanta Dosha — specific vāra-nakshatra combination birth per Narada Samhita.
YAMAGHANTA_DOSHA.prose: Per Nārada Saṃhitā, Yamaghanta Dosha = birth on specific vāra-nakshatra (weekday-asterism) combinations from the classical 28-pair table. Confers Yama-related (death-deity-related) struggle tendency, transition-period crises, and karmic conflict pattern. Detection in the corpus is currently nakshatra-only pending the full vāra-pair table; severity is conservative until that wiring lands.
YAMAGHANTA_DOSHA.general: Yama-related struggle, transition-period crises, karmic conflict pattern.

YOGARISHTA_MARS_8TH_FROM_MOON.name: Yogarishta — Mars in 8th from Moon. High emotional volatility, poor anger management, and sudden trauma risk.
YOGARISHTA_MARS_8TH_FROM_MOON.prose: Yogarishta Mars-8th-from-Moon — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — Mars in the 8th sign from the Moon. The 8-from-Moon position is doctrinally hostile to mental peace; the mind's comfort-source is corrupted by Mars' aggression-function. Mental tension, poor anger-management, sudden trauma-risk. Remedy: Mars-shanti, Hanuman-Chalisa, mind-pacification meditation.

YOGARISHTA_MARS_SATURN_KENDRA.name: Yogarishta — Mars-Saturn in kendra. Volatile mix of acute trauma and chronic stress, striking foundation-houses.
YOGARISHTA_MARS_SATURN_KENDRA.prose: Yogarishta Mars-Saturn-Kendra — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — Mars-Saturn conjunct in any kendra (1, 4, 7, 10). Mars is acute-trauma karaka; Saturn is chronic-restriction karaka. Their conjunction in a foundation-pillar produces a dual signature: chronic stress with episodic acute crises. Remedy: Mars-Saturn pacification, Hanuman-Shiva upasana.
YOGARISHTA_MARS_SATURN_KENDRA.mind: Chronic stress with acute episodic crises

YOGARISHTA_SATURN_LAGNA_DEBIL.name: Yogarishta — debilitated Saturn in Lagna. Reduced physical vitality, bone/nerve concerns, and chronic delays.
YOGARISHTA_SATURN_LAGNA_DEBIL.prose: Yogarishta Saturn-Lagna-Debil — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — Saturn debilitated (Aries) in Lagna. Saturn is the chronic-karaka; debility in the body-house produces long-term physical frailty: bone problems, chronic pain, energy-deficit. Remedy: Shani-shanti, search for Neecha-Bhanga, Hanuman-upasana.

YOGARISHTA_SUN_SATURN_RAHU.name: Yogarishta — Sun, Saturn, and Rahu conjunct. Heavy eclipse on self-identity, mental health, and paternal lineage.
YOGARISHTA_SUN_SATURN_RAHU.prose: Yogarishta Sun-Saturn-Rahu — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — Sun-Saturn-Rahu conjunct in any house. Atma-karaka (Sun) trapped between chronic-restriction (Saturn) and shadow (Rahu); the self-axis is doubly afflicted. Psychological-disorder risk, ego-conflicts, sudden tension. Remedy: trigraha shanti, Gayatri-japa.

YOGARISHTA_TRIKA_LORDS_CONJUNCT.name: Yogarishta — Trika-lords conjunct. Complicated chronic health concerns, offset by potential Vipareeta-Raja windfalls.
YOGARISHTA_TRIKA_LORDS_CONJUNCT.prose: Yogarishta Trika-Lords-Conjunct — Phaladeepika Ch.10 — 6th, 8th, and 12th lords all conjunct in one house. The three dusthana-lords united produce a chronic affliction-cluster: persistent health-issues compounded across illness/transformation/loss domains. Note: this same configuration can also generate Vipareeta-Raja effects when the compound rises to a kendra/trikona — Phaladeepika commentary specifically allows this conversion. Remedy: Navagraha-shanti, Jupiter-Saturn upasana.

YUGA.name: Yuga Yoga — 7 planets confined to 2 signs per BPHS 36. Dual-path nature, modest wealth.
YUGA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Yuga Yoga = all 7 grahas in only 2 signs. Native is dual-natured (split between two paths), engaged in dyadic karma, modest in wealth, and tends toward heretical/non-conformist religious views. Phaladeepika 7 — moderate fruit overall, life flavoured by binary tension.
YUGA.general: Dual-path nature, modest wealth, dyadic karma, non-conformist views.

YUPA.name: Yupa Yoga — 7 grahas in 1st through 4th sequentially per BPHS 36. Sacrificial-post dharma.
YUPA.prose: Per BPHS Ch.36, Yupa Yoga = 7 grahas in the first four houses sequentially (1-2-3-4). The "sacrificial-post" pattern confers dharma-karma engagement, hierarchically-ordered conduct, and stable householder-dharma. Common in priests, ritualists, and disciplined religious householders.
YUPA.general: Dharma-karma engagement, ordered conduct, stable householder-dharma, ritual-work.
